jobs.description:
Overview

Axway, Inc. seeks Senior Services Consultant I (Scottsdale, AZ)

Job Description: Determine an organization’s network and system needs and install operating and application hardware and software. Install and configure Axway API Management solutions (API Manager, API Gateway, Cassandra) across high-availability environments including AWS Cloud, Linux servers, Kubernetes, and Docker, ensuring secure API traffic routing compliant with enterprise architecture standards. Design and configure database environments integrating MySQL, Microsoft SQL Server, and Apache Cassandra to support API transaction monitoring, storage, and seamless data exchange across enterprise systems. Deploy APIs across cloud, SaaS, and legacy systems while leading Axway platform upgrades to maintain latest updates, continuously improve client environments. Ensure operational excellence of API Management solutions through continuous optimization, stability verification, and interoperability testing, utilizing integrated Datadog and Splunk monitoring platforms for comprehensive API health observability. Architect AI workflow solutions using Amplify Fusion to scale AI initiatives and establish secure, compliant integrations between AI agents and business-critical applications. Provide formal training and informal mentorship to equip clients with technical knowledge to maximize Axway API Manager, API Gateway, Engage, and Amplify Fusion solutions. Deploy and manage Amplify Engage to federate API governance across multi-cloud environments, centralizing API catalogs, onboarding developer communities, and enforcing enterprise-wide compliance standards.

Telecommuting permitted. Reports to headquarters in Scottsdale, AZ.

Job Requirements: Requires a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology and Management, or related and 2 years of related experience. Must have some experience in each of the following skills: Operating system and application administration with Windows or Linux-based environments; Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) tools source control, build systems, issue tracking, and requirements management; Web API development in SOAP, XML, REST, JSON, and REST-based API testing; Database administration and management with Oracle, MSSQL, MySQL and Cassandra; Cloud and container-based technologies including AWS, Docker, and Kubernetes; Web communication technologies including HTTP/HTTPS, TLS/SSL, Public Key Infrastructure (PKI), and X509 standards; and Web application security and federated identity standards including SAML, WS-Fed, WS-Trust, OAuth, OpenID, and XACML.

EOE.

To apply, email resume to Candace Kappelman, referencing Req. # 315.

Job Purpose

The Role

This is not a typical enterprise software sales role.

We're seeking a commercially driven hunter with deep expertise in regulated industries, a strong professional network, and a proven ability to open doors, build executive relationships, and win new business.

You'll be responsible for developing your own pipeline, identifying high-potential target accounts, and leading complex enterprise sales opportunities from prospecting through to close.

Working closely with Marketing, Presales, Product, and Customer Success teams, you'll help shape TimeArc's growth strategy whilst delivering measurable revenue impact.

About TimeArc

TimeArc helps organizations manage, govern, and deliver complex, high-value content where accuracy, traceability, version control, and regulatory confidence are essential.

The solution serves specialized markets including audit and accounting, tax, and standards and regulatory organizations.

Job Overview

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute a new-logo sales strategy for TimeArc within assigned industries and territories.
  • Build and maintain a prioritized target-account plan based on industry knowledge, market relationships, and commercial potential.
  • Engage senior business, content, methodology, technology, compliance, and innovation leaders.

  • Develop compelling business cases that demonstrate the financial and operational value of TimeArc.
  • Manage the complete enterprise sales cycle, from account development and qualification through solution validation, commercial negotiation, and close.
  • Partner closely with BDRs, Marketing, Presales, Product, Customer Success, and executive sponsors.
  • Coordinate industry campaigns, events, webinars, partner activity, and account-based marketing programs.
  • Maintain accurate opportunity data, next steps, close dates, risks, and forecasts in Salesforce.
  • Use MEDDPICC or a comparable enterprise qualification framework to assess and advance opportunities.
  • Provide structured market feedback to Product and Marketing on buyer needs, competitive activity, messaging, and emerging use cases.
  • Develop trusted relationships that create opportunities for long-term customer growth.

Skills & Experience

  • Sales Background: Proven success selling enterprise technology, information solutions, or professional services into:

    • Audit & accounting firms

    • Tax advisory firms, corporate tax functions, or government tax authorities

    • Standards development & regulatory organizations

  • Industry Knowledge: Strong understanding of target buyers, operating models, terminology, priorities, and purchasing processes.

  • Networking & Targeting: An established professional network with the ability to identify credible target accounts and buyer personas.

  • Business Development: Success driving new business, generating opportunities, and managing complex, long enterprise sales cycles with multiple stakeholders.

  • Value-Based Selling: Experience developing business cases, engaging business/technical stakeholders, and translating technical features into business outcomes.

  • Core Sales Execution: Strong discovery, executive communication, negotiation, opportunity management, pipeline management, accurate forecasting, and consistent quota achievement.

  • Collaboration: Comfortable working within an international, cross-functional team environment.

Preferred Experience

  • Domain & Tech Exposure: Background in content tech, structured content, knowledge management, workflow, compliance, AI, or digital transformation.

  • Specialized Knowledge: Familiarity with audit trails, effective dates, point-in-time content, content governance, metadata, jurisdictional complexity, and explainable AI.

  • Sales Methodology & Tools: Experience using Salesforce, account-based selling, and MEDDPICC.

  • Key Relationships: Pre-existing relationships with senior decision-makers in the target industries.

What Success Looks Like

During the first six months, the successful candidate will:

  • Develop a focused territory and target-account plan.
  • Activate existing industry relationships and create new executive-level conversations.
  • Build qualified pipeline across the assigned TimeArc verticals.
  • Establish a clear point of view on the business problems TimeArc solves.
  • Work with Marketing and the BDR team to improve industry messaging and campaign performance.
  • Progress qualified opportunities through a disciplined and visible sales process.

Longer term, success will be measured by:

  • New-logo bookings
  • Qualified pipeline creation
  • Forecast accuracy
  • Strategic account penetration
  • Contribution to TimeArc’s growth strategy.

Content is becoming increasingly important to AI, regulatory compliance, customer experience, and enterprise decision-making. TimeArc provides organizations with the structure, governance, traceability, and control needed to use critical information confidently.

jobs.title: Contracts Specialist
jobs.excerpt: Transforming The Way Construction Owners Use Technology & Data Avicado is known for best-in-class service to our clients, and our contracts are the backbone of that delivery.
jobs.description:
Transforming The Way Construction Owners Use Technology & Data

Avicado is known for best-in-class service to our clients, and our contracts are the backbone of that delivery. Solid contracts set the terms, expectations, and guardrails that let our teams do great, uninterrupted work. As Avicado grows, the Contracts Specialist is one of the key support pillars that keeps that backbone strong. You keep our contracts reviewed, signed on terms we can stand behind, easy to find, and easy to understand, so Finance, our consultants, Sales, and leadership can do their work with confidence.

Core Responsibilities

Contract Review and Risk Screening

  • Act as the first-line reviewer for contracts, amendments, and RFPs from Sales and internal teams, including client, partner, vendor, and IT agreements.
  • Identify the terms that carry real risk, say what each could cost us, and recommend how to respond, including redlines within our standard positions.
  • Coordinate redlines and approvals between Sales and leadership, and elevate terms outside our standard positions, so every contract has a clear status and a clear next step.
  • Support internal teams with risk questions on software and IT agreements and client security questionnaires.
  • Own the insurance requirements in contracts: be the first stop for internal questions, coordinate the annual insurance renewal with our broker, and back up the Biz Ops Coordinator on certificate of insurance (COI) requests.

Contracts Database and Lifecycle

  • Build and maintain the central Contracts Database. A contract is not done until it is stored with its key dates, terms, and obligations.
  • Keep the data accurate and complete: check entries regularly, fix errors at the source, and document how entries are made so teammates can add to the database correctly.
  • Record renewal, notice, and termination terms when a contract is stored, so Sales, who own renewals, know the terms, the paper the contract is on, and whether anything new needs to be put in place.
  • Own the termination process: when Directors or Sales decide to end an agreement, review the contract if its terms are not already in the database, define how it gets terminated, and hold the team accountable for the steps.
  • Grow what the database captures over time so the team can answer questions about terms and obligations without reopening the contract, and so leadership can see risk in aggregate across all of our contracts.

Templates

  • Own our contract templates: decide what goes into them, get our Legal team's feedback, and update the templates once a change is approved.
  • Maintain the template change request process so every request gets a clear answer and the requester can see its status.
  • Keep one current version of each template in one place, and make sure out-of-date copies are not in use.
  • Work with Sales so they understand which terms carry little risk and can be adjusted, and which carry operational or business risk and should not change without review.
  • Identify template gaps and get them closed.

Ideal Background

Should have

  • Hands-on experience reviewing professional services agreements, such as MSAs, SOWs, and change orders, ideally in a consulting or implementation environment.
  • Working knowledge of common risk terms: indemnification, limitation of liability, SLAs, data and privacy, and insurance requirements.
  • Experience building or maintaining a contract repository or tracker and keeping it accurate over time, not only using one.
  • Experience carrying a template or process change through to adoption across teams that do not report to you.
  • A calculated view of risk: you size it, recommend a response, and let decision-makers weigh it against the value of the deal, rather than treating risk as something to avoid or forwarding every contract to counsel.
  • Experience working with an outside law firm or in-house counsel.
  • Comfort working in lower-tech setups (SharePoint, spreadsheets, Salesforce), not only e-signature platforms, and embracing new tools such as AI.

Preferred

  • Experience with public sector contracts and RFPs.
  • Experience with prime agreements and the terms that flow down from them, such as procurement codes and subcontracting commitments. Construction experience is a plus.
  • Experience with client security questionnaires.
  • Experience reviewing software, IT, and vendor agreements.
  • Experience with international contracts.

Characteristics of an ideal candidate 

  • Responsive; Avicado takes great pride in reacting quickly and positively to our clients and teammates, both internal and external 
  • Innovative; a desire to drive innovation through new and unique solutions while embracing creative ideas
  • Entrepreneurial; the drive to take initiative, deliver results, and create value for our clients
  • Empowered; bring solutions instead of problems
  • Performance Driven & Accountable; sets goals and challenges our high-performance culture
  • Even-tempered; handles pressure and thrives in a fast-paced environment
  • Coachable; recognizes strengths & weakness and open to guidance 

Why Avicado 

  • Competitive compensation 
  • Health insurance 
  • 401k with employer match
  • Flexible PTO
  • Remote work
  • Philanthropic Matching Gift Program  And more… 

About Avicado 

Avicado, LLP was established in 2015 with a focus on utilizing the latest cloud-based tools and applications to enhance our clients' experience. As a technology consultancy, we empower construction owners to make the most of their systems and data. Our team of experts collaborates with enterprise organizations such as data centers, universities, hospitals, and real estate developers to promote seamless interoperability across their teams and technologies. We are experiencing an exciting phase of expansion and actively searching for new talent to join our team.

We’re a close-knit team with a high-performance culture, but we don’t like to take ourselves too seriously.

Our diversity and inclusivity are a point of pride, and we have created a highly interactive remote work environment that encourages mutual respect and individuality while fostering opportunities for employees to excel both personally and professionally. We offer competitive benefits, remote work experiences, flexible work arrangements, various career development opportunities, employee resource groups, and more.

Avicado's unwavering dedication to creating a remarkable workplace experience has been widely acknowledged by experts in the industry. We are thrilled to have attained the highly coveted "Great Place to Work" certification and to have been included on Inc.'s esteemed Best Workplaces list for three consecutive years. Additionally, we are humbled to have received the AYA Award, which recognizes allies who promote equality and actively foster positive change for women in technology. At Avicado, we take great pride in fostering a culture that is both inclusive and supportive, especially for women in the technology industry.

These accolades are a testament to our ongoing efforts to foster a culture of inclusion, mutual respect, and professional growth for all members of our team.

If you are a self-motivated individual who wants to work with Fortune 500 clients in a rapidly growing company, we encourage you to join us!

jobs.description:
Selection process developed by matteria

Location and Work Mode

Remote role based in Mexico, with domestic and international travel as required.

Who we are

The Nature Conservancy (TNC) is a global environmental nonprofit dedicated to conserving the lands and waters on which all life depends. Founded in 1951, TNC combines science, collaboration, conservation, and innovative approaches to address some of the world's most complex environmental challenges. Its work brings together communities, governments, businesses, donors, scientists, and other partners to create lasting solutions for people and nature.

Our impact

Since its founding in 1951, The Nature Conservancy has grown to become one of the most effective and wide-reaching environmental organizations in the world. Some key accomplishments include:

  • 86 countries and territories where TNC has conservation impact.

  • 1,000+ scientists contributing to TNC's conservation work.

  • 100+ marine conservation projects around the world.

  • 125M+ acres of land protected through TNC's work.

Purpose of the Position

The Donor Relations Manager II will strengthen the execution of TNC's fundraising strategy in Latin America by supporting the teams and Relationship Managers responsible for donor relationships connected to TNC's work in Mexico, Belize, and Guatemala.

The role enables fundraising opportunities through strong coordination, project management, donor strategy support, and collaboration across TNC's regional and global teams.

Key Responsibilities

Donor Strategy and Fundraising Support

  • Support the identification, cultivation, solicitation, and stewardship of international prospects and donors connected to TNC's work in Latin America.

  • Support donor strategies by understanding donor interests, capacity, potential, and alignment with TNC's conservation priorities across the region, with specific focus on Belize, Guatemala, and Mexico.

  • Support opportunities involving donors with the capacity to contribute more than USD 100,000.

Relationship Manager and Stakeholder Coordination

  • Work closely with Relationship Managers, Business Units, Divisions, regional teams, and other internal stakeholders to advance international fundraising opportunities.

  • Serve as a bridge between international Relationship Managers and conservation teams, translating donor opportunities into the information, materials, expertise, and internal coordination required to move them forward.

  • Coordinate contributions from multiple stakeholders and ensure accountability for agreed deliverables.

Donor Engagement

  • Support donor meetings, donor trips, in-person events, leadership visits, and other engagement opportunities.

Proposals, Stewardship and Communications

  • Collaborate with Donor Communications to develop donor materials, including proposals, stewardship notes, reports, and correspondence.

  • Help ensure donor communications are accurate, relevant, timely, and connected to the donor's interests and TNC's impact.

Internal Processes and Project Management

  • Project manage the internal review processes required for solicitations and gifts at local, regional, and global levels.

  • Coordinate complex and collaborative fundraising projects involving multiple development professionals and internal teams.

  • Manage timelines, deliverables, dependencies, and follow-up across multiple stakeholders.

Data, Reporting and Pipeline Management

  • Maintain accurate donor information in TNC's donor database.

  • Generate reports and analyze donor information to support fundraising decisions.

  • Track donor opportunities and use information to support cultivation, stewardship, and pipeline development.

Compliance and Risk Management

  • Ensure compliance with TNC policies and procedures, as well as applicable donor, legal, and regulatory requirements.

  • Maintain confidentiality when handling sensitive donor and organizational information.

  • Support consistent, high-quality donor engagement while minimizing organizational risk.

Requirements and competences to work with us

Education

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.

  • Additional education, coursework, or training in fundraising, philanthropy, development, nonprofit management, business development, partnerships, or project management is desirable.

Experience

  • At least 3 years of relevant professional experience in fundraising, donor relations, development, philanthropy, business development, partnerships, or another relationship-oriented function.

  • Experience building and maintaining long-term relationships with donors, partners, clients, volunteers, or other relevant stakeholders.

  • Experience coordinating projects involving multiple stakeholders, teams, functions, or geographies.

  • Experience working in multicultural or cross-cultural environments.

  • Familiarity with Latin America and its cultural and professional context.

  • Based in Mexico.

Knowledge and Skills

  • Understanding of fundraising principles and donor engagement practices.

  • Strong project management and coordination capabilities.

  • Ability to organize multiple stakeholders, timelines, deliverables, and processes simultaneously.

  • Ability to understand stakeholder interests and connect them with organizational priorities.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

  • Ability to synthesize complex information and translate it into clear and actionable inputs.

  • Experience generating reports and analyzing and interpreting data.

  • Ability to work effectively across departments and multiple teams.

  • Experience with donor databases, CRM systems, reporting tools, or similar information-management platforms is desirable.

  • Fluency in English and Spanish.

Competencies

  • Relationship building: builds trust and productive relationships with diverse stakeholders, adapting communication to different levels of seniority, functions, cultures, and priorities.

  • Cross-functional collaboration: connects people and teams, understands different perspectives, and creates alignment around shared objectives without relying exclusively on formal authority.

  • Project management and execution: brings structure, accountability, and follow-through to complex processes involving multiple stakeholders, deadlines, and deliverables.

  • Strategic-operational thinking: understands the broader fundraising objective and translates it into practical actions, processes, materials, and next steps.

  • Autonomy and adaptability: navigates a complex, international, matrixed environment with initiative and sound judgment, moving work forward without constant supervision.

Our team profile

The ideal person enjoys connecting people, information, and opportunities. This is a team-oriented environment where success depends on working across functions and geographies, understanding different perspectives, and bringing people together around a shared objective. The team is looking for someone who:

  • Enjoys building meaningful professional relationships and networks.

  • Is genuinely interested in fundraising and philanthropy.

  • Is motivated by conservation and the possibility of contributing to TNC's mission.

  • Enjoys being the person who connects different teams and makes things happen.

Systems, tooling, and intake automation

jobs.description:
The Challenge

We connect over 500’000 callers in 190 countries: that represents 36,000 calling corridors and over 100 million calling minutes. We work with various global suppliers optimising for call quality. It’s complex. Each calling corridor has its own quality quirks and legal and regulatory rules to work within. We want someone to own call quality and routing holistically across all of it: routing daily to optimize what's happening right now, while watching the data for the long-term trends that tell us where to fix things next.

A failed call is not a metric to us. It's someone not hearing their mother's voice or its an important business call that fails. We also have real ambitions to scale calling well beyond where we are today, so this complexity isn't going anywhere. It's only going to grow.

Talk360 has been profitable since 2025, expanding beyond our core calling app into embedded, B2B2C calling for partners. We are lean, around 30 people globally, spread across the Netherlands, South Africa, Nigeria, Suriname, Turkey, Egypt, Kenya, Ukraine, and beyond. That means this role has real scope from day one: no layers between you and the decisions that matter, and no shortage of things worth tackling.

What You'll Do

  • Own call quality holistically: hold the full picture of call quality end to end, working with the team on both the daily grind and the long-term view, moving fluidly between quick fixes and structured experiments.

  • Manage zones, codes, and origins: own and continuously refine our zone, dialing code, and call origin management, keeping the underlying structure clean and accurate across all 900 zones.

  • Update routing continuously: change routing several times a day, from immediate fixes to longer-running tests of new suppliers.

  • Work cross-functionally by design: partner daily with Ozcan, who owns supplier account management and deal creation, and Mahmoud, who runs hourly monitoring and support-team escalations to suppliers. Work with Ewan on automating the processes behind routing, and with Product and CRM to improve the experience for our end users.

  • Move routing toward automation: work toward (semi) automated routing and pricing, reducing how much of this still runs on manual, single-person work.

Requirements

What You'll Bring

  • Hands-on experience with international A-Z calling and telco routing: zones, codes, LCR, and SIP response codes, built at a telco, carrier, or comms platform with real cross-border calling experience.

  • NOC or technical support background: comfortable troubleshooting live voice traffic and reading call detail records and quality metrics like ASR and ACD.

  • Exposure to a routing/testing platform such as iTest or an equivalent tool. Familiarity with Digitalk Cloud Carrier (DCC), our current routing platform, is a plus.

  • Nice to have: working technical literacy in SIP signalling and SBC concepts

Who You Are

  • Process driven and meticulous: you build the audit trail as you go, not after something goes wrong. You are methodical and analytical by nature, and you would rather have a clean, repeatable process than a clever one-off fix.

  • Hands-on: you do the routing work yourself, day to day, not just direct others to do it.

  • A strong communicator: equally at ease explaining a routing issue to Product or Marketing as debating a fix with a supplier's NOC team.

  • Ownership without a script: you see a bottleneck and you fix it rather than wait to be asked.

  • Genuinely commercial: you understand a dropped call or a bad route costs Talk360 real money and a real user's trust, not just an SLA breach.

Recruitment Process

  1. Recruiter screening

  2. Hiring manager screening with COO

  3. Technical interview

  4. Case study

  5. Final interview. with CEO

What you get

Learning and growth

  • €1,500 annual personal development budget, plus access to company-wide training sessions to keep learning and evolving.

Time to recharge

  • 25 vacation days

  • Option to swap two public holidays per year for days that better reflect your culture or beliefs

  • Recharge Fridays, unlocked when team targets are met (we'll tell you more during the interview)

Work from anywhere

  • As a global and diverse team, we encourage you to work from another city or country for up to 2 weeks per year, gain fresh perspectives and spark new ideas.

A team you'll actually want to be part of

  • Weekly team lunch every Thursday

  • Regular team moments and outings

  • An international and diverse team, with colleagues from the Netherlands, South Africa, Nigeria, Suriname, Turkey, Egypt, Kenya, Ukraine and beyond

Set up for success

  • Company laptop and all the tools you need to do your best work

  • Monthly phone allowance and commuting allowance

An environment to grow and make impact

  • A collaborative environment where you can learn from others, take ownership, and contribute to a meaningful mission

About Talk360

Talk360 was founded with a clear purpose: to become the most accessible and reliable calling app for African diaspora communities, both within Africa and abroad. For our users, calls are not transactional, they are emotional lifelines to family, friends, and essential support networks. When service quality drops, they feel it immediately. That responsibility drives everything we build.

Over the past years, Talk360 has grown into a global communications platform connecting more than 6 million people worldwide last year. We successfully spun off our payments arm into NjiaPay, stepped into the gap left by the discontinuation of Skype, and achieved profitable growth from 2025 onwards, marking our transition from early-stage scale-up to a disciplined, sustainable business.

As we continue to grow, we are expanding beyond our own B2C app. We are now launching our first embedded calling products within partner platforms, bringing Talk360’s technology into new ecosystems and enabling partners to offer international calling directly within their own products.

Our ambition is bold: to become the world’s most trusted way to call any real phone number — connecting migrants, travellers, professionals, and businesses across the globe.

Here’s what our users say:

“I like Talk360 because it saves me a lot of money. I used to call from Zimbabwe for 15 rands a minute. Talk360 came to the rescue. Now I can call my mother for hours.” — Google Play, South Africa ★★★★★

jobs.title: Director of Reliability Assessments and Performance Analysis
jobs.excerpt: Our CompanyThe North American Electric Reliability Corporation (NERC) is a not-for-profit international regulatory authority whose mission is to assure the effective and efficient reduction of risks to the reliability and security of the grid.
jobs.description:
Our Company

The North American Electric Reliability Corporation (NERC) is a not-for-profit international regulatory authority whose mission is to assure the effective and efficient reduction of risks to the reliability and security of the grid. NERC develops and enforces Reliability Standards; annually assesses seasonal and long‐term reliability; monitors the bulk power system through system awareness; and educates, trains, and certifies industry personnel. NERC’s area of responsibility spans the continental United States, Canada, and the northern portion of Baja California, Mexico. NERC is the Electric Reliability Organization (ERO) for North America, subject to oversight by the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) and provincial authorities in Canada. NERC’s jurisdiction includes users, owners, and operators of the bulk power system, which serves nearly 400 million people.

Our Mission

The vision for the ERO Enterprise, which is comprised of NERC and the six Regional Entities, is a highly reliable and secure North American bulk power system. Our mission is to assure the effective and efficient reduction of risks to the reliability and security of the grid.

Your Impact

The Director of Reliability Assessments and Performance (RAPA) leads NERC’s independent assessment of reliability, adequacy, and performance of interconnected North American bulk power system. The Director provides strategic and technical leadership across three functional areas: Reliability Assessments, Performance Analysis, and Data & Analytics Integration. The position is responsible for identifying emerging and quantifying reliability risks; developing forward-looking assessments of resource and energy adequacy and their impacts on reliability; evaluating historical system performance and reliability trends; and developing the data, analytical tools, platforms, and governance necessary to support NERC's reliability and security mission.

The Director leads multidisciplinary teams of engineers, analysts, data scientists, and technology professionals. The Director also works across the ERO Enterprise to advance consistent, technically rigorous, and increasingly sophisticated approaches to reliability assessment and performance analysis. The position is responsible for major NERC reliability publications and analytical products and serves as a senior technical representative of NERC before the Board of Trustees, FERC, DOE, state and provincial policymakers, industry executives, stakeholder organizations, and the media.

This position reports to the Senior Vice President of Strategy and External Engagement.

Your Role

  • Provide strategic leadership for NERC's Reliability Assessment, Performance Analysis, and Data & Analytics Integration functions, establishing priorities, analytical direction, and multi-year strategies aligned with NERC and ERO Enterprise long-term strategies.
  • Lead NERC's independent assessment of current and future bulk power system reliability including resource adequacy, energy adequacy, transmission capability, demand and load growth, resource transformation, fuel availability, emerging technologies, and other evolving reliability risks.
  • Direct development of NERC's major reliability assessments and performance publications including seasonal and long-term reliability assessments, the State of Reliability, special assessments, technical reports, and other products requested by NERC executive leadership or the Board of Trustees.
  • Advance the methodologies used to evaluate reliability risk including probabilistic and scenario-based approaches that better characterize energy limitations, extreme conditions, resource performance, uncertainty, and tail-risk events rather than relying solely on traditional deterministic planning measures.
  • Lead analysis of historical bulk power system performance to identify trends, emerging risks, reliability gaps, and opportunities for industry action using NERC reliability data and other authoritative data sources.
  • Establish an integrated analytical framework connecting forward-looking reliability assessments with observed system performance allowing historical performance, operating experience, and emerging trends to inform NERC's assessment of future reliability risk.
  • Provide executive-level interpretation of changing industry conditions including rapid demand growth, resource mix transformation, inverter-based resources, distributed resources, energy storage, large loads, generator and transmission performance, fuel infrastructure dependencies, and other emerging reliability issues.
  • Lead a foundational data team focused on data strategy and analytics, including development and maintenance of analytical platforms, tools, applications, dashboards, data pipelines, and shared analytical capabilities supporting reliability assessments, performance analysis, and broader NERC reliability activities.
  • Guide development of analytical capabilities including statistical analysis, probabilistic modeling, visualization, automation, advanced analytics, and appropriate application of technologies to improve the efficiency, reproducibility, and credibility of NERC's reliability analysis.
  • Establish and oversee data governance practices that promote authoritative data sources, consistent definitions, data quality, appropriate access, documentation, stewardship, and effective use of reliability information across NERC.
  • Oversee major reliability data programs and data collections including development of data requests, coordination with Regional Entities and industry, quality assurance, and evolution of data structures necessary to address emerging reliability risks.
  • Develop and maintain strong partnerships across the ERO Enterprise coordinating analytical approaches, data requirements, assessment methodologies, and reliability findings with Regional Entities while preserving NERC's independent assessment responsibilities.
  • Evaluate the reliability implications of significant industry developments including changing electricity market practices, regulatory and public-policy requirements, environmental regulations, technological changes, resource retirements and additions, infrastructure constraints, and evolving planning practices.
  • Provide technical and policy-relevant reliability insights to NERC executive leadership and the Board of Trustees including recommendations regarding emerging risks, analytical priorities, industry actions, and areas requiring additional assessment.
  • Represent NERC before FERC, DOE, EIA, state and provincial regulators, RTOs/ISOs, utilities, trade organizations, research institutions, and other reliability stakeholders providing technical briefings, testimony, presentations, and subject-matter expertise.
  • Serve as a senior NERC spokesperson on reliability assessments, system performance, and emerging reliability risks, providing technical background and briefings to media and other external audiences.
  • Recruit, develop, and retain high-performing engineering, analytical, data science, and technology professionals while developing future technical and organizational leaders.
  • Establish rigorous quality-control, documentation, and review processes to ensure NERC analytical products are technically defensible, reproducible, transparent, and consistent with NERC's role as the independent Electric Reliability Organization.
  • Collaborate across NERC departments including Reliability Standards, Compliance Monitoring and Enforcement, Security, Legal and Regulatory, Information Technology, and external affairs to ensure analytical findings appropriately inform broader organizational priorities.

Qualifications

The successful candidate will have at a minimum:

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering or an advanced degree in a technical field (engineering, computer science, data science, applied mathematics, or another relevant technical discipline)
  • At least 10 years of experience in bulk power system planning and/or operations within the electric utility industry. Experience leading engineering team would be preferable.
  • Deep understanding of bulk power system reliability, including resource adequacy, energy adequacy, transmission planning, generation performance, system operations, and the changing reliability characteristics of the North American resource mix.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead complex, high-visibility technical assessments involving uncertainty, incomplete information, competing stakeholder perspectives, and emerging reliability risks.
  • Strong understanding of modern analytical methods, including statistical analysis, probabilistic methods, data visualization, large-scale data analysis, and analytical tool/platform development.
  • Demonstrated understanding of data governance, data quality, stewardship, analytical reproducibility, and lifecycle management of critical data and analytical products.

jobs.title: Remote data analyst
jobs.excerpt: What is data analyst ?  A data analyst is a professional who collects, cleans, and analyzes data to answer questions or solve problems.
jobs.description:
What is data analyst ?

A data analyst is a professional who collects, cleans, and analyzes data to answer questions or solve problems. They work in many industries, including business, finance, science, medicine, and government

To excel as a remote data analyst, professionals must possess a combination of technical skills, soft skills, and industry-specific expertise. These essential skills enable analysts to effectively work with data, collaborate with remote teams, and provide valuable insights that drive business growth.

Skills;

Analytical and problem-solving skills

Knowledge of statistics and mathematics

Experience with spreadsheets

Experience with statistical languages

Experience with scripting languages

Knowledge of database management systems

Data visualization skills

Data Analyst Job Description: Key Responsibilities

Remote data analysts play a crucial role in driving business growth and decision-making by transforming raw data into actionable insights. Their key responsibilities include:

Collecting and interpreting data from various sources: Data analysts are responsible for gathering data from multiple sources, such as databases, APIs, and spreadsheets. They then interpret this data, identifying patterns and trends that can provide valuable insights for the business.

Analyzing data to identify trends and patterns: Once the data has been collected and interpreted, data analysts use various statistical methods and tools to analyze it. By identifying trends and patterns, they can provide insights that help businesses make data-driven decisions.

Creating reports and visualizations to present findings: Data analysts use data visualization tools like Tableau and Power BI to create clear and engaging reports that effectively communicate their findings to stakeholders. These visualizations help businesses understand complex data and make informed decisions.

Collaborating with cross-functional teams to support business objectives: Data analysts work closely with various teams within the organization, such as marketing, sales, and product development. By collaborating with these teams, they can provide data-driven insights that help support the company's overall business objectives.

Ensuring data accuracy and compliance with relevant regulations: Data analysts must ensure that the data they collect and analyze is accurate and reliable. They must also comply with any relevant regulations, such as data privacy laws, to protect the organization from potential legal issues.

Technical Skills

Data manipulation and analysis tools: Proficiency in tools like Excel, SQL, Python, and R is crucial for data analysts to efficiently collect, clean, and analyze data from various sources.

Data visualization tools: Mastery of visualization tools such as Tableau and Power BI helps analysts create impactful visual representations of their findings, making it easier for stakeholders to understand complex data.

Knowledge of statistical methods and machine learning algorithms: A deep understanding of statistical methods and machine learning algorithms allows data analysts to identify trends and patterns, providing valuable insights for decision-making.

Soft Skills

Effective communication and collaboration: Remote data analysts must be able to clearly and concisely communicate their findings and collaborate with cross-functional teams to support business objectives.

Attention to detail and problem-solving abilities: A keen eye for detail and strong problem-solving skills are essential for identifying data anomalies and ensuring data accuracy.

Time management and organization: Remote work requires excellent time management and organizational skills to stay on track and meet deadlines.

Adaptability and self-learning capabilities: As technology and industry trends evolve, remote data analysts must be adaptable and committed to continuous learning to stay ahead of the curve.

jobs.excerpt: This is a remote position. Sustainability is changing fast, and the work required to make it real inside large organisations has become more demanding, more specific, and more deeply embedded in business operations.
jobs.description:
This is a remote position.

Sustainability is changing fast, and the work required to make it real inside large organisations has become more demanding, more specific, and more deeply embedded in business operations. As a result, Nordic Sustainability is building a pool of freelance experts and specialist collaborators we can draw on when client projects require a particular depth of knowledge we want to bring in.

This is not a call for generalists. It's a call for people who know their area well, whether that's a technical sustainability discipline, a business function, or a sector, and who understand how large organisations actually work from the inside.

This call isopen until31 August 2026and applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis. We're looking for individuals operating as freelancers (or willing to set up a freelance structure) and specialist companies of 2 to 5 people interested in a closer collaboration.

What we're looking for

Sustainability specialists
We're particularly interested in deep technical knowledge across:
  • Climate transition planning and corporate climate strategy
  • Climate risk assessment (physical and transition risk)
  • Biodiversity and nature-related impacts and dependencies
  • Chemicals management and product-related environmental compliance
  • Circularity, waste, and materials strategy
  • Supply chain due diligence and human rights (aligned with CSDDD, OECD Guidelines, and UNGPs)
  • Carbon accounting, Scope 3 methodology, and GHG inventory design

Corporate function specialists
We're equally interested in people who have worked inside large companies in functions where sustainability now sits — even if sustainability has not been their primary focus. Understanding how commercial decisions are made, how procurement works, or how products are developed is exactly the kind of knowledge that makes sustainability advice land.

Relevant backgrounds include:

  • Commercial strategy, finance, or business development

•Product design, innovation, and R&D

  • Procurement, sourcing, and supply chain management

•Risk management and legal

•Operations and manufacturing

An understanding of sustainability is a bonus. A thorough understanding of how the business function actually operates is the baseline requirement.

Sectoral expertise
Sector knowledge helps us deploy the right person at the right moment. The following sectors are particularly relevant to our current and anticipated client base:
  • Manufacturing and industrial production
  • Pharmaceuticals, chemicals, and life sciences

•Energy and utilities

•Financial services and investment

•Retail and consumer goods

What collaboration with Nordic Sustainability looks like
We work with large multinationals on complex, high-stakes sustainability challenges. Projects typically sit at the intersection of regulatory requirements, commercial strategy, and operational change. Freelance collaborators are brought in to add specific expertise — you'll work alongside our core team, not independently.

This is project-based engagement. There is no guarantee of ongoing volume, but our intent is to build relationships that work over time for the right people.

Important: this call is for freelance or independent collaboration only — it is not a route into permanent employment at Nordic Sustainability. Applicants must either already operate as a freelancer or be willing to set up a freelance structure.

For small companies

Companies of between 2 and 5 people with a strong specialism that would complement Nordic Sustainability's work are also welcome to register interest in closer collaboration. This is a different conversation, not the freelancer pool described above, and should be directed to:

How to apply

To be considered for the freelance pool, please submit the following:

1.Your CV (maximum 2 pages)

2.A short letter of motivation (maximum half a page) — tell us briefly what you do, why it's relevant to the work Nordic Sustainability does, and how you prefer to work

3.Completed questionnaire (following on the next pages)

​
We will review all applications on a rolling basis and reach out to those whose profiles are a strong match for our pipeline.

Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

Do you have a passion for engaging with people and helping them on their journey to better health? Signify Health, part of CVS Health®, is seeking a Full Time Physician to provide In-Home Health Evaluations, engaging with people in the comfort of their own homes and helping bridge gaps in care.

You’ll play a critical role in building trusted relationships to make people healthier, helping bring flexible, comprehensive and personalized health evaluations right to people’s front doors.

Job highlights

The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). You’ll use an iPad and an intuitive clinical workflow for each evaluation and are not required to prescribe medicine, order lab tests or alter people’s current treatment regimen.

In this role, you will:

  • Bring your heart into every visit, joining a national network of purpose-driven clinicians dedicated to improving health outcomes

  • Be part of our efforts to visit millions of people nationwide with the goal of providing connections to the right care for people’s unique needs

  • Work with Signify Health as a clinician colleague, fulfilling the requirements of the specified role

  • Conduct virtual visits as needed

  • Provide all Signify Health services as indicated including Diagnostic & Preventive Services products (i.e., spirometry, DEE, bone density screening, etc.)

A Note on Our Work Environment:

As an in-home clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of health plan members. We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants.

Why Clinicians Enjoy Working with Signify Health
“Many of the people I see are shocked that a physician is coming to their home to visit with them one-on-one. When you sit down and have an unhurried conversation about their health, they are impressed, happy, and understand that their health plan and care team cares about them.” - M.L., MD

The primary care physician gets a snapshot of a person in an office setting, but with Signify Health, we see things like the number of steps to enter their home, the state of disrepair those steps may be in, and the person’s ability to function comfortably and with ease in their own home. We can make referrals to the individual’s health plan, encourage the participation of their loved ones, and ensure their PCPs are aware of their health and overall quality of life.” - C.H., MD

jobs.title: Principal Architect, System Software - Orbital Data Center
jobs.excerpt: Space-1 is NVIDIA's first Orbital Data Center (ODC) module — a Vera Rubin–class compute platform engineered for low-Earth orbit mission.
jobs.description:
Space-1 is NVIDIA's first Orbital Data Center (ODC) module — a Vera Rubin–class compute platform engineered for low-Earth orbit mission. It is the first step in a multi-generation orbital roadmap to speed up AI adoption. We are looking for a strong technical architect to own end-to-end system software architecture for Space-1 and successor orbital platforms. You will architect the full stack — application to libraries, from data center stack to BMC and BIOS firmware, manageability, and telemetry through the host OS, GPU and CPU drivers, and CUDA — to deliver a production-ready inference platform that operates reliably in the radiation, thermal-cycling, and remote-operations environment of LEO. You will partner closely with the orbital hardware system architecture team, drive customer use cases with constellation operators, align architecture with mission requirements, and bring the best orbital AI products to market. Join us at the forefront of technological advancement.

What you'll be doing:

  • Own system architecture for inference stack and other applications running on this class of products and make it resilient to any fault happening in space.

  • Co-architect with the orbital hardware system architecture team to define interfaces, partitioning, and trade-offs across silicon, board, firmware, OS, and AI workload layers for 5-year LEO missions.

  • Own end-to-end system software architecture for Space-1 and successor Orbital Data Center modules — covering data center stack, BMC firmware, BIOS, host OS, GPU/CPU drivers, CUDA, DCGM, and manageability telemetry as a single integrated stack.

  • Define the manageability architecture for an unreachable, autonomous data center: remote bring-up, in-orbit firmware update, dual-module redundancy, fault containment, recovery from SEU/SEFI events, and telemetry for fleets ranging from tens to millions of nodes.

  • Architect rad-tolerant system software behaviors — ECC handling, memory scrubbing, latch-up mitigation, deterministic recovery, and graceful degradation through 5 years and up to ~8,000 thermal cycles in dawn–dusk sun-synchronous orbit.

  • Drive Redfish, MCTP, PLDM, and constellation-level management protocols across BMC, BIOS, and host software so customers can operate orbital fleets with the same tools they use on the ground.

  • Define minimum BMC feature set, pin budget, boot architecture (rugged M.2 / VPX-class options), and dual-module redundancy strategy in partnership with platform and mechanical engineering.

  • Partner with cloud and constellation customers (SpaceX, Blue Origin, Starcloud, Planet, Cowboy Space, and others) to translate mission requirements — orbit, duty cycle, NSA PHIPs security, post-quantum networking (CX9), inference SLAs — into actionable platform software architecture.

  • Drive reliability and optimization in the system software architecture from an orbital data center viewpoint, including correct operation through eclipse periods and idle-power retention strategies.

  • Work closely with the bring-up team and resolve issues at Speed of Light from first silicon through first launch.Own quality, reliability, and telemetry performance of the system software delivered with each ODC module shipped to customers.

What we need to see:

  • 15+ years of relevant experience in server/platform system software — spanning compute libraries, BMC firmware, BIOS, host OS, drivers, and manageability

  • BS, MS, or PhD in EE/CS or related field of education (or equivalent experience).

  • Working experience in building AI infrastructure and systems in space. Proven record of architecting and delivering platform software for large-scale data centers or mission-critical embedded systems.

  • Strong knowledge of server architecture, data center manageability, and full-stack integration of firmware with OS and accelerator software. Hands-on experience with data center health management workflows, telemetry, and fault management at scale.

  • Solid understanding of hardware management interfaces (USB, SMBus/I2C, PCIe) and proficiency with modern management protocols including Redfish, MCTP, and PLDM.

  • Strong and demonstrable skill in C/C++ and Python.

  • Experience programming and debugging server platforms, including pre-silicon and platform bring-up environments.

  • Experience in SCM (e.g. Git, Perforce) and project management tools like Jira.

  • Excellent written and oral communication skills, good work ethics, high sense of team-work, love to produce quality work, and commitment to finish your tasks every single day.

  • You are a self-starter who loves to find creative solutions to complicated problems and hands on with coding.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • Experience architecting platform software for space, aerospace, defense, or other radiation, thermal, and vibration-constrained environments — including SEU/SEFI mitigation, ECC strategy, TID/SEE qualification, and rad-hard design partitioning. Being a part of a start up or initiative directly related to space data centers.

  • Hands-on experience with autonomous, remote, or unreachable data center operations — in-orbit or in-field firmware update, dual-module redundancy, and recovery without physical access. Hands-on with x86 or ARM (Grace/Vera) system architecture and the NVIDIA AI software stack (CUDA, DCGM, DOCA/OFED, GPU drivers, DGX OS).

  • Familiarity with NSA PHIPs security, post-quantum networking, and aerospace standards (VPX, MIL-STD shock/vibe, NASA EEE-INST-002).

  • Proven technical leadership driving large complex programs with 50+ engineers across firmware, OS, driver, and AI stack teams.

  • Skilled in reviewing hardware schematics and PCB layouts for debugging, design verification, and collaboration with hardware engineers.

NVIDIA's invention of the GPU in 1999 sparked the growth of the PC gaming market, redefined modern computer graphics, and revolutionized parallel computing. More recently, GPU deep learning ignited modern deep learning — the next era of computing — with the GPU acting as the brain of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can perceive and understand the world. Today, we are increasingly known as “the AI computing company.” We're looking to grow our company and establish teams with the most thoughtful people in the world. NVIDIA is leading the way in groundbreaking developments in Artificial Intelligence, High-Performance Computing, and Visualization. Our invention serves as the visual cortex of modern computers and is at the heart of our products and services. Our work opens up new universes to explore, enables amazing creativity and discovery, and powers what were once science fiction inventions from artificial intelligence to autonomous cars. NVIDIA is seeking exceptional individuals like you to help us drive the next wave of artificial intelligence.

jobs.description:
Overview

The Senior Auditor Contract Compliance (Construction) performs contract compliance and cost control audits on construction and capital projects, with a focus on distribution center, data center, corporate office, and retail construction, remodel, and build-out programs. This role applies working knowledge of construction audit practices, including AIA billing formats, job-cost reconciliation, GMP and CMAR contract structures, subcontract reviews, insurance cost validation, and lease and developer cost audits.

The Senior Auditor executes audit testing independently, quality-checks and mentors other auditors on assigned engagements, and communicates findings clearly to clients and suppliers. This is a US-based remote role with periodic travel to construction project sites as needed (up to 20%).

Responsibilities

Contract Compliance and Cost Control

  • Perform detailed contract compliance audits to assess alignment with AIA billing standards, GMP/CMAR contract terms, unit-price schedules, cost-plus arrangements, and negotiated allowances.
  • Validate that billed costs —general conditions, general requirements, subcontractor, developer, and landlord — comply with contract requirements and industry norms.
  • Identify cost recoveries, billing errors, non-allowable charges, and process improvement opportunities

Construction Technical Proficiency

  • Apply working knowledge of AIA billing formats (G702, G703, continuation sheets) to identify anomalies or unsupported values.
  • Support insurance auditing on construction projects, including reviewing policy documents (GL, Builders Risk, OCIP/CCIP, Workers' Compensation) and validating contractually allowable insurance costs.
  • Perform subcontract audits, including T&M validations, change order support, negotiated buyouts, and back-charge review.
  • Conduct job cost reconciliations, matching committed costs, actuals, payments, and cost-to-complete details.
  • Support developer and landlord cost verification, including audits of land acquisition, soft costs, carrying costs (interest, equity), lease costs, tenant improvement allowances, and pass-through expenditures.
  • Conduct monthly pay application reviews, including verification of percent complete, stored materials, retainage, and subcontractor flow-down compliance.
  • Support construction procurement and bid analysis, including bid leveling, identifying scope gaps, and alternate pricing.
  • Claim settlement support experience — including work related to disputed amounts between owners, contractors, subcontractors, or developers — is a plus.
  • Legal preparation support experience is a plus, including working with counsel on arbitration, litigation, or expert-witness documentation.

Procurement and Supply Chain

  • Audit material purchases and subcontractor billings for compliance with procurement requirements and pricing terms.
  • Assess buyout savings, material escalations, equipment rentals, and service procurements; flag opportunities to strengthen procurement controls and reduce cost leakage.

Communication and Reporting

  • Communicate audit results clearly and concisely, in both written and verbal form, to internal, client, and supplier personnel.
  • Help draft and issue audit reports summarizing completed audit activities, findings, and recoveries.
  • Present and support audit claims in a manner that is clear, concise, and persuasive.
  • Manage conflict and maintain professionalism with clients, contractors, and suppliers at all times, including when other parties are not.

Project Management, QC, and Team Support

  • Work independently, balancing priorities across multiple audit engagements and ensuring each project moves toward timely completion.
  • Maintain production goals and strong project management skills, advancing a group of audits forward each day.
  • Delegate, train, and quality-check audit work performed by other auditors; participate in and lead team knowledge sharing on contract interpretation, audit techniques, and cost-control practices.
  • Exhibit personal initiative in learning new analytic tools and construction audit techniques; accept and provide constructive feedback in a collaborative team environment.

Quality Assurance

  • Implement self-check and peer review practices to eliminate calculation errors and maintain high-quality, consistent work product.
  • Ensure detailed documentation and proper use of Cotiviti tools and construction audit software.

Governance and Compliance

  • Ensure compliance with Cotiviti policies, confidentiality requirements, data security standards, and relevant industry standards, including those promoted by the National Association of Construction Auditors (NACA).

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, Engineering, Construction Management and/or Business Administration or related field required
  • Certified Construction Auditor (CCA) preferred. CFE, PE, CCM, or PMP are pluses
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in construction auditing, construction project management or project engineering
  • Experience auditing AIA-format billings, GMP and CMAR contracts, job-cost structures, tenant improvement projects, data centers, distribution centers, or large capital portfolios preferred.
  • Experience reviewing insurance costs, subcontracts, cost-plus agreements, change orders, or developer/landlord cost submissions preferred.
  • Experience conducting completed project audits and monthly pay application reviews
  • Exposure to bidding processes and bid leveling, and how bids translate into contract risk and audit focus areas, is a plus.
  • Experience supporting claim negotiation or legal counsel in disputes or arbitration preparation is a plus.
  • Strong project management skills required
  • May require travel up to 20%

Mental Requirements:

  • Communicating with others to exchange information.
  • Assessing the accuracy, neatness, and thoroughness of the work assigned.

Physical Requirements and Working Conditions:

  • Ability to sit or stand for extended periods and repeat hand motions in computer-based work.
  • No adverse environmental conditions expected in the primary work location.
  • Ability to visit active job sites safely, including adherence to site-specific safety and PPE requirements.
  • Must be able to provide a dedicated, secure work area.
  • Must be able to provide high-speed internet access/connectivity and office setup and maintenance.

Base compensation ranges from $85,000 to $100,000. Specific offers are determined by various factors, such as experience, education, skills, certifications, and other business needs. This role is eligible for discretionary bonus consideration.

Cotiviti offers team members a competitive benefits package to address a wide range of personal and family needs, including medical, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance coverage, 401(k) savings plans, paid family leave, 9 paid holidays per year, and 17-27 days of Paid Time Off (PTO) per year, depending on specific level and length of service with Cotiviti.

For information about our benefits package, please refer to our Careers page.

jobs.description:
Job Title: Network Engineer

Reports to: Manager of Cloud Operations

Job Summary

The Infrastructure Services team provides systems engineering and operational support for network-based server and software. The Network Engineer designs, manages, and administers networks and systems, including servers (physical and virtual). Responsibilities include assessment, design, implementation, configuration, documentation, coordination, control, maintenance, troubleshooting, security, usage monitoring, and the development of specialized procedures for systems. This role is also responsible for capacity planning, tuning, system monitoring, system performance, and problem resolution across all aspects of the infrastructure.

Duties and Responsibilities

  • Install, configure, maintain, and manage network devices (including firewalls, switches, wireless), servers, and their associated operating systems.
  • Evaluate and recommend procurement of network devices, servers, peripheral equipment, and systems monitoring/alerting software.
  • Investigate problems, identify their source, determine possible solutions, test, and implement solutions.
  • Guide complex issues from identification to resolution across different departments, clients, employees, and systems.
  • Troubleshoot networks, systems, and applications to identify and correct malfunctions and other operational difficulties.
  • Investigate, recommend, and install enhancements and operating procedures that optimize network/system availability.
  • Document system problems and resolutions for future reference.
  • Participate in and contribute to the planning and execution of business continuity and disaster recovery capabilities.
  • Contribute meaningfully to organizational processes, teams, and products.
  • Adhere to organizational processes and procedures.
  • Work independently while also collaborating effectively as a team member.
  • Exhibit initiative and drive to complete tasks promptly, while adapting to change management processes with proper planning.
  • Communicate effectively with clients, internal teams, and leadership.
  • Demonstrate leadership qualities and take ownership of assigned responsibilities.
  • Complete special projects or other duties as assigned.
  • Availability for occasional off-hour, evening, weekend, and overtime work is required.
  • Participation in a cyclic on-call rotation and carrying an on-call phone is required.
  • Occasional travel to remote data centers within the United States is required.
  • Assist in the migration of on-premises systems to AWS.
  • Design and implement AWS architecture solutions that meet business requirements, including potential use of Infrastructure as Code.
  • Set up and manage monitoring, logging, and alerting solutions using AWS CloudWatch, AWS Config, and third-party tools.
  • Ensure cloud infrastructure complies with security standards and best practices.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to AWS infrastructure and applications.
  • Experience with the use of VMware ESXi, vCenter, and vSphere.
  • Palo Alto Firewall administration.
  • Experience with Cisco devices, including Nexus core switches and perimeter defense mechanisms. Cisco certification is a plus.
  • Knowledge of TCP/IP-based LANs, VLANs, iSCSI and Fiber Channel SANs, and VPNs.
  • Familiarity with current Red Hat/CentOS Linux operating systems is a plus.
  • Experience in systems monitoring and management in a high-availability data center environment.
  • Understanding of federal IT standards, guidelines, and programs such as NIST, DISA, and DIACAP/RMF.
  • Experience optimizing cloud resources for performance and cost efficiency.
  • Experience implementing AWS IAM policies and securing AWS environments is a plus.
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, and Ansible is a plus.
  • Experience with vulnerability management programs and patch management.
  • Ability to think and act independently to resolve complex systems issues.
  • Ability to provide technical and professional leadership, guidance, and training to others.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Minimum of 3 years of hands-on experience with designing, implementing, maintaining, scaling, and capacity management.
  • Bachelors degree from an accredited college or university in a related field or equivalent work experience.
  • Two or more industry-standard job-related certifications are preferred.
  • Ability to stand and sit for extended periods of time.
  • Ability to lift up to 10 lbs.

  • Manage database schemas, migrations, query performance, backups, and recovery procedures.
  • Administer Linux servers, including application services, permissions, updates, networking, and troubleshooting.
  • Build and maintain Docker environments, including container networking, persistent storage, configuration, and health checks.
  • Manage DNS records, domain routing, TLS certificates, and reverse proxies.
  • Maintain CI/CD workflows using GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps Pipelines, and appropriate build agents or runners.
  • Carry out deployments with migration checks, rollback procedures, and post-deployment verification.
  • Investigate production incidents and address their underlying causes.
  • Coordinate outsourced developers and specialists, clarify requirements, review deliverables, and manage technical dependencies.
  • Mentor developers through code reviews, practical demonstrations, and constructive feedback.
  • Keep implementation proportionate to the problem, controlling unnecessary complexity, infrastructure costs, and maintenance overhead.

Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated senior-level experience delivering and maintaining production web applications.
  • Strong frontend development skills using a modern framework, JavaScript or TypeScript, HTML, and CSS.
  • Strong backend development experience, including secure APIs, integrations, validation, and error handling.
  • Practical experience integrating AI or LLM capabilities into software, including checking output quality, handling failures, and managing latency and usage costs.
  • Substantial hands-on experience with AI coding assistants or agentic development workflows, with examples of working results you independently verified.
  • Strong SQL and relational database experience, including migrations, indexing, performance analysis, and backup and recovery.
  • Hands-on Linux administration and Docker deployment experience.
  • A working understanding of DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, TLS, firewalls, ports, and reverse proxies.
  • Practical CI/CD experience with GitHub Actions and familiarity with Azure DevOps repositories, pipelines, and build agents.
  • Strong Git, pull-request, code-review, and release-management skills.
  • Previous experience leading a development team or coordinating technical delivery.
  • Proven mentoring experience and the ability to explain technical decisions clearly.
  • Experience working with outsourced developers, contractors, or distributed teams.

  • Interest in a long-term, full-time role with increasing responsibility.

Especially Valuable Experience

  • Building products or engineering processes in an early-stage startup.
  • Taking responsibility for several applications or services at the same time.
  • Evaluating outsourced work for correctness, security, maintainability, and operational readiness.
  • Developing AI agents, tool integrations, retrieval workflows, or reliable automation.
  • Operating PostgreSQL and multi-service Docker environments.
  • Establishing deployment standards, monitoring, incident procedures, and practical documentation.
  • Helping junior developers become more effective through structured mentoring.

Initial compensation will reflect our startup budget, your experience, and the agreed scope of responsibility. As your contribution and responsibilities grow alongside the business, we aim to provide substantial salary progression during the first few years.

Progression will depend on demonstrated results, leadership capability, company growth, and financial capacity. Compensation expectations and progression milestones will be discussed openly during recruitment.

Job Title: In-Home Nurse Practitioner or Physician Assistant Per Diem - Des Moines

Job Location: Work at Home, Iowa, United States

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Part time

Job Seniority Level:

We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

Do you have a passion for engaging with people and helping them on their journey to better health? Signify Health, part of CVS Health®, is seeking a Per Diem Clinician (Nurse Practitioner or Physician Assistant) to provide In-Home Health Evaluations, engaging with people in the comfort of their own homes and helping bridge gaps in care.

You’ll play a critical role in building trusted relationships to make people healthier, helping bring flexible, comprehensive and personalized health evaluations right to people’s front doors.

Job highlights

The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). You’ll use an iPad and an intuitive clinical workflow for each evaluation and are not required to prescribe medicine, order lab tests or alter people’s current treatment regimen.

In this role, you will:

  • Bring your heart into every visit, joining a national network of purpose-driven clinicians dedicated to improving health outcomes

  • Be part of our efforts to visit millions of people nationwide with the goal of providing connections to the right care for people’s unique needs

  • Work with Signify Health as a clinician colleague, fulfilling the requirements of the specified role

  • Be flexible to travel locally and within licensed states, as needed

  • Conduct virtual visits as needed

  • Provide all Signify Health services as indicated including Diagnostic & Preventive Services products (i.e., spirometry, DEE, bone density screening, etc.)

A Note on Our Work Environment:

As an in-home clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of health plan members. We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants.

Why Clinicians Enjoy Working with Signify Health

"I love seeing health plan members at home. You get a better picture of their health when you see where they live.” - Erica R., PA

“At Signify Health, we have the time to help people and to truly listen to their questions and concerns. We can help guide them so they can take better care of themselves. We really can make a change in communities.” - Ali B., NP

“I like how Signify Health manages my experience. I’m just doing the clinician part of my job without all the administrative responsibilities. I have the time to provide education so people have a better understanding of their health. I can answer their questions without rushing out the door.” - Andrew K., PA

Per diem employees qualify for:

  • Hourly base rate, plus additional incentive structure (i.e., per visit completed, other incentives may apply)

  • Malpractice insurance coverage (during Signify Health-related activities)

  • Supplies and other perks

Required & Preferred Qualifications (NPs and PAs)

  • Active, unrestricted license(s) in coverage area(s)

  • Board certification (required)

  • Multi-state licenses (preferred)

Anticipated Weekly Hours

12

Time Type

Part time

Pay Range

The typical pay range for this role is:

$37.66 - $81.11

This pay range represents the base hourly rate or base annual full-time salary for all positions in the job grade within which this position falls. The actual base salary offer will depend on a variety of factors including experience, education, geography and other relevant factors.

Our people fuel our future. Our teams reflect the customers, patients, members and communities we serve and we are committed to fostering a workplace where every colleague feels valued and that they belong.

Great benefits for great people

We take pride in offering a comprehensive and competitive mix of pay and benefits that reflects our commitment to our colleagues and their families.

This part‑time position is eligible for a range of benefits and programs that support the physical, emotional, and financial well‑being of colleagues. Depending on hours worked and eligibility, the benefits for this position include dental, vision, wellness resources, employee discounts, access to certain voluntary benefits, and other programs.

Additional details about available benefits are provided during the application process and on Benefits Moments.

We anticipate the application window for this opening will close on: 12/31/2026

Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with all federal, state and local laws.
