jobs.title: Deputy Chief Executive Officer (Deputy CEO)
jobs.excerpt: ROLE PURPOSEThe Deputy Chief Executive Officer serves as the principal execution leader of the company and acts as the Chief Executive Officer's primary partner in the management and delivery of the Company's strategic, operational, commercial, and financial objectives.
jobs.description:
ROLE PURPOSE

The Deputy Chief Executive Officer serves as the principal execution leader of the company and acts as the Chief Executive Officer's primary partner in the management and delivery of the Company's strategic, operational, commercial, and financial objectives.

The role is responsible for overseeing the Company's core revenue-generating businesses, driving organizational performance, ensuring effective execution of strategic initiatives, fostering alignment across business units, and maintaining accountability for the achievement of approved business plans and financial targets.

The Deputy CEO provides day-to-day leadership and coordination across the enterprise, ensuring that strategic priorities approved by the Board and Executive Management are translated into measurable outcomes. The role is specifically intended to create organizational capacity for the CEO to focus on strategic growth initiatives, business development, capital management, enterprise risk oversight, stakeholder engagement, funding activities, acquisitions, and long-term transformation initiatives.

The Deputy CEO will serve as Acting Chief Executive Officer when required and will represent the Company internally and externally as delegated by the CEO.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Enterprise Leadership & Business Performance

  • Support the CEO in the overall leadership and management of the company.
  • Drive execution of the Company's strategic plan and annual business objectives.
  • Ensure alignment between corporate strategy, departmental priorities, and individual performance objectives.
  • Lead the execution of initiatives designed to enhance profitability, efficiency, productivity, and shareholder value.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, performance excellence, collaboration, innovation, and client-centricity.
  • Ensure timely identification and resolution of operational, commercial, and organizational challenges.
  • Act as the primary executive responsible for translating strategy into execution.

Commercial Leadership & Revenue Management

Provide executive oversight for the Company's core client-facing and revenue-generating businesses, including:

  • Investment Banking
  • Sales & Services
  • Wealth Management
  • Trading & Brokerage
  • Treasury & Financial Institutions

Responsibilities include:

  • Driving revenue growth and market share expansion.
  • Monitoring business performance against approved budgets and targets.
  • Identifying opportunities for revenue enhancement and business development.
  • Ensuring effective cross-selling and collaboration across business lines.
  • Supporting the development and execution of commercial strategies.
  • Monitoring client acquisition, retention, and relationship management initiatives.
  • Ensuring business units operate efficiently and profitably.

Strategic Execution & Transformation

  • Lead enterprise-wide implementation of strategic initiatives approved by the Board and Executive Committee.
  • Establish and maintain mechanisms to monitor strategic initiative delivery.
  • Ensure strategic projects are delivered on time, within budget, and in accordance with approved objectives.
  • Coordinate execution across business units and support functions.
  • Identify and escalate barriers to execution and recommend corrective actions.
  • Support organizational transformation initiatives and business process improvements.
  • Champion a culture of continuous improvement and execution excellence.

Executive Management & Organizational Coordination

  • Serve as a key member of the Executive Management Team.
  • Coordinate management activities across business lines and support functions.
  • Chair executive and management meetings as delegated by the CEO.
  • Monitor execution of management action items and strategic priorities.
  • Drive accountability across the leadership team.
  • Facilitate effective communication and collaboration across departments.
  • Ensure alignment of resources with strategic priorities.

Financial Performance & Resource Management

  • Partner with the CEO and CFO to achieve approved financial objectives.
  • Monitor financial performance across business units.
  • Drive disciplined expense management and resource optimization.
  • Ensure business units operate within approved budgets.
  • Monitor key financial indicators and recommend corrective actions where required.
  • Support the preparation and execution of annual business plans and budgets.
  • Ensure efficient deployment of financial and operational resources.

Operational Oversight & Service Excellence

Through direct leadership and collaboration with operational stakeholders:

  • Promote operational excellence across the organization.
  • Maintain oversight of critical operational performance metrics.
  • Work closely with the VP Operations and VP Information Technology to ensure effective execution of operational and technology priorities.
  • Support service delivery improvements and client experience initiatives.
  • Ensure business continuity and operational resilience.
  • Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, scalability, and service quality.
  • Support implementation of technology-enabled solutions to improve organizational effectiveness.

Risk, Governance & Regulatory Oversight

  • Support the CEO in maintaining a strong governance and control environment.
  • Ensure effective implementation of Board and Executive Committee decisions.
  • Monitor the status of regulatory, audit, compliance, and risk management initiatives.
  • Support the remediation of operational, regulatory, and governance issues.
  • Promote adherence to internal policies, regulatory requirements, and industry standards.
  • Foster a culture of ethical conduct and accountability throughout the organization.
  • Ensure significant issues are escalated appropriately and addressed promptly.

Stakeholder Engagement

  • Build and maintain productive relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Represent the Company in meetings with clients, regulators, industry bodies, and business partners as delegated.
  • Support initiatives designed to enhance the Company's reputation and market position.
  • Collaborate with senior management to strengthen client and stakeholder relationships.

Acting Chief Executive Officer

  • Serve as Acting CEO in the absence of the Chief Executive Officer.
  • Exercise delegated authority as assigned by the CEO and Board of Directors.
  • Represent the Company in executive-level engagements when required.
  • Provide leadership continuity during periods of CEO absence.

ETHICS, CONDUCT & SECURITY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Uphold the highest standards of integrity, professionalism, confidentiality, and ethical conduct.
  • Ensure compliance with all applicable laws, regulations, policies, and governance standards.
  • Safeguard confidential, proprietary, and client information.
  • Promote a culture of transparency, accountability, and responsible corporate citizenship.
  • Support cybersecurity, information security, and business continuity initiatives.
  • Report and address any identified ethical, regulatory, or operational concerns.

QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE

Education

  • Master's Degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Management, Accounting, Law, or a related discipline.
  • Professional designation such as CFA®, FRM®, CAIA®, CPA, ACCA, or equivalent.

Experience

  • Minimum twelve (12) years of progressively senior leadership experience within financial services, banking, capital markets, investment management, wealth management, or a related industry.
  • Demonstrated experience managing multiple business units and senior leaders.
  • Proven track record of driving business growth, operational performance, and organizational transformation.
  • Experience leading strategic initiatives and complex organizational projects.
  • Strong understanding of financial services regulation and governance frameworks.
  • Experience operating at Executive Committee or Board level would be considered a strong asset.

CORE COMPETENCIES & SKILLS

Leadership & Management

  • Strategic leadership
  • Executive presence

Commercial & Financial Acumen

Personal Attributes

  • High integrity and professionalism
  • Strong execution orientation
  • Resilience and adaptability
  • Sound judgment
  • Results-driven mindset
  • Exceptional communication skills

KEY RELATIONSHIPS

Internal

External

  • Clients
  • Regulators
  • Industry Associations
  • Financial Institutions
  • Business Partners
  • Professional Advisors
  • Vendors and Service Providers

KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS

Financial Performance

  • Achievement of annual revenue targets.
  • Achievement of profitability objectives.
  • Cost-to-income ratio performance.
  • Business line budget achievement.

Strategic Execution

  • Percentage of strategic initiatives delivered on time.
  • Achievement of annual corporate objectives.
  • Successful implementation of transformation initiatives.
  • Closure of executive action items.

Operational Excellence

  • Service delivery performance.
  • Operational efficiency improvements.
  • Technology and operational project execution.
  • Client experience metrics.

Leadership & Culture

  • Employee engagement and leadership effectiveness.
  • Talent retention and succession readiness.
  • Cross-functional collaboration effectiveness.
  • Stakeholder satisfaction.

Governance & Risk

  • Regulatory and audit issue remediation.
  • Compliance with governance standards.
  • Timely implementation of Board and Executive directives.
  • Reduction in operational risk events.

SPECIAL WORKING CONDITIONS

  • The position operates in a fast-paced executive environment requiring significant interaction with internal and external stakeholders.
  • The role will require flexibility beyond normal business hours, including occasional evenings, weekends, and public holidays.
  • The role may involve domestic and international travel.
  • The incumbent will regularly participate in Board meetings, Executive Committee meetings, regulatory engagements, client meetings, and strategic planning sessions.

WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS

The Deputy Chief Executive Officer role has been established to strengthen organizational execution, enhance management capacity, and ensure disciplined delivery of the company's strategic, commercial, and operational objectives. The position serves as the Company's principal internal leader, enabling the Chief Executive Officer to focus on growth, business development, capital management, stakeholder engagement, enterprise risk oversight, and long-term transformation initiatives.

Video & Motion Designer

Job Title:Video & Motion Designer

Department:Creative

Reports To:Design Manager

Location:Dubai, UAE

Work Arrangement:Freelance

SUMMARY

The Video & Motion Designer is responsible for creating animated and video content across social, digital and broadcast platforms for the agency’s sport and entertainment clients. Reporting to the Design Manager, the Video & Motion Designer works within the studio’s traffic and workflow system — receiving briefs, prioritisation, and quality feedback through the Design Manager — to bring creative concepts to life through motion graphics, animation and edited video. The role works closely with the Design Manager and wider creative team to deliver high-quality, on-brand motion content across every touchpoint, to the standards and deadlines the studio requires.

Above all, this is a storytelling role. We are looking for a motion designer who thinks in narrative — someone who can take a brief, find the story in it, and build structure, pacing and emotion into every frame, whether it is a six-second social cut or a full campaign film. Trend-led edits and transitions alone are not enough; every piece should have a beginning, a build and a payoff.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Creative Development

  • Lead with story:find the narrative angle in every brief and shape it into a clear arc — hook, build and payoff — before a single keyframe is set.
  • Craft pacing, rhythm and emotional beats through edit timing, motion, music and sound, so content is felt, not just watched.
  • Develop motion concepts, storyboards and animatics based on briefs assigned by the Design Manager.
  • Translate static designs and brand identities into engaging motion systems and animated assets.
  • Research and stay current with motion design, animation and video trends, particularly across sport and entertainment.
  • Prepare and present motion concepts, articulating creative rationale where needed.

Motion & Video Production

  • Design and animate motion graphics in Adobe After Effects for social media, digital advertising, websites, events, LED screens and broadcast.
  • Edit and assemble video content, including highlights, promos, reels and campaign films, incorporating footage, graphics, typography, music and sound design.
  • Create animated templates, lower thirds, title sequences, logo animations and social-first formats (Reels, TikTok, Stories, Shorts).
  • Adapt and resize content across multiple aspect ratios, durations and platform specifications.
  • Render, export and package final files for delivery, in line with the Design Manager’s technical specifications.
  • Deliver work within the timelines and priorities set through the studio’s traffic system, including fast-turnaround and live-event content.

Brand & Quality Control

  • Maintain and adhere to established brand and motion guidelines across all client work.
  • Submit work for quality review to the Design Manager before it leaves the studio, and implement feedback and revisions in a timely manner.
  • Ensure technical quality across all outputs, including frame rates, resolution, colour, audio levels and safe zones.

Collaboration & Asset Management

  • Collaborate with the Design Manager and wider creative team, including designers, copywriters and production partners, to ensure cohesive visual communication.
  • Flag capacity or timeline concerns to the Design Manager as early as possible.
  • Manage and organise project files, footage, templates and motion assets, maintaining clear version control and archiving.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Professional motion designer:proven, hands-on motion graphics experience in Adobe After Effects is essential. This is the core of the role, not a secondary skill.
  • Proven storytelling ability:a portfolio that shows narrative-led work with clear structure, pacing and payoff — not only trend-based, template or transition-driven content.
  • Advanced proficiency in Adobe After Effects, with strong working knowledge of Premiere Pro, Photoshop and Illustrator.
  • Solid understanding of animation principles, timing, typography, composition and colour theory.
  • Experience creating motion graphics and edited video for social, digital and broadcast media.
  • Familiarity with Cinema 4D, Element 3D or other 3D tools is an advantage.
  • Working knowledge of audio editing, colour correction and video export formats and codecs.
  • Experience in sport, entertainment or live-event content is an advantage.
  • Ability to work within established deadlines, including fast-turnaround projects.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills.
  • Showreel (mandatory) demonstrating original After Effects motion graphics and storytelling, alongside video editing work.
  • Ability to receive and implement critique constructively.

• Strong organisational skills.

PLEASE NOTE

This is a dedicated motion design role. Applicants must be experienced motion designers with original After Effects animation work in their showreel.

Non-motion designers should not apply.Applications from video editors, videographers, social media content creators or graphic designers without a professional motion graphics background will not be considered.

jobs.description:
Remote | India | Project-Based Independent Contractor

Compensation: $15–$55 USD/hour, based on specialty, experience, and project requirements

Help Shape the Future of AI in Healthcare

What if your clinical expertise could help artificial intelligence better understand complex medical information, evaluate healthcare scenarios, and deliver more accurate, reliable responses?

At Volga Partners, we’re connecting experienced healthcare professionals with opportunities to contribute to the development and evaluation of advanced AI models.

We’re seeking physicians, nurse practitioners, and physician assistants who can apply their clinical knowledge, independent judgment, and evidence-based reasoning to evaluate AI-generated medical information.

This isn’t a traditional healthcare position. You won’t be providing direct patient care or managing a caseload. Instead, you’ll assess complex medical scenarios, challenge inaccurate conclusions, identify gaps in reasoning, and provide structured feedback that improves AI model performance.

Your clinical expertise is what matters. AI experience is a plus, not a requirement.


Important Note: This is a freelance, task-based role designed for those seeking supplemental income. It’s essential to understand the nature of freelance work—tasks will be assigned as they become available, and work may be irregular or intermittent.

The Opportunity

As a Healthcare SME, you’ll serve as a subject matter evaluator, helping assess the quality, accuracy, and reasoning of AI-generated responses across specialized healthcare functions.

You’ll examine realistic scenarios, identify errors or gaps in AI-generated conclusions, and provide expert feedback grounded in established medical standards, clinical guidelines, and professional judgment.

Your contributions will help improve how AI systems understand and respond to complex healthcare challenges.

Areas of Expertise We're Seeking

We're particularly interested in professionals with substantial knowledge and practical experience in one or more of these areas:

1. General Practice

Physicians experienced in primary care, diagnostic assessment, preventive medicine, management of common medical conditions, and evidence-based clinical decision-making.

2. Family Medicine

Physicians with expertise in comprehensive primary care, acute and chronic disease management, differential diagnosis, and patient care across different age groups.

3. Internal Medicine

Physicians experienced in adult medicine, complex medical conditions, diagnostic interpretation, multisystem disease management, and evidence-based treatment decisions.

4. Nurse Practitioners (NPs)

Advanced-practice nursing professionals with experience in clinical assessment, diagnostic reasoning, treatment planning, patient management, and healthcare quality standards within their professional scope.

5. Physician Assistants / Physician Associates (PAs)

Qualified clinical professionals with experience in patient assessment, diagnostic evaluation, treatment planning, and interpretation of medical findings within their professional scope.

You do not need expertise in every area. We're seeking depth of knowledge within your particular specialization.

What You'll Do

  • Evaluate AI-generated medical content: Assess responses for clinical accuracy, completeness, relevance, and consistency with accepted medical standards.
  • Analyze clinical reasoning: Determine whether AI-generated assessments, differential diagnoses, and treatment recommendations are supported by appropriate clinical evidence.
  • Identify errors and inconsistencies: Recognize inaccurate medical information, unsupported conclusions, missing clinical considerations, and potential patient safety concerns.
  • Validate medical information: Reference authoritative medical literature, established clinical guidelines, and evidence-based healthcare practices.
  • Provide expert feedback: Clearly explain findings, identify opportunities for improvement, and recommend clinically appropriate corrections.
  • Support AI quality improvement: Apply established evaluation guidelines, scoring criteria, and project-specific quality standards.
  • Complete independent evaluations: Use designated online platforms to complete assignments accurately and within established project timelines.

Why Join Volga Partners?

Apply Your Clinical Expertise in a New Way

Use the medical knowledge and professional judgment you've developed throughout your career to contribute to advanced AI technology without providing direct patient care.

Help Improve AI Accuracy and Reliability

Your evaluations will help identify weaknesses in AI-generated medical information and support the development of more accurate, clinically informed AI systems.

Work Remotely

Participate in specialized project-based assignments from an eligible location, with schedules and workloads determined by project needs.

Explore the Future of Healthcare Technology

Gain experience contributing to advanced AI model evaluation while applying the professional expertise you already possess.

No AI Background Required

We're looking for strong clinical professionals who can recognize accurate medical reasoning, identify mistakes, and explain their assessments using sound professional judgment.


Compensation:

Volga Partners offers project-based hourly compensation based on clinical specialization, relevant experience, professional qualifications, geographic location, and project requirements. See rates per expertise:

General Practice Physician: $25–$55

Family Medicine Physician: $25–$55

Internal Medicine Physician: $25–$55

Nurse Practitioner: $15–$35

Physician Assistant: $15–$35

Project Details

  • Engagement Type: Project-based independent contractor
  • Work Arrangement: Remote
  • Locations: United States, United Kingdom, Australia, New Zealand, Canada, India, and the Philippines, subject to client approval
  • Schedule: Variable, including potential weekday and weekend assignments
  • Evaluation Platform: DataCompute
  • Project Duration: Based on client requirements and project availability
  • Selection Process: Qualified candidates may be required to complete a skills-based clinical evaluation assessment before selection

Specific assignments, schedules, workloads, and project dates will be communicated as they are confirmed. Hours and future assignments are not guaranteed.

Bring Your Medical Expertise to the Future of AI

If you're an experienced healthcare professional who enjoys analyzing complex medical information, applying evidence-based clinical judgment, and contributing to innovative technology, we'd love to hear from you.

Join Volga Partners and help shape the next generation of healthcare AI.

Apply today to be considered for upcoming project opportunities.

Requirements

Who We're Looking For

We’re seeking experienced healthcare professionals who bring more than familiarity with clinical practice. You should be comfortable analyzing complex medical information, exercising independent clinical judgment, and explaining the reasoning behind your conclusions.

Required Qualifications

  • Minimum of three years of relevant professional clinical experience in an applicable specialty.
  • Recognized medical degree, advanced-practice qualification, or equivalent professional credential appropriate to the specialty and country.
  • Demonstrated experience applying clinical judgment, diagnostic reasoning, or evidence-based medical practices.
  • Strong understanding of medical terminology, clinical guidelines, and healthcare standards relevant to the candidate's specialization.
  • Ability to critically evaluate complex medical information and distinguish accurate clinical reasoning from unsupported conclusions.
  • Strong analytical, research, and problem-solving abilities.
  • Excellent written English communication skills, including the ability to clearly explain clinical findings and professional assessments.
  • Comfort using digital platforms, web-based applications, and online research tools.
  • Ability to work independently, follow detailed instructions, and meet established quality standards.
  • Must be comfortable and understand this is a task-based role.

Preferred Qualifications

We encourage applications from professionals with backgrounds such as:

  • Current or previous professional licensure or registration relevant to the candidate's specialty.
  • Experience reviewing medical records, clinical research, medical guidelines, or healthcare quality assessments.
  • Familiarity with U.S. healthcare standards or clinical practices in the United Kingdom, Canada, Australia, or New Zealand.
  • Experience evaluating clinical documentation, medical literature, or complex healthcare cases.
  • Previous exposure to AI model evaluation, medical content review, clinical research, or healthcare technology.

Experience with AI model evaluation, large language models (LLMs), research, or structured quality assessments is beneficial but not required.

In this role, you will:

  • Provide all Signify Health services as indicated including Diagnostic & Preventive Services products (i.e., spirometry, DEE, bone density screening, etc.)

A Note on Our Work Environment:

As an in-home clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of health plan members. We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. This is a remote position.

India-Based | Remote | Full-Time

International market intelligence, independent workstream ownership and high-quality research delivery across renewable energy markets.

About the Role
We are looking for an experienced and highly motivated Renewable Energy Market Research Analyst to join our international Energy Research team.
The role combines renewable energy market intelligence, data research, project and workstream management, and the preparation of high-quality research outputs. The successful candidate will independently manage defined research workstreams and selected projects while contributing to recurring market intelligence products, client-specific studies, awards and other research-based initiatives.
The position requires a strong understanding of global renewable energy markets, with a particular focus on photovoltaics, battery energy storage systems, heat pumps and e-mobility. You will work closely with colleagues in India and Germany across Market Intelligence, Primary Research, product development and client solutions.
Key Responsibilities
Market Research and Intelligence
  • Conduct in-depth research on global renewable energy markets, with a particular focus on photovoltaics, battery energy storage, heat pumps and e-mobility.
  • Monitor and analyse renewable energy installations and market volumes, electricity-market dynamics and prices, tenders, political and regulatory frameworks, market incentives, downstream stakeholders, macroeconomic developments, technology trends and key industry news.
  • Identify reliable primary and secondary sources, including regulatory authorities, industry associations, data providers, company publications and specialist media.
  • Evaluate sources critically and ensure that all research outputs are transparent, traceable and properly documented.
Data Research and Management
  • Maintain and regularly update structured databases containing renewable energy market, regulatory, technology and stakeholder information.
  • Collect, validate, clean and structure quantitative and qualitative data.
  • Spport the development of market estimates, market shares, forecasts, rankings and comparative market assessments.
  • Document data sources, assumptions, methodologies and update processes.
  • Improve the accessibility and reusability of data across different research products and client projects.
Project and Workstream Ownership
  • Independently plan and manage defined research workstreams and selected projects from initial research planning through to final delivery.
  • Translate project objectives into clear tasks, milestones and deliverables.
  • Coordinate inputs from colleagues and contributors and proactively follow up on timelines and open items.
  • Identify risks, data gaps and potential delays at an early stage and communicate them transparently.
  • Review and quality-check research and data work packages prepared by junior or supporting resources where required.
  • Support senior analysts and project leads in the delivery and further development of larger recurring products and complex client assignments.
  • Take increasing ownership of recurring products or project modules based on experience and demonstrated performance.
    Reports, Products and Client Projects
    • Prepare high-quality reports, presentations, market summaries, articles and other research-based knowledge pieces.
    • Translate complex market information into clear findings, visualisations and management-relevant insights.
    • Contribute to whitepapers, client-specific studies, market assessments, workshops and Advisory-related projects.
    • Support the combination of different data sources and research assets to answer specific client and business questions.
    • Collaborate with colleagues responsible for Primary Research, product development and client solutions.
    Awards and Stakeholder Coordination
    • Support selected research-based awards and ranking programmes.
    • Conduct company, market and technology research required for award evaluations.
    • Coordinate defined communication with applicants, industry experts and evaluators.
    • Support the documentation, evaluation and quality-assurance processes associated with awards and rankings.
    Process Improvement, Technology and Automation
    • Contribute to the standardisation and continuous improvement of research, data-management and reporting processes.
    • Identify repetitive research or data tasks that can be supported through digital tools, automation or AI-assisted workflows.
    • Use AI-supported research tools responsibly, ensuring that all information is verified through reliable sources.
    • Support the development of templates, dashboards, documentation and reusable research workflows.
    • Share knowledge, sources and best practices proactively with the wider team.
    Key Skills, Knowledge and Abilities
    • Strong understanding of renewable energy markets, particularly photovoltaics and battery energy storage. Knowledge of heat pumps or e-mobility is an advantage.
    • Strong research skills and the ability to identify, evaluate and synthesise information from a wide variety of sources.
    • Very good quantitative and qualitative analytical skills.
    • Ability to manage defined projects and workstreams independently, including priorities, timelines, contributors and deliverables.
    • Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.
    • High level of ownership, reliability and proactive communication.
    • Ability to identify risks or unclear requirements and raise them early.
    • Strong written and spoken English.
    • Ability to prepare clear, well-structured reports, presentations and management summaries.
    • Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; good knowledge of Microsoft Word.
    • Experience with data visualisation, Power BI, statistical software, databases, automation tools or AI-supported research workflows is an advantage.
    • Ability to work independently in a remote and international environment while remaining closely connected to the wider team.
    • Collaborative, culturally sensitive and respectful working style.
    • Willingness to learn, document knowledge and support the development of other team members.
      Required Education and Experience
      • Master’s degree in economics, business administration, energy economics, environmental sciences, data analytics, public policy or another relevant discipline.
      • Two to four years of professional experience in renewable energy market research, market intelligence, consulting, Advisory or a comparable analytical role.
      • Demonstrable experience in at least one of the following areas: photovoltaics, battery energy storage, electricity markets, heat pumps, e-mobility, or renewable energy policy and regulation.
      • Experience in a reputable research, consulting, energy, data or market-intelligence organisation is preferred.
      • Previous responsibility for defined projects, workstreams or recurring research products is strongly preferred.
      Location and Working Model

      • Full-time employment, 40 working hours per week.
      • Regular collaboration with colleagues based in India and Germany.
      • Willingness to maintain sufficient working-hour overlap with Central European business hours.

jobs.title: Data QA Engineer - Remote
jobs.excerpt: At Zyte, we eat data for breakfast and you can eat your breakfast anywhere and work for Zyte.
jobs.description:
At Zyte, we eat data for breakfast and you can eat your breakfast anywhere and work for Zyte. Founded in 2010, we are a globally distributed team of over 250 Zytans working from over 28 countries who are on a mission to enable our customers to extract the data they need to continue to innovate and grow their businesses. We believe that all businesses deserve a smooth pathway to data.

Role Overview

Data QA is how we make sure the data we deliver is right before the customer sees it. As a Data QA Engineer, you will check the data our spiders and AI-assisted projects produce against what the customer asked for, find what is wrong and tell the team exactly what you found.

Quality assurance is more useful as a question asked at the start than a gate at the end. Is this requirement testable and how would we know if it were wrong? Part of this role is asking that question early, so problems are fixed before they reach the customer.

Key Responsibilities

  • Turn customer scraping and data requirements into a clear test approach and own QA from the start on new projects.
  • Combine exploratory manual and visual testing with automated tests where automation pays for itself.
  • Run test cycles on extracted data and report the results clearly.
  • Write up defects with enough detail that a developer can reproduce and fix them without a conversation.
  • Use descriptive statistics, summaries and charts to show how good the data is: completeness, accuracy, consistency and drift.
  • Produce test reports and quality scores that give the team, and the customer where needed, a true picture.
  • Say what was tested, what was not, and what risk that leaves.
  • Work with project managers and clients to clear up unclear or untestable requirements before QA begins.
  • Feed into our test automation framework, with a focus on coverage and performance.
  • Suggest and take ownership of improvements to QA process and tooling, including browser add-ons, spreadsheet add-ons and UI-based test automation tools.
  • Work with QA leadership, project managers and developers, with minimal supervision.

Requirements

  • 5+ years in a QA Engineer or similar role - testing software or data.
  • Python preferred language - Pandas and Jupyter for data analysis and validation.
  • SQL: basic to intermediate queries, and comfort with at least one relational database and its tools.
  • A solid grasp of web technologies and protocols: HTML, XPath, JSON, HTTP and CSS.
  • Experience writing tests against HTTP/REST APIs.
  • Proactive and detail-oriented QA professional with a strong sense of ownership over project quality.
  • Fast learner adept at rapidly understanding complex project domain requirements and adapting to new technologies.
  • Leveraging AI and LLM tools to optimize test case generation and accelerate data validation processes.
  • Good test case design and test data management.
  • Experience working in an agile team (Scrum or Kanban) alongside developers.
  • An understanding of data quality concepts such as completeness, accuracy, consistency and drift.
  • Strong attention to detail, and the confidence to hold the quality line under delivery pressure.
  • Clear written and spoken communication in English.

Nice to Have

  • Working knowledge of Scrapy and other Python-based scraping frameworks.
  • Experience with test automation frameworks.
  • Interest in data science concepts as they apply to data analysis and validation.
  • Interest in using AI and LLM tools to speed up data validation.

Benefits

As a new Zytan, you will:

Become part of a self-motivated, progressive, multi-cultural team.

Have the freedom and flexibility to work from where you do your best work.

Work with cutting-edge open source technologies and tools.

35 days paid holidays

The Role

Moderna continues to expand its innovative mRNA platform, unlocking new applications across diseases and therapeutic areas. As the company advances its oncology pipeline, including intismeran autogene, a personalized investigational mRNA therapy being developed in collaboration with Merck, this role will play a critical part in preparing for the potential launch of Moderna’s first commercial therapeutic in oncology.

Moderna’s intismeran autogene (INT) program represents an exciting advancement in personalized cancer treatment, leveraging the power of mRNA technology to develop therapies tailored to each patient’s unique tumor profile. This innovative approach has the potential to redefine the future of cancer care and marks a significant milestone in Moderna’s evolution beyond infectious diseases. This is a unique opportunity to help shape the commercial launch of a pioneering oncology program and play a foundational role in building Moderna’s oncology business.

Moderna is seeking a Sr. Director, Regional Sales, Central, who will build, lead, and develop the Central Region Oncology Sales team to drive regional sales strategy and execution for a co-promoted solid tumor oncology asset. This role is accountable for regional sales performance, oncology launch excellence, performance management and field execution across complex account ecosystems, while partnering closely with an alliance partner. The role requires deep expertise in oncology, and knowledge of account dynamics, experience building high performing teams, strong communication skills, analytical skills, ability to execute while partnering closely with the alliance, as well as proven leadership in a launch environment. This position is also responsible for building key business relationships with multi-disciplinary stakeholders across key health systems, accounts and large practice networks.

You combine strong sales and people leadership expertise with deep oncology knowledge and are comfortable partnering with alliance or other matrix partners to drive solutions that are best for patients and business. You are a collaborative thinker who thrives in complex, cross-functional environments and brings a proactive, solution-oriented mindset.

Here’s What You’ll Do

  • Manage and deploy resources to ensure the achievement of objectives and manage regional budgets to ensure appropriate utilization of funds.
  • Ensure full compliance with Moderna policies and all applicable healthcare laws and regulations.

  • Prior experience in melanoma is highly preferred
  • Experience successfully launching and executing in an alliance relationship is highly preferred
  • Proven experience building high performing teams
  • Deep knowledge of key customer types including academic, community, IDN, and GPO affiliated oncology programs

  • Experience working in a solution oriented, dynamic, startup environment
  • Demonstrated experience collaborating with cross function partners to ensure the appropriate coordinated engagement of all account types
  • Proven ability to utilize market knowledge and analytics to drive regional strategies, effective targeting, and achievement of sales goals
  • Fluency in data-driven decision-making and CRM utilization for field strategy

  • Exceptional interpersonal, leadership, communication and influencing skills

Pay & Benefits

Do you have a passion for engaging with people and helping them on their journey to better health? Signify Health, part of CVS Health®, is seeking a Per Diem Physician to provide In-Home Health Evaluations, engaging with people in the comfort of their own homes and helping bridge gaps in care.

You’ll play a critical role in building trusted relationships to make people healthier, helping bring flexible, comprehensive and personalized health evaluations right to people’s front doors.

Job highlights
The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). You’ll use an iPad and an intuitive clinical workflow for each evaluation and are not required to prescribe medicine, order lab tests or alter people’s current treatment regimen.

In this role, you will:

  • Bring your heart into every visit, joining a national network of purpose-driven clinicians dedicated to improving health outcomes

  • Be part of our efforts to visit millions of people nationwide with the goal of providing connections to the right care for people’s unique needs

  • Work with Signify Health as a clinician colleague, fulfilling the requirements of the specified role

  • Be flexible to travel locally and within licensed states, as needed

  • Conduct virtual visits as needed

  • Provide all Signify Health services as indicated including Diagnostic & Preventive Services products (i.e., spirometry, DEE, bone density screening, etc.)

A Note on Our Work Environment:

As an in-home clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of health plan members. We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants.

Why Clinicians Enjoy Working with Signify Health
“Many of the people I see are shocked that a physician is coming to their home to visit with them one-on-one. When you sit down and have an unhurried conversation about their health, they are impressed, happy, and understand that their health plan and care team cares about them.” - M.L., MD

“The primary care physician gets a snapshot of a person in an office setting, but with Signify Health, we see things like the number of steps to enter their home, the state of disrepair those steps may be in, and the person’s ability to function comfortably and with ease in their own home. We can make referrals to the individual’s health plan, encourage the participation of their loved ones, and ensure their PCPs are aware of their health and overall quality of life.” - C.H., MD

Per diem employees qualify for:

  • Hourly base rate, plus additional incentive structure (i.e., per visit completed, other incentives may apply)

  • Malpractice insurance coverage (during Signify Health-related activities)

  • Supplies and other perks

Required & Preferred Qualifications (MDs and DOs)

  • Active, unrestricted license(s) in coverage area(s)

  • Multi-state licenses (preferred)

12

Part time

$83.69 - $180.25

This pay range represents the base hourly rate or base annual full-time salary for all positions in the job grade within which this position falls. The actual base salary offer will depend on a variety of factors including experience, education, geography and other relevant factors.

Most complex technical challenges in Imunify360 go beyond individual squads. A single detection change can impact the scanner, agent, UI, reputation backend, and release process. While squad leads own delivery within their teams, the Staff Engineer ensures technical alignment across the product.

As a Staff Engineer, you'll be a hands-on technical leader working across the entire product, focusing on the most critical and high-impact challenges as priorities evolve. You'll drive technical decisions, improve architecture, establish engineering standards, and help teams build sustainable solutions.

This is an individual contributor role, without direct people management responsibilities. You'll remain actively involved in development, spending approximately 30–50% of your time writing production code, rather than focusing solely on architectural design.

jobs.description:
Firmable's product depends on customer trust in how we handle their data. This role is the operational backbone of that trust: the controls you run are what let 1,000+ customers rely on Firmable with their data.

The Role

As our Security Engineer, you'll own the day-to-day execution of the security controls and policies that keep Firmable compliant against SOC 2 (all five TSC) and ISO 27001:2022. You'll report into the Security & Compliance team, fully remote and open globally. This is a hands-on operational role, not a paper-compliance one: you implement, monitor and continuously tighten the controls auditors and customers actually test against.

~90% hands-on execution: control implementation, continuous monitoring, evidence collection, vulnerability and access management.
~10% cross-functional: partnering with engineering on secure cloud config and shaping the program as it scales across frameworks.

What You'll Own

  • SOC 2 & ISO 27001 execution: implement and maintain controls across infrastructure, applications and internal systems; close gaps as they're identified

  • Security policy enforcement: put information security policy into daily practice across engineering and business teams, covering access control, data classification, incident response, vendor risk and change management

  • Continuous control monitoring: recurring access reviews, log reviews, vulnerability scans and patch cadence checks; organise evidence ahead of audits

  • Vulnerability management: triage scanner findings, coordinate remediation with engineering, verify closure

  • Identity & access management: onboarding/offboarding, least-privilege and MFA enforcement, periodic access recertification

  • Monitoring & incident response: watch security alerts and logs, triage and escalate per the incident response plan

  • Risk & vendor management: maintain the risk register and third-party risk assessments, track remediation to closure

  • Audit readiness: prepare evidence for annual assessments and respond to customer security questionnaires

  • Security awareness: run employee training and phishing simulations

  • Secure cloud configuration: partner with engineering on least-privilege IAM, encryption at rest and in transit, and secrets management (AWS)

What We're Looking For

Must haves

  • 2–5 years in security engineering, cloud security or infrastructure security, ideally with direct SOC 2 or ISO 27001 exposure

  • Working knowledge of the SOC 2 Trust Services Criteria and how technical controls map to them

  • Hands-on cloud security fundamentals (AWS preferred): IAM, logging/monitoring, vulnerability scanning

  • Comfortable executing policy day to day (access reviews, evidence collection, remediation tracking), not just writing it

  • Clear written communication and comfortable working async across time zones with a distributed team

Highly valued

  • Familiarity with GRC automation platforms (Vanta, Drata or similar)

  • Relevant certification (Security+, CySA+, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer, or progress toward CISA/CISSP)

The Environment

Fully remote, open globally, working closely with a distributed Security and Engineering team across time zones. Real ownership over controls that directly protect customer trust, not a box-ticking exercise. Fast-moving, AI-native product team.

Why This Role

  • Real ownership: the controls you run directly protect the trust 1,000+ customers place in Firmable's data

  • Multi-framework exposure from day one: a live SOC 2 and ISO 27001 program, not a single-framework box-tick

  • Competitive compensation and flexible hours in a fast-moving, AI-native product team

jobs.description:
Title

Partnership and Resource Mobilisation Coordinator

Reports To

Programmes Manager

Status

FTE 0.8 - 4 days per week

Location

Remote working, based in The Netherlands, Germany or the United Kingdom.

You must have the right to work in the country for which you apply. IDC is unable to support work visa applications or relocation.

Languages

Excellent communication skills in oral and written English

Compensation

Per annum depending on skills and experience:

  • €36,000 to €42,400 gross annually for 0.8 FTE (based on a full-time equivalent of €45,000 to €53,000)

Background

International Detention Coalition (IDC) is a unique global network of over 200 civil society organisations and individuals in more than 75 countries, which coordinates with members and partners on advocacy, research, coalition and capacity building, to eliminate immigration detention and advance rights-based alternatives to detention. IDC is a highly recognised, impact-driven organisation, offering a stimulating workplace committed to local, national, regional and global change.

Role Purpose

The Partnership and Resource Mobilisation Coordinator supports the development and implementation of IDC’s fundraising and resource mobilisation efforts, helping to strengthen and diversify the organisation’s funding base, with a focus on mobilising private capital and securing funding from donors and sectors that IDC has not yet reached.

Role Summary

The Partnership and Resource Mobilisation Coordinator combines strategic thinking with hands-on implementation, and works to identify and pursue funding opportunities, develop high-quality pitches, support donor communications, coordinate with relevant team members, and maintain strong relationships between IDC and its funders, and prospective funders. Working closely with the Executive Director, Programmes Manager, Chief Communications Officer, as well as the finance and regional programme teams, the Partnership and Resource Mobilisation Coordinator will help ensure that fundraising is proactive, coordinated, innovative and aligned with IDC’s organisational strategy and programme priorities.

The Partnership and Resource Mobilisation Coordinator will help strengthen IDC’s long-term financial sustainability by building a proactive, relationship-driven and diversified fundraising function. The role will focus on mobilising private philanthropic capital, engaging philanthropic and entrepreneurial networks, and developing strategic relationships with prospective supporters, particularly from sectors that IDC has not yet reached. In parallel, the Coordinator will explore innovative funding approaches and emerging giving channels, translating promising opportunities into meaningful, long-term partnerships that expand and diversify IDC’s funding base.

Role Responsibilities

Strategic Relationship Development & Engagement

  • Support the development and implementation of IDC’s organisational fundraising and resource mobilisation strategy, ensuring that all activities align with IDC’s ethical guidelines and policies.
  • Maintain an overview of IDC’s funding priorities, funding needs and development pipeline.
  • Support forward planning of fundraising opportunities, including prospecting, cultivation, proposal development and renewal timelines.
  • Monitor developments in the funding environment, particularly related to the mobilisation of private capital and identify emerging opportunities, trends and risks relevant to IDC.
  • Contribute to organisational discussions about funding priorities, positioning and sustainability.
  • Identify opportunities to strengthen and diversify IDC’s funding base, in particular:
    • Mobilise private philanthropic capital Identify and develop opportunities with corporates, philanthropists, family offices, donor-advised funds (DAFs) and other private funding partners to broaden and diversify IDC’s funding base.
    • Explore innovative funding approaches Identify and assess emerging funding channels and mechanisms, for example, digital giving and crypto philanthropy, that could unlock new sources of support for IDC.
    • Develop impact-oriented partnerships Build relationships with funders and partners who share IDC’s mission and are interested in supporting measurable, long-term social change through strategic, mission-aligned partnerships.

Donor Cultivation and Communication

  • Champion networking and relationship-building opportunities that strengthen the organisation’s profile, partnerships and reach.
  • Coordinate follow-up, such as thank you letters and other stewardship communications, with funders and prospective funders, ensuring actions and opportunities are appropriately tracked.
  • Prepare background research, briefing materials and correspondence for donor meetings.
  • Liaise with the Executive Director, Programmes Manager and relevant team members on potential opportunities related to target funders.
  • Coordinate relevant IDC impact stories and social media activities in cooperation with the Chief Communications Officer.

Development Research and Prospecting

  • Conduct research into new prospective funders as described above, from sectors we have not yet reached, that match IDC’s strategy and priorities, while respecting IDC’s ethical guidelines and policies.
  • Oversee and maintain a comprehensive funder database and assess prospective opportunities against IDC’s strategic priorities, programmes, and organisational capacity in consultation with relevant personnel.
  • Update IDC’s Executive Director, Programmes Manager and relevant personnel regularly by preparing concise prospect profiles and recommendations for internal consideration.
  • Develop and maintain a pipeline of prospective funding opportunities.

Funding Cultivation

  • Coordinate and contribute to the development of high-quality concept notes, proposals, pitch decks, and tailored partnership propositions for different types of prospective supporters, in collaboration with IDC’s Executive Director and relevant personnel.
  • Work with IDC colleagues, including the Chief Communications Officer to translate IDC’s mission, strategic priorities, programmes and approach into compelling and impact-oriented funding propositions, incorporating outcomes from impact monitoring and assessment, such as impact stories that resonate with funders’ interests and priorities.
  • Coordinate proposal development processes related to the mobilisation of private capital, including timelines, inputs, review and submission.
  • Maintain a forward-looking calendar of funding opportunities, applications, pitches and renewals.

Development Systems and MEL

  • Maintain and improve systems for tracking prospects, opportunities, applications, funder relationships and development activity.
  • Contribute to regular development reporting and pipeline reviews.
  • Track fundraising progress against agreed objectives and priorities.
  • Capture and share learning from successful and unsuccessful funding approaches.
  • Contribute to improving organisational fundraising tools, templates, processes and resources.

Collaboration and Teamwork

  • Work with relevant team members to develop and maintain a system for grant administration and acquisition, including development of resources and capacity building for IDC team members.
  • Work collaboratively with relevant team members, including the Executive Director, Programmes Manager, Chief Communications Officer, as well as the finance and regional programme teams to achieve fundraising goals and objectives.
  • Participate in team meetings, training sessions and other organisational activities as needed.

Core Responsibilities

  • Actively contribute to a culture of agile learning, collaboration, teamwork and support within the IDC team.
  • Demonstrate passion and alignment with IDC’s mission, vision and core values of innovation, collaboration, respect, inclusion, representation and being solutions-focused.
  • Demonstrate an understanding of IDC policies to ensure a positive and safe working environment for all.
  • Actively engage with organisational systems, processes and infrastructure to ensure sustainability and appropriate safeguarding of institutional knowledge, assets and core activities over time.
  • Test and use AI tools across relevant areas of work, where appropriate, to enhance efficiency, effectiveness and innovation.

Essential Qualifications

  • Relevant degree in management, business administration, economics, social sciences, communications, marketing or related field or equivalent professional experience.
  • Proven experience and a successful track record in fundraising or development and mobilisation of private capital for the non-profit sector.
  • Strategic and entrepreneurial mindset and the ability to recognise opportunities, think creatively, work proactively and develop new approaches to building partnerships and diversifying income.
  • Experience maintaining funding pipelines, donor information or similar relationship-management systems.
  • Knowledge of fundraising best practices and grant regulations
  • Ability to understand complex organisational or programme information and translate it into clear, compelling pitches.
  • Demonstrated understanding of the issues faced by refugees, people seeking asylum and migrants, particularly those affected by immigration detention.
  • Strong research, analytical and writing skills in English.
  • Excellent networking and relationship-building skills.
  • Excellent organisational skills including attention to detail, with the ability to multitask and prioritise effectively and work within time constraints and competing deadlines.
  • Ability to work independently and proactively in a remote and internationally distributed team.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, donor management software, online research tools and relevant AI technologies.
  • Commitment to the mission and values of IDC.
  • Ability to travel if needed.

Desireable

  • Experience engaging with private philanthropists, corporate giving, family foundations, family offices, major donors, donor-advised funds (DAFs), philanthropic advisers or other private funding networks.
  • Familiarity with entrepreneurial networks, business angels or other intermediaries who can facilitate access to philanthropic capital.
  • Experience exploring alternative funding channels, such as digital giving, crypto philanthropy or other emerging approaches to resource mobilisation.
  • An established professional network in philanthropy, private giving, business development or related fields, or the ability to build such networks proactively.
  • Understanding of impact-oriented philanthropy and the ability to communicate the social impact of an organisation in ways that resonate with prospective supporters.
  • Knowledge of the Spanish language.
  • Knowledge of project management/fundraising software such as Salesforce, Sales Navigator, etc.

Application Process

To apply for this role, please upload your resume and a cover letter on IDC Careers’ Webpage, by Friday 6 November 2026. Please ensure that you clearly address all of the key selection criteria in your application.

If you have enquiries, please write to . Please note that applications will not be accepted if sent by email.

Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. The selected candidate will be expected to start as soon as possible.

NB: All applications must be submitted in English.

We envision a world where immigration detention no longer exists. And we work with everyone to make that vision a reality. We believe people should be able to live freely while they await the outcome of their immigration case, and we advocate for the human rights and dignity of everyone impacted by immigration detention.

IDC is solutions-focused, meaning that we work with lived experience leaders, governments, decision-makers, civil society, UN agencies and other actors to deliver alternatives that benefit migrants, communities and society at large. We are truly global, uniting a coalition of civil society organisations, community groups and individuals from all over the world. While the movement spans continents, we all have a clear purpose: to reduce and ultimately end immigration detention and to promote alternatives.

IDC values diversity, equality and inclusivity. Applications are welcome from all backgrounds. We especially encourage applications of those from underrepresented backgrounds, including but not limited to gender, race, age, sexual orientation, disability and religion. In particular, we highly encourage leaders with lived experience of the impacts of detention to apply. If potential candidates require any adaptations to usual recruitment processes, please do not hesitate to note this in your application.

Salary: €36,000 to €42,400 gross annually for 0.8 FTE (based on a full-time equivalent of €45,000 to €53,000)

Fully Remote — South Africa | Independent Contractor | UK business hours | UK logistics software client

About the Role

Outsource Ability is recruiting on behalf of a UK software company that supplies freight management, transport management, demurrage and detention, and carbon emissions software to the logistics industry. The client is looking for an experienced B2B Appointment Setter to generate qualified product demonstrations with freight forwarders and logistics companies.

You will work through an existing database of around 3,000 contacts by telephone. You will find the right decision-makers, learn what software they use now, uncover their operational challenges and book qualified demonstrations. The focus is on real sales opportunities, not meetings booked to hit an activity target.

This is a telephone-based role. You will not send unsolicited sales emails, and you will not handle technical queries, pricing, commercial negotiations or contract discussions. These are referred to the client's business owner.

Key Responsibilities

Outbound Calling & Appointment Setting

  • Work systematically through the existing database of around 3,000 contacts.
  • Make outbound calls to freight forwarding and logistics businesses.
  • Identify and engage business owners, managing directors, operations directors and other relevant decision-makers.
  • Introduce the client's software and establish whether it could benefit the prospect's business.
  • Identify operational challenges, inefficiencies and frustrations with prospects' existing systems.
  • Qualify interest and book demonstrations with suitable prospects against an agreed qualification standard.
  • Match each prospect to the relevant product, using the product information and guidance provided.
  • Manage callbacks and follow-up calls where prospects are not immediately available.
  • Confirm booked demonstrations to reduce cancellations and no-shows.

Lead Qualification & Market Intelligence

  • Establish each prospect's current transport management or freight software and provider.
  • Record user numbers, current software costs and satisfaction levels where prospects are willing to share them.
  • Identify whether the prospect is considering a change of system, the reasons for it and the expected timescale.
  • Identify the decision-makers involved in purchasing.
  • Build market intelligence on competitor systems, pricing and customer requirements.

CRM & Database Management

  • Log every call attempt, outcome and conversation note in Zoho CRM.
  • Verify and update contact names, job titles, telephone numbers and LinkedIn profiles.
  • Apply the existing lead statuses and tags, and schedule callbacks and follow-up tasks.
  • Record demonstration bookings, outcomes and pipeline information accurately.
  • Clean the database alongside outbound calling, without letting it take priority over appointment generation.

Post-Demonstration Follow-Up

  • Contact prospects within one working day of a demonstration delivered by the client.
  • Establish feedback, level of interest, remaining questions and objections.
  • Confirm next steps and purchasing timescales, and follow up on outstanding decisions.
  • Arrange further discussions where required, without duplicating the work of the client's internal sales team.

Reporting & Compliance

  • Provide a weekly performance report that separates activity levels from commercial outcomes, including objections heard and competitor information gathered.
  • Screen calls against TPS/CTPS and follow UK telephone marketing and data protection rules.
  • Send emails only for appointment confirmations or when a prospect asks for information.
  • Take part in regular performance reviews and suggest improvements to messaging and qualification.

Systems

  • Zoho CRM
  • LinkedIn
  • Email and calendar tools
    Experience with every system is not essential, but you must be confident learning new technology.

What We're Looking For

Essential

  • Proven experience in B2B outbound appointment setting.
  • Confident speaking with business owners and senior decision-makers.
  • Strong telephone communication and objection-handling skills.
  • Experience identifying pain points and qualifying opportunities.
  • Experience working with a CRM system.
  • Excellent organisation and accurate record-keeping.
  • A proactive, professional and commercially focused approach.
  • A track record of consistently achieving appointment targets.
  • Excellent spoken and written English.

Advantageous

  • Experience in SaaS or business software sales.
  • Experience in freight forwarding, logistics or transport management systems.
  • Experience using Zoho CRM.
  • Experience calling UK businesses.

Key Performance Indicators
You will be measured on qualified demonstrations that actually take place. The target is a minimum of three each week once an agreed onboarding period ends. Only demonstrations with a relevant decision-maker who has a genuine requirement count towards it. You will also be expected to log every call in Zoho CRM, follow up within one working day after each demonstration and work through the full database systematically.

Working Arrangements

  • An initial onboarding period will allow you to learn the products, CRM processes and target market.
  • You will report weekly on activity and outcomes and take part in regular performance reviews.
  • Technical, pricing, commercial and contractual matters are referred to the client's business owner.

Remote Work Requirements

Applicants must:

  • Be based in South Africa.
  • Have a modern laptop or PC with an Intel i5 / AMD Ryzen 5 processor or equivalent and a minimum of 8GB RAM.
  • Have a stable fibre connection with a minimum of 50 Mbps download and 50 Mbps upload.
  • Have a functional UPS, inverter or power station that can run the router and laptop for at least 2–4 hours during load shedding.
  • Have a professional noise-cancelling headset with a clear microphone.
  • Have a quiet workspace suitable for calls and video meetings.
  • Be available for the agreed hours during UK business times.

jobs.excerpt: About the CollaborationOIKONOMAKIS LAW is a cross-border legal practice acting for private and corporate clients in international matters.
jobs.description:
About the Collaboration

OIKONOMAKIS LAW is a cross-border legal practice acting for private and corporate clients in international matters. We originate and retain the client relationship on the matters we place with national counsel, remain substantively involved in legal strategy and legal production, and use locally authorised lawyers for the host-law, reserved, procedural and court-facing work that requires national qualification or local rights.

Our objective is to build a small, non-exclusive panel of national counsel who already work in this manner with foreign law firms. We are not looking for a nominal signature or a referral-only relationship. Each paid matter is separately conflicted, scoped, priced and accepted before work begins.

Firm website:

The Firm’s Managing Partner, Christos Oikonomakis, is a Greek-qualified lawyer and is registered in Israel as a foreign lawyer.

Within the applicable Israeli regulatory framework governing foreign lawyers, Mr. Oikonomakis provides legal services in Israel concerning Greek law, within the scope permitted by his professional qualification and foreign-lawyer registration.

His status as a registered foreign lawyer does not authorize him to practice Israeli law.

OIKONOMAKIS LAW is therefore seeking to establish an independent professional collaboration with an experienced Israeli lawyer based in Tel Aviv or the wider Tel Aviv District who can independently undertake the Israeli-law components of cross-border matters handled by Mr. Oikonomakis and the Firm.

Nature of the Opportunity

This is not an employment position.

We are inviting proposals for an independent professional collaboration between OIKONOMAKIS LAW / Christos Oikonomakis and an Israeli legal practitioner or independent Israeli legal practice.

The participating lawyers and legal practices will remain fully:

* professionally independent;

  • legally and scientifically independent;

* financially independent;

* organizationally independent; and

* corporately independent.

Each lawyer or legal practice will remain independently responsible for:

  • the legal advice and services provided by them;
  • compliance with the professional and regulatory framework applicable to their own practice;

* professional conduct requirements;

  • professional liability and insurance arrangements applicable to them;
  • their own professional decisions and legal opinions; and
  • the conduct of those parts of each matter falling within their respective professional qualification and authorization.

The collaboration may operate on a case-by-case, referral, co-counsel and/or continuing professional collaboration basis depending upon the nature and volume of cross-border matters.

Scope of Collaboration

Cross-border matters may involve circumstances where Mr Oikonomakis provides advice concerning Greek law while the same transaction, dispute or client matter simultaneously raises issues of Israeli law.

In such circumstances, the selected Israeli lawyer may be independently instructed to undertake the relevant Israeli-law workstream.

This may include, where appropriate:

* advising on Israeli law;

* preparing Israeli legal opinions;

  • identifying Israeli-law implications arising from cross-border matters;
  • drafting and reviewing contracts governed by Israeli law;

* corporate and commercial matters;

* company and investment matters;

* civil and commercial disputes;

* litigation and dispute resolution;

  • recognition and enforcement of foreign judgments;
  • arbitration and alternative dispute resolution;

* property and real estate matters;

* immigration and residency matters;

* inheritance and succession matters;

  • family and private client matters involving Greece and Israel;

* banking and regulatory matters;

  • dealings with Israeli public authorities, registries and institutions;
  • representation before Israeli courts, tribunals or authorities where professionally appropriate;
  • negotiations with Israeli counterparties;

* conducting Israeli legal research;

  • preparing Israeli-law memoranda and procedural documentation; and
  • cooperating with Greek and other international counsel on multi-jurisdictional matters.

The objective is to provide clients with coordinated and efficient cross-border assistance while ensuring a clear division between Greek-law legal services and Israeli-law legal services.

Regulatory Structure

The proposed cooperation is designed specifically to respect the professional boundaries applicable to foreign lawyers operating in Israel.

Mr. Christos Oikonomakis will provide legal services only within the scope of his foreign professional qualification and registration in Israel, including advice and legal work concerning Greek law.

Any legal service that constitutes the practice of Israeli law will be undertaken independently by the appropriately qualified Israeli lawyer.

The Israeli collaborating lawyer will retain complete professional control and responsibility for the Israeli-law component of any matter entrusted to them.

Requirements

Applicants must:

  • be fully admitted to practice law in Israel;
  • be current members of the Israel Bar Association;
  • be legally authorized to practice Israeli law;

* be in good professional standing;

  • have a minimum of five (5) years of post-qualification legal experience;
  • maintain the professional arrangements and insurance appropriate to their practice;
  • be based in Tel Aviv or otherwise able to provide effective legal services throughout Israel;
  • possess excellent legal drafting, research and analytical skills;
  • demonstrate the ability to handle matters independently;
  • have strong professional judgment and client-management abilities;
  • have excellent written and spoken Hebrew;
  • have excellent written and spoken English; and
  • maintain high standards of confidentiality, professional ethics and responsiveness.

Preferred Experience

Particular consideration will be given to lawyers experienced in one or more of the following areas:

* Corporate and Commercial Law

* Commercial Litigation

* Civil Litigation

* Contract Law

  • International and Cross-Border Disputes

* Private International Law

  • Recognition and Enforcement of Foreign Judgments
  • Arbitration and Alternative Dispute Resolution

* Real Estate and Property Law

* Immigration and Residency

* Inheritance and Succession

* Family and Private Client Law

* International Business Transactions

* Banking and Regulatory Matters

* International Investments

Experience involving:

* international clients;

* European businesses;

* Greek individuals or companies;

* Israeli investments in Greece;

  • Greek investments or interests in Israel;

* cross-border Greece–Israel disputes;

  • real estate transactions involving Greece and Israel; or
  • clients with legal interests in both jurisdictions will be considered a significant advantage.

Knowledge of the Greek language is advantageous but not required.

Professional Independence

The selected collaborator will not become an employee of OIKONOMAKIS LAW by virtue of this collaboration.

The arrangement is intended to preserve the complete legal, professional, scientific, organizational and corporate independence of all participating lawyers and legal practices.

There will be no employment relationship solely by reason of the collaboration.

Each matter will be subject to:

  • appropriate conflict-of-interest checks;

* acceptance by the relevant lawyer;

* agreement on the scope of work;

  • clear allocation of professional responsibility;
  • applicable regulatory and professional requirements; and

* agreement on professional fees.

What We Are Looking For

We are particularly interested in establishing a long-term professional relationship with a reliable, experienced and commercially minded Israeli lawyer who is comfortable operating independently while coordinating efficiently with international counsel.

The collaboration may include:

* individual client referrals;

* Greece–Israel cross-border matters;

  • Israeli-law workstreams within larger international files;
  • joint coordination of multi-jurisdictional disputes;

* transactional matters;

* international investments;

* private-client matters; and

  • continuing collaboration regarding clients with legal and commercial interests in both Greece and Israel.

The objective is not to create an employment relationship, but to establish a reliable professional cooperation between independent legal practitioners.

Application

Interested lawyers are invited to submit:

* a current CV or professional profile;

  • Israel Bar Association membership details;
  • confirmation of current authority to practice Israeli law;
  • details of their existing law firm or independent legal practice;

* principal areas of practice;

  • confirmation of at least five years of post-qualification professional experience;
  • a summary of relevant international and cross-border experience;

* languages spoken;

  • confirmation of appropriate professional arrangements;
  • their preferred structure for professional collaboration; and
  • indicative hourly and/or matter-based professional rates.

Applications and proposals will be treated confidentially and will remain subject to professional conflict and regulatory checks.
