We are looking for a Senior Director, Business Design to join our team. At Runyon, Business Designers drive the analysis of the viability of products and ventures, and articulate how optimal business models shape the experience, and vice versa. They consider a series of monetization opportunities, operational considerations as well as the growth implications to scale into market while maintaining a firm understanding of the underlying market dynamics of incumbent position, emergent players and value exchange across key stakeholders in the ecosystem.

This role requires someone who is highly strategic, detail-oriented, and experienced in financial modeling, performing competitive analyses, creating growth strategies and testing value hypotheses and growth hypotheses from low to increasing live fidelity. They have the ability to develop a deep understanding of a partner’s business and translate those into a plan of action. They develop strong relationships and build trust with core decision-makers, both internally and externally.

About Runyon

Runyon is a product design and venture studio that helps companies grow. We are a team of customer-centered designers, researchers, and strategists that crafts new products, experiences and ventures. Our approach combines customer needs and behaviors with leading edge business strategy. Our work is sprint- and prototype-driven and we think about how we can craft strategies and products into the market in ways that are meaningful and measured from the start. Our team has decades of experience working with some of the largest global partners including Disney, The New York Times, American Express, Target and others.

  • We're prototyping-led. We lead with tangible assumptions in the form of prototypes and test them with real stakeholders to validate and refine our strategy and design. Regardless of discipline, we think and communicate in concepts, and use those to move further, faster.
  • We're detailed and intentional. We always back up our design decisions with sound reasoning—be it user research, market research, or both. We make things that make sense and that have a clear through line.
  • We're fast. We work almost exclusively in sprints, and with lean teams. We need folks who like to run.
  • We're collaborative. We jam as a multidisciplinary team of specialists who collectively contribute to the full spectrum of work across user research, strategy and design to arrive at high quality outcomes.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Actively participate in ideation sessions with cross-functional teams to conceptualize new experiences, products, services, and ventures that create differentiated market opportunities
  • Collaborate with internal teams and senior client partners to define strategic success criteria, business objectives, and opportunities for growth
  • Design profitable new products, brands, services, business models, and ventures, translating strategic opportunities into tangible, market-ready solutions
  • Shape growth and go-to-market strategies for new products and ventures, aligning business, financial, and operational objectives
  • Craft design-driven market and competitive analyses that uncover opportunities, inform strategic direction, and position our partners for differentiation
  • Develop financial models that establish what needs to be true for revenue growth, product and venture success, and long-term business sustainability
  • Shape operational plans, resource strategies, and strategic partnerships that support product development, venture incubation, and business growth
  • Develop and lead experiments that generate actionable insights, validate opportunities, and inform strategic product and venture roadmaps
  • Evaluate emerging technologies, including AI-enabled capabilities, and identify opportunities to integrate them into meaningful product, service, and venture solutions
  • Establish deep partnerships with cross-functional teams and client stakeholders, ensuring alignment and collaborative progress toward key strategic and product milestones

QUALIFICATIONS

  • 7+ years of experience as a business designer, business strategist, or business analyst at a design studio, consultancy, or internally within an organization
  • Fluent in business acumen, including knowledge in strategy, marketing, finance, operations and product development
  • Ability to build and interpret financial models to quantify business impact
  • Ability to interpret and communicate complex business ideas to different audiences, in addition to listening and modifying your thinking based on the contributions and perspectives of others
  • Ability to easily adapt, and switch between different projects, businesses and industries
  • A desire to engage with collaborative, multi-disciplinary teams which include our partners
  • A proven track record of successfully launched products as a business designer, product manager, product growth strategist, and/or as a startup founder
  • Great communication and time management abilities, including the skill to direct and manage small teams and judiciously involve investors, experts, and stakeholders
  • You thrive in ambiguity, and have a propensity to experiment with generative ideas in order to identify the most innovative and disruptive solutions

Please note that this job posting remains active as part of our ongoing effort to build a network of talented designers, strategists, researchers, and other creative professionals. As a result, it may not correspond to an immediate opening. Runyon’s dynamic, fast-paced environment makes this ideal for candidates who thrive in flexible, project-based roles.

🚀 Be part of a movement to change the way Europe pays

In today’s digital Europe, payments still feel too complicated. Random delays, confusing rules, extra apps and accounts make it harder than it should be to pay and get paid.

The European Payments Initiative is changing that with Wero, a proudly European digital wallet to make payments easier, clearer and more secure. Online, in store, at home and across borders, with your money and data protected under European laws and regulations.

Wero is live in Belgium, France and Germany and launching very soon in Luxembourg and the Netherlands. Backed by 16 major banks and the two largest European acquirers, we’re building a brand new, proudly European payment system. Why not join us?

🔎 What's in it for you

Play a key role in onboarding and certifying banks, acquirers, and payment service providers across Europe onto the Wero network. Working at the crossroads of API testing, end-to-end certification, and partner engagement, you will collaborate closely with external stakeholders to ensure seamless integrations. This is a unique opportunity to join a remote-first, high-impact environment where you directly contribute to the quality, interoperability, and reliability of Europe's next-generation payments infrastructure.

🐝 About the team

You’ll join the Member Quality Assurance team within Operations Services Delivery. The team is responsible for coordinating, scoping and validating testing activities for EPI member institutions, helping banks, acquirers and PSPs successfully integrate with Wero.

You’ll work closely with external member banks, acquirers, PSPs and test tooling partners, as well as internal Product, Payment Experience, Infrastructure and Operations teams. This is a collaborative role for someone who enjoys combining structured testing, technical investigation and clear partner communication.

💥 Your impact

  • Scope testing requirements and guide member banks, acquirers and PSPs through end-to-end certification with clear instructions and hands-on technical support.

  • Review and validate member test outcomes against EPI specifications, scheme standards and compliance rules to ensure seamless integration.

  • Investigate technical issues during testing, analyse distributed system logs and inspect API payloads to identify and resolve blockers quickly.

  • Execute internal tests to identify edge cases, inconsistencies and system gaps before member releases.

  • Convert manual test scenarios into automated test cases and contribute to the continuous improvement of testing frameworks and tooling.

  • Maintain comprehensive records of test results, defects, decisions and resolutions in Jira and Confluence for full traceability and auditability.

  • Collaborate with Product, Payment Experience, Infrastructure and Operations stakeholders to ensure testing feedback is understood and translated into product and process improvements.

💻 Technology stack & way of working

  • Testing & API tools: REST APIs, JSON, Postman, Bruno, API scripting and automation, Fime test tools

  • Tracking & collaboration: Jira, Confluence

  • Ways of working: Agile methodology, daily stand-ups, cross-functional collaboration and close interaction with external partners

🕵🏻‍♀️ To succeed, you should meet at least 70% of these requirements

  • +3 years of professional experience in QA, testing, technical operations or a similar role, ideally within payments, banking or fintech.

  • A degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field is preferred, or equivalent practical experience.

  • Fluent in English (CEFR C1 or C2); French, German, Dutch or other European languages are a plus.

  • Thrive in a remote-first, multicultural and fast-paced environment.

  • Strong experience in end-to-end and integration testing across multi-tier or distributed architectures.

  • Hands-on proficiency with REST APIs, JSON data contracts and API testing or scripting tools such as Postman or Bruno.

  • Solid experience reading system logs, debugging integration errors and troubleshooting issues across distributed services.

  • Demonstrated experience working directly with external partners, member institutions, clients or technical stakeholders such as Project Leads and Test Managers.

  • Proficiency with test management workflows, issue tracking and documentation using tools such as Jira and Confluence.

  • Ability to translate complex technical findings into clear guidance for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Nice to haves

  • Familiarity with European payment schemes and rails such as SEPA, Instant Payments, SWIFT or card schemes.

  • Experience with payment gateways, processors, core banking platforms or mobile banking integrations.

  • Understanding of regulatory and scheme certification standards such as PSD2 or scheme compliance.

  • Knowledge of reconciliation, clearing and settlement workflows.

🪜 If this looks like you, the recruitment steps are:

  1. A first call with one of our recruiters

  2. A culture interview with the hiring manager

  3. A technical interview with Test Engineer

  4. Hopefully, an offer you can’t refuse

⛔ Turn back if …

  • You prefer working in a purely internal or isolated testing environment without direct external partner or bank interaction.

  • You shy away from digging into logs, investigating API discrepancies or multitasking across several onboarding and certification tracks.

  • You are looking for a rigid, fully static environment rather than an evolving, agile pan-European initiative.

🎁 What we can offer

  • Remote-first culture with quarterly and annual all-staff in-person meetups to keep teams connected and collaborative

  • Possibility to work from another EU country for up to 3 months per year

  • Competitive compensation package, featuring salary, performance-based bonus and a thoughtfully designed, high-quality benefits programme

  • The opportunity to be part of a true pan-European company

  • Learning & development budget: €5,000 training budget per year

Otherwise apply!

EPI offers the same job opportunities to all, without distinction of gender, ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, social status, disability or age. EPI promotes the development of an inclusive work environment that mirrors the diversity of the clients our product is serving.

jobs.description:
This is a remote position.

Executive Sales

Summary

I am looking for a few highly skilled and sophisticated sales leaders to manage “Make A Deal Meetings” where we propose partnership terms, negotiate terms and close deals with high-producing and established real estate businesses and small service-based businesses, over Zoom Meetings.

Our successful candidates will represent Fusion in these negotiations with individuals who have already been through an “Explanation of Investment” who have self-identified as someone who would like to have our investment IF we can arrange the financial terms in such as way that it will fit into their business. The goal is to help the person make a decision in that meeting at terms that are agreeable to our firm and execute the agreement. The meetings last between 1 and 3 hours and we will arrange 2 to 4 meetings per day. Our current closing ratio is just under 50% when the prospect shows for the meeting.

The income range is $180,000 to $300,0000 annually.

If you have an interest, PLEASE READ THE ENTIRE AD BEFORE APPLYING. WE PROVIDE EXTENSIVE INFORMATION ABOUT THE COMPANY AND THE POSITION.

Job Description

Our Sales Leader is a closer and a negotiate. We generate business from cold calls and set up meetings for our Partnership Development Executives to walk them through a VERY DETAIL explanation of our business model and how we invest into these small business operations.

At the end of the Investment presentation our Executives pose two primary questions,

1. Does the Prospect “love” the business model concept?

And

2. Does the Prospect believe that over time that if we provide all the services we covered consistently over months, would their business significantly improve?

Only if a prospects answers affirmatively to both questions will the meeting continue. IF the answers are yes, we then explain our “Make A Deal” meeting process. The “Make A Deal Meeting” is basically a meeting where both parties come together in one meeting to try and figure out agreeable terms to both parties and close the deal and execute the meeting ideally in one meeting. We start by proposing reasonable terms and a financial model for our investment of resources and then we are willing to improve pricing IF they are ready to move forward. To help lubricate the sales process, we offer a two-week rescission period and a guarantee of income growth of hundreds of thousands of dollars if they follow our program.

About the Company

Fusion Growth Partners is a business incubator and micro venture capital company. We invest resources in businesses that are experiencing success at certain levels but have a high desire to grow a lot more. We invest in a unique way where most investors would never consider these types of businesses. When we partner with small service-based businesses of individual real estate agents, we invest heavily into their businesses to them significantly grow their clientele and scale business profits. We consider ourselves as a “Partnership as a Service” business similar to, but different than, a SaaS business. Fusion was recently ranked as the 813th fastest-growing business by Inc. 5000. Therefore, we consider this role to be one of the best opportunities for sales professional business advisors available today.

Our partners benefit from Fusion providing their business with sophisticated growth planning, a full suite of back-office services and SaaS resources, plus the support of our experienced staff. Fusion is the only company in the country that currently offers these services and is compensated in a way that conveniently accommodates the cash flow challenges of a real estate agent. We have over 300 team members and are growing very quickly. We need more talent to enter untouched markets.

Fusion invests in companies through strategic revenue-sharing growth partnerships. Our investment resources include, but are not limited to, thousands of dollars of business building systems and processes and the staff to operate those business systems which are all provided as an investment into our partners' businesses. Fusion’s income is primarily generated from a small share of the revenue generated by our partner’s businesses. Our company is looking to hire additional Partnership Development Executives to support our rapidly growing volume of new partnership investments.


Requirements

Desired Candidate Attributes

We are looking for individuals who are of the highest negotiation and closing skill level possible. We have a great position for those who love to close sales enjoy the satisfaction of accomplishing the desired goal. However, we are selling a relationship, not a product and therefore our candidate(s) must not embellish in anyway, or mislead in anyway, create expectations that will not be realized, because this will create service and investment scenarios that will hurt our company’s reputation and brand.

Our sales process has already been engineered and the closing ration is high, BUT it takes finesse and requires awareness of the nuances of prospects emotional decision-making processes.

We want professionals who have the highest level of closing skill for true sales professionals, but we do not want “know it all’s” who are not coachable or not willing to learn our playbook. Our individuals must be willing to be team players.

We want individuals who have business savvy and acumen, extensive experience in closing sales with a short sales cycle. We are looking for individuals who we can rely on. They do what they say they will do every time.

We want hungry people. We want salespeople who have finesse, confidence and yet carry themselves with an air of humbleness.

Location: 100% Remote

Employment: Full-time, long-term position

Start date: As soon as possible after selection and agreement

Salary: Startup-aligned starting compensation, based on experience and responsibilities, with the potential for substantial growth during the first few years

About UsWe are a startup developing software products, web applications, AI-powered tools, integrations, and business automations across different projects.

Our delivery model combines internal ownership with outsourced development. We work with external developers and specialists, and we need strong technical leadership to turn their contributions into reliable, maintainable software.

AI-assisted and agentic development are central to how we work. We want to move quickly, make sensible technical decisions, and build solutions that our team can understand, operate, and improve.

We are looking for an experienced engineer who wants to join at an early stage, take meaningful responsibility, and grow with the company.

Job DescriptionWe are seeking a Senior AI & Full-Stack Engineer who can develop applications across frontend and backend, integrate AI capabilities, and manage the Linux infrastructure, databases, and deployment processes supporting them.

You should be comfortable taking a project from an initial business requirement through implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing operation. You will work across different products and internal initiatives, helping us choose practical solutions and deliver them efficiently.

Alongside hands-on engineering, your responsibilities may include leading developers, mentoring less experienced colleagues, coordinating outsourced contributors, and reviewing externally delivered work. Previous team leadership and mentoring experience are therefore important.

This is an opportunity to help establish the engineering foundations of a growing startup and develop into a broader technical leadership position.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain web applications across frontend and backend.
  • Build AI-powered features, integrations, internal tools, and business automations.
  • Use AI coding assistants and coding agents effectively, with appropriate testing and human review.
  • Translate business requirements into clear implementation tasks and verifiable acceptance criteria.
  • Design APIs, business logic, authentication, authorization, and third-party integrations.
  • Manage database schemas, migrations, query performance, backups, and recovery procedures.
  • Administer Linux servers, including application services, permissions, updates, networking, and troubleshooting.
  • Build and maintain Docker environments, including container networking, persistent storage, configuration, and health checks.
  • Manage DNS records, domain routing, TLS certificates, and reverse proxies.
  • Maintain CI/CD workflows using GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps Pipelines, and appropriate build agents or runners.
  • Carry out deployments with migration checks, rollback procedures, and post-deployment verification.
  • Investigate production incidents and address their underlying causes.
  • Coordinate outsourced developers and specialists, clarify requirements, review deliverables, and manage technical dependencies.
  • Mentor developers through code reviews, practical demonstrations, and constructive feedback.
  • Keep implementation proportionate to the problem, controlling unnecessary complexity, infrastructure costs, and maintenance overhead.

Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated senior-level experience delivering and maintaining production web applications.
  • Strong frontend development skills using a modern framework, JavaScript or TypeScript, HTML, and CSS.
  • Strong backend development experience, including secure APIs, integrations, validation, and error handling.
  • Practical experience integrating AI or LLM capabilities into software, including checking output quality, handling failures, and managing latency and usage costs.
  • Substantial hands-on experience with AI coding assistants or agentic development workflows, with examples of working results you independently verified.
  • Strong SQL and relational database experience, including migrations, indexing, performance analysis, and backup and recovery.
  • Hands-on Linux administration and Docker deployment experience.
  • A working understanding of DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, TLS, firewalls, ports, and reverse proxies.
  • Practical CI/CD experience with GitHub Actions and familiarity with Azure DevOps repositories, pipelines, and build agents.
  • Strong Git, pull-request, code-review, and release-management skills.
  • Previous experience leading a development team or coordinating technical delivery.
  • Proven mentoring experience and the ability to explain technical decisions clearly.
  • Experience working with outsourced developers, contractors, or distributed teams.
  • The ability to work independently, prioritize competing needs, and make sound decisions with a limited startup budget.
  • Interest in a long-term, full-time role with increasing responsibility.

Especially Valuable Experience

  • Building products or engineering processes in an early-stage startup.
  • Taking responsibility for several applications or services at the same time.
  • Evaluating outsourced work for correctness, security, maintainability, and operational readiness.
  • Developing AI agents, tool integrations, retrieval workflows, or reliable automation.
  • Operating PostgreSQL and multi-service Docker environments.
  • Establishing deployment standards, monitoring, incident procedures, and practical documentation.
  • Helping junior developers become more effective through structured mentoring.

Growth, Responsibility and CompensationJoining at this stage offers the opportunity to influence how we build software, organize delivery, and develop our engineering team.

Initial compensation will reflect our startup budget, your experience, and the agreed scope of responsibility. As your contribution and responsibilities grow alongside the business, we aim to provide substantial salary progression during the first few years.

For a strong contributor, the role can develop into positions such as Technical Lead, Engineering Lead, or Head of Engineering. Progression will depend on demonstrated results, leadership capability, company growth, and financial capacity. Compensation expectations and progression milestones will be discussed openly during recruitment.

What We Offer

  • A fully remote, full-time role with a long-term perspective.
  • Direct involvement in technical decisions across multiple products and initiatives.
  • The opportunity to build, lead, and mentor a distributed engineering team.
  • Broad ownership across software, AI integration, infrastructure, and delivery.
  • Close collaboration with startup leadership.
  • The potential for significant career and compensation growth as the company develops.

Remote Working ArrangementOur remote working setup includes a time-tracking tool that records mouse-click and keyboard-activity metrics and captures screenshots of the screen. This monitoring is part of the working arrangement and will be explained during the recruitment process.

Applicants should be comfortable working with this setup.

How to ApplyWe are looking to fill this core engineering role promptly. Applying early gives us the opportunity to discuss how you could help shape our technical direction from the beginning.

Please submit your CV and a short overview covering:

  • A production application you helped deliver and your own frontend and backend contributions.
  • An AI feature or agentic workflow you implemented and how you verified its results.
  • Your Linux, Docker, database, and deployment responsibilities.
  • A team you led or developers you mentored, including the outcomes.
  • Your experience coordinating outsourced development and reviewing external deliverables.
  • Your earliest start date and salary expectations, taking our startup stage into account.

Public portfolio links and GitHub repositories are welcome. Please do not share confidential customer information or credentials.

jobs.excerpt: Thank you for your interest in interning at the International Centre for Missing & Exploited Children (ICMEC).
jobs.companyName: The International Centre for Missing and Exploited Children
jobs.description:
Thank you for your interest in interning at the International Centre for Missing & Exploited Children (ICMEC). Interns contribute substantially to the work of ICMEC, and ICMEC’s staff work closely with interns to make the experience as rewarding as possible.

The International Centre for Missing & Exploited Children (ICMEC) is a private, nonprofit organization established more than 25 years ago. ICMEC is headquartered in the United States, with formal representation in numerous countries around the globe. ICMEC works to make the world a safer place for children by defending against child sexual exploitation, abuse, and the risk of going missing. ICMEC works with partners around the world to develop research, technologies, and educational resources to aid in the search and recovery of children who are missing, fight child sexual exploitation and empower caring professionals, institutions, and communities to safeguard children from all forms of sexual abuse.

The Koons Family Institute on International Law & Policy (The Koons Family Institute) is ICMEC’s in-house research arm. The Koons Family Institute defends children against sexual exploitation, abuse, or risk of going missing on multiple fronts by conducting and commissioning original research into the status of child protection laws around the world, creating replicable legal tools, promoting best practices, bringing together great thinkers and opinion leaders, and collaborating with partners to identify and measure threats to children and ways ICMEC can advocate change.

Our Mission
ICMEC envisions a world where children can grow up safe from exploitation, abuse, or the risk of going missing. We believe every child deserves a safe childhood. ICMEC’s mission is to advance child protection and safeguard vulnerable children around the world.

We do this by:

  • building and improving systems to prevent and respond to cases of missing children, child sexual exploitation, or abuse;
  • advocating for enhanced laws and policies;
  • mobilizing industries to secure their technologies and platforms from becoming vehicles for abuse and exploitation;
  • providing tools and training for criminal justice professionals to effectively investigate and prosecute cases of exploitation, abuse or children who are missing;
  • safeguarding school environments; and
  • empowering healthcare professionals to recognize and respond to child abuse and exploitation cases.

As the workload of ICMEC continues to grow and resources are stretched, the contributions of interns are extremely important. ICMEC interns who share the same belief in our goals help to make the success stories happen. ICMEC offers full‐ and part‐time internships each academic semester. Successful applicants will be highly motivated, detail-oriented, independent students with a passion for public interest work.

*We are now accepting applications for the Fall 2025 intern class.

Internship positions:

The Legal Research Interns will support the Director of The Koons Family Institute by writing, editing, and conducting comprehensive research and analysis on global policies and laws for a variety of publications, reports, white papers, and other projects. Interns may focus on topics such as child sexual abuse material, online grooming, missing children, child sex trafficking, child sexual abuse and exploitation, sextortion, age verification for online platforms, and other related topics. Interns specific projects may include engaging with policy experts within the technology industry and contributing to important discussions surrounding digital safety for children; reviewing global laws and regulations related to age verification and analyzing age verification measures across various countries to identify trends, best practices, and gaps in policy; and summarizing findings into briefs and reports that highlight trends, key insights, and provide policy recommendations for enhancing age verification processes. Interns also may utilize foreign language skills and regional areas of expertise.

Specific requirements by internship position:

Legal Research Internsmust:

  • Be available to work 12 to 15 weeks, at least 15 hours per week (20+ hours preferred) during the Fall or Spring semesters; or
  • Be available to work 8 to 12 weeks, at least 20 hours per week (30+ hours preferred) during the Summer term;
  • Undergo initial and periodic background checks; and
  • Have completed undergraduate studies (working toward a Master’s or Juris Doctorate degree strongly preferred). We will consider students in their sophomore, junior, or senior year of undergraduate studies with relevant experience.

*Internships will be completed primarily remotely, with the possibility of limited in-person interaction in the ICMEC office in Alexandria, Virginia, if conditions allow.

Is the internship paid?

All internships are unpaid.

Is academic credit granted for the internship?

Internships may be granted academic credit (please refer to your school’s internship/externship requirements).

Does ICMEC provide housing?

ICMEC does not provide housing for interns nor do we provide a stipend to cover living expenses.

How do I apply?

An application form is available at . You can submit the application form online and please be sure to include a Statement of Purpose or cover letter, résumé/CV, official or unofficial transcripts, and a writing sample.

Point of Contact:

Internship Coordinator

International Centre for Missing & Exploited Children

2318 Mill Road, Suite 1010

Alexandria, VA 22314

Applications must be received by the application deadline (though deadlines may be extended as needed):

  • Fall Semester - August 23
  • Spring Semester - December 31
  • Summer semester - March 16

Your interest in ICMEC is very much appreciated, and we look forward to helping you have a rewarding and fulfilling experience.

What’s next?

You will hear from us as soon as your application has been reviewed, usually within three (3) weeks.

  • Systems Proficiency: Expert proficiency in AP and accounting systems, specifically NetSuite, Salesforce, and Coupa.

  • Soft Skills: Excellent problem-solving skills, impeccable attention to detail, and the ability to resolve discrepancies efficiently. Must possess strong time management skills to prioritize tasks effectively under pressure and the flexibility to adapt to new processes.

AI Automation & Data Platform Lead

(Build & Scale Our AI-Driven Global Sourcing Platform)

About ASC Global

ASC Global is a global independent distributor and sourcing company serving the electronic-components, computer and data-center, industrial MRO and aviation MRO markets. We source semiconductors, passive components, interconnect products, memory, computer hardware, data-center infrastructure and industrial/aviation parts from suppliers worldwide.

The Opportunity

We're building an AI-driven global sourcing and product-intelligence platform, and we need someone who can both build it and help the rest of the company put AI to work. This is a rare hybrid: part hands-on technical builder, part AI/automation lead for the business. You'll personally architect and ship a system that continuously monitors hundreds of distributor sites, broker inventories, marketplaces and manufacturer sources - identifying products, capturing pricing and availability, and matching listings to canonical parts - while also working directly with our buyers, sales, operations and leadership to find and implement practical AI use cases across the company.

This is not a role where you hand requirements to someone else and wait. You'll write the code, deploy the system, and also run the workshops that get people using it.

What You'll Do

  • Build and operate the crawling, data-ingestion, normalization and matching platform - handling static and JavaScript-rendered sites, PDFs, pagination and multilingual content, with full source provenance on every record

  • Design the canonical product/supplier/offer data model and the entity-resolution logic that matches listings to real parts

  • Use LLMs where they genuinely help (extraction, translation, classification) with proper evaluation, confidence thresholds and human review - never letting a model guess a price or quantity it can't find

  • Connect the platform to Zoho CRM's RFQ workflow and, downstream, QuickBooks

  • Work with Sales, Purchasing, Operations and Finance to spot other processes AI or automation can improve, turn those into real pilots, train employees to use them, and track the impact

What Success Looks Like

  • A working architecture and data model within the first 90 days

  • At least 10 sources connected with full provenance

  • Searchable, normalized product and supplier data

  • Measured matching accuracy

  • Source-health monitoring in place

  • An initial Zoho RFQ integration

  • Beyond that: measurable hours saved, faster sourcing turnaround, broader AI adoption across departments, and a documented plan for scaling to hundreds of sources

What We're Looking For

  • Five or more years of hands-on software/data-engineering experience with real production ownership of web-crawling or large-scale data-acquisition systems - not personal projects or coursework

  • Advanced Python and strong SQL

  • Experience with a production crawling framework (e.g. Scrapy) and browser automation (Playwright or Selenium) for JavaScript-rendered sites

  • Solid grounding in HTTP, rate limiting, retries, queues and failure recovery

  • Experience building normalized pipelines from messy, conflicting data, plus entity resolution / fuzzy matching / deduplication work backed by real accuracy numbers

  • Strong PostgreSQL (or similar), plus Docker and at least one major cloud platform

  • Comfortable using LLM APIs in production - structured outputs, evaluation, cost control - without treating them as a replacement for deterministic checks

  • Personally implemented an AI or automation solution inside a real company (not just used the tools), ideally across more than one department, and comfortable running training and translating business needs into requirements for other engineers

Nice to Have

  • Temporal, Dagster, Prefect or Airflow

  • OpenSearch or Elasticsearch

  • RapidFuzz, Splink or embeddings-based matching

  • Zoho, Salesforce, HubSpot, QuickBooks or other ERP integrations

  • Electronic components or other complex technical catalogs

  • Prior experience as the first or lead engineer on a new platform

Job Title: In-Home Nurse Practitioner or Physician Assistant Per Diem - Mansfield

We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

Do you have a passion for engaging with people and helping them on their journey to better health? Signify Health, part of CVS Health®, is seeking a Per Diem Clinician (Nurse Practitioner or Physician Assistant) to provide In-Home Health Evaluations, engaging with people in the comfort of their own homes and helping bridge gaps in care.

You’ll play a critical role in building trusted relationships to make people healthier, helping bring flexible, comprehensive and personalized health evaluations right to people’s front doors.

Job highlights

The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). You’ll use an iPad and an intuitive clinical workflow for each evaluation and are not required to prescribe medicine, order lab tests or alter people’s current treatment regimen.

In this role, you will:

  • Bring your heart into every visit, joining a national network of purpose-driven clinicians dedicated to improving health outcomes

  • Be part of our efforts to visit millions of people nationwide with the goal of providing connections to the right care for people’s unique needs

  • Work with Signify Health as a clinician colleague, fulfilling the requirements of the specified role

  • Be flexible to travel locally and within licensed states, as needed

  • Conduct virtual visits as needed

  • Provide all Signify Health services as indicated including Diagnostic & Preventive Services products (i.e., spirometry, DEE, bone density screening, etc.)

A Note on Our Work Environment:

As an in-home clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of health plan members. We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants.

Why Clinicians Enjoy Working with Signify Health

"I love seeing health plan members at home. You get a better picture of their health when you see where they live.” - Erica R., PA

“At Signify Health, we have the time to help people and to truly listen to their questions and concerns. We can help guide them so they can take better care of themselves. We really can make a change in communities.” - Ali B., NP

“I like how Signify Health manages my experience. I’m just doing the clinician part of my job without all the administrative responsibilities. I have the time to provide education so people have a better understanding of their health. I can answer their questions without rushing out the door.” - Andrew K., PA

  • Malpractice insurance coverage (during Signify Health-related activities)

  • Supplies and other perks

Required & Preferred Qualifications (NPs and PAs)

  • Board certification (required)

  • Multi-state licenses (preferred)

  • Assist with mock interviews and functional assessments of rater performance as needed.

  • Education:

    • Preferred: MD, DO, or PhD.

  • Experience:

    • At least 1 year of clinical experience with stroke patients.

    • Prior experience administering stroke-related rating scales in clinical trials.

  • Skills:

    • Strong interpersonal and communication skills for professional interaction with raters and trial staff.

jobs.description:
Novakid is an online English school for kids. The Visitor Squad owns the funnel from first visit to paid lesson: landing pages, registration and booking, blog, and the visitor's personal account. We track two key metrics, visitor → lead and visitor → booking, and test almost everything we ship through experiments.

This is a backend-first role: about 70% backend (Python, some ) and 30% frontend (React/TypeScript). You'll own the server side of the funnel: APIs behind registration, booking and the visitor account, attribution, and server-side integrations with ad platforms. When a feature needs frontend work, you'll take it end-to-end yourself. You'll work within the squad's processes: planning, grooming, code review, sprints and releases.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build and maintain Python services and APIs behind the funnel: registration, booking and the visitor account

  • Build and own server-side integrations with ad platforms (Meta CAPI, TikTok Events API and similar): event delivery, deduplication, retries and monitoring

  • Own attribution on the backend: end-to-end visit tracking, UTM persistence, and diagnosing gaps in V2L/V2B data

  • Keep services fast and reliable: caching, query optimization, debugging server-side rendering in our layer

  • Investigate production incidents through Sentry and see them through to resolution

  • Support A/B testing on the server side: feature flags, rollouts, and cleanup after experiments

  • Ship frontend changes in React/TypeScript when a feature needs it

Requirements

  • Requirements

    • 5+ years of production backend development in Python, including services you designed, shipped and supported in production yourself

    • Strong backend fundamentals: API design, relational databases and SQL, caching, background jobs, and integrating third-party APIs (auth, rate limits, retries, idempotency)

    • Production debugging experience: logs, error tracking, finding the root cause of an issue

    • : comfortable reading and changing an Express service

    • Working frontend skills: enough TypeScript and React to deliver a feature end-to-end. Expert level not required.

    • An understanding of how tracking data travels from click to report, and the ability to find where it gets lost

    • Product mindset: you work with metrics and hypotheses, not just tickets

    • Fluent English

    Nice to Have

    • Server-side conversion tracking (CAPI, Events API, server-side GTM)

    • BigQuery: checking your own hypotheses with data

    • CDN and edge caching (CloudFront or similar)

    • GDPR and consent mechanisms

    • E2E testing with Playwright or Cypress

    Our Tech Stack

    Python, , Express (SSR), TypeScript, React, , Sentry, GrowthBook, BigQuery.

    What we offer

    • Fully remote work

    • A chance to shape the future of AI-driven education

    • A fun, dynamic team that loves building innovative products

    • Unlimited holidays, because we trust you to deliver

We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

Do you have a passion for engaging with people and helping them on their journey to better health? Signify Health, part of CVS Health®, is seeking a Full Time Physician to provide In-Home Health Evaluations, engaging with people in the comfort of their own homes and helping bridge gaps in care.

You’ll play a critical role in building trusted relationships to make people healthier, helping bring flexible, comprehensive and personalized health evaluations right to people’s front doors.

Job highlights

The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). You’ll use an iPad and an intuitive clinical workflow for each evaluation and are not required to prescribe medicine, order lab tests or alter people’s current treatment regimen.

In this role, you will:

  • Bring your heart into every visit, joining a national network of purpose-driven clinicians dedicated to improving health outcomes

  • Be part of our efforts to visit millions of people nationwide with the goal of providing connections to the right care for people’s unique needs

  • Work with Signify Health as a clinician colleague, fulfilling the requirements of the specified role

  • Be flexible to travel locally and within licensed states, as needed

  • Conduct virtual visits as needed

  • Provide all Signify Health services as indicated including Diagnostic & Preventive Services products (i.e., spirometry, DEE, bone density screening, etc.)

A Note on Our Work Environment:
As an in-home clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of health plan members. We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants.

Why Clinicians Enjoy Working with Signify Health
“Many of the people I see are shocked that a physician is coming to their home to visit with them one-on-one. When you sit down and have an unhurried conversation about their health, they are impressed, happy, and understand that their health plan and care team cares about them.” - M.L., MD

“The primary care physician gets a snapshot of a person in an office setting, but with Signify Health, we see things like the number of steps to enter their home, the state of disrepair those steps may be in, and the person’s ability to function comfortably and with ease in their own home. We can make referrals to the individual’s health plan, encourage the participation of their loved ones, and ensure their PCPs are aware of their health and overall quality of life.” - C.H., MD

  • Health, dental and vision insurance

  • Paid time off

  • Annual CEU allowance

  • Malpractice coverage

This is a remote position.

Product Owner

Deltid / Fjernarbejde

Om E-SG.cloud

E-SG.cloud er en SaaS virksomhed, der leverer en ESG-rapporteringsløsning til små og mellemstore virksomheder. Vores cloud-baserede software, E-SG.cloud, tilbyder virksomheder en intuitiv og brugervenlig løsning til at væsentliggøre, indsamle og rapportere ESG-data. Efter gældende standarder og love konkretiseres og organiseres ESG rapporteringi én platform. Vores tjenester og produkter hjælper virksomheder med at overvinde udfordringer som skiftende ESG-krav, indsamling af ESG-data fra flere datapunkter, tidskrævende og fejlbehæftede manuelle processer, dårlig datakvalitet og mangel på værktøjer til at kommunikere og udveksle ESG-data på tværs af organisationen.

Om stillingen

Dette er en remote deltidsstilling som Product Owner. Du er ansvarlig for at definere og prioritere funktioner og opgaver af E-SG.cloud-softwaren, oprette og vedligeholde produktbackloggen og arbejde tæt sammen med udviklingsteamet for at levere funktioner og brugerhistorier. Du er ansvarlig for at sikre, at udviklingsteamet har en klar forståelse af produktets vision og mål. Som Product Owner er du også ansvarlig for at sikre, at produktet opfylder kravene fra brugere og interessenter.

Dine ansvarsområder og opgaver omfatter bl.a.:

  • Sikre, at produktet opfylder vores kunders behov
  • Definere og prioritere backlog-emner og produktfunktioner og sikre, at de er i overensstemmelse med produktets vision og mål
  • Samarbejde og arbejde tæt sammen med tværfunktionelle teams for at indsamle feedback og definere brugerkrav
  • Oprette og vedligeholde epics, user stories, acceptkriterier og andre processer og workflows for at støtte udviklingsteamet og forbedre produktudviklingsprocessen
  • Deltage i daglige scrum-møder, sprint-planlægning og sprint-reviews med produktudviklingsteamet.
  • Sikre, at teammedlemmerne har en klar forståelse af produktvisionen, de forventede leverancer, målene for hvert initiativ og tidslinjer og milepæle for nye produktudgivelser.
  • Løbende indsamle og analysere feedback fra interessenter, scrum masters, ingeniørteams og kunder for at informere om vellykkede beslutninger om produktydelse
  • Fungere som det primære kontaktpunkt for udviklingsteamet og interessenter i forbindelse med produktrelaterede problemer.

Vi forestiller os, at du har:

  • Viden om produktstyring og softwareudvikling
  • Erfaring med produktstyringsværktøjer som [JIRA, Trello, Asana].
  • Dokumenteret erfaring med at skabe, optimere og styre produkt roadmaps med succes
  • Erfaring med Agile/Scrum-metodologier
  • En Bachelor- eller kandidatgrad i datalogi, informationsteknologi, forretningsadministration eller projektledelse
  • Analytiske færdigheder
  • Erfaring med at arbejde med fjernteams
  • Kendskab til ESG-rapporteringsstandarder og -rammer er et plus

Desuden er det en fordel, hvis du:

  • Har fremragende kommunikation og interpersonelle færdigheder
  • Har stærke problemløsningsevner og evnen til at tænke kreativt
  • Er detailorienteret og i stand til at håndtere flere prioriteter
  • Er samarbejdsvillig og i stand til at arbejde effektivt med tværfunktionelle teams
  • Er undefokuseret og i stand til at indsamle og analysere feedback for at informere produktbeslutninger
  • Har fejlfrie projektledelsesevner og evnen til at sikre, at produktstrategien altid følger tidsplanen gennem flere iterationer
  • Har solid viden om produktdesign, brugeroplevelse og softwareudviklingsprocesser og best practices

Vi tilbyder:

  • Muligheden for at lære og udvikle sig hver dag.
  • Meget professionelle og kompetente kolleger.
  • Udfordrende og unikke opgaver med en kreativ tilgang til problemløsning.
  • En fælles rejse, hvor vi lærer sammen og støtter hinanden.
  • En fantastisk mulighed for at hjælpe med at sætte den fremtidige retning for E-SG.cloud
  • Stor frihed og fleksibilitet med hensyn til at organisere og planlægge din arbejdsdag.
  • Mulighed for at arbejde hjemmefra. Rejser må forventes.

Vores techstack:

  • Elixier
  • Phoenix Liveview
  • Figma
  • HIX Interface
  • Flowbite UI-bibliotek

Responsibilities

Peraton is seeking a skilled and motivated FinOps Cloud Engineer to support DOI USGS Permitting Modernization and Cloud Infrastructure program. You will serve as the primary financial operations authority for a multi-environment AWS cloud platform supporting 50+ software developers, 20 business analysts, and Government staff engaged in permitting modernization. You will own end-to-end cloud cost management from consumption forecasting to rightsizing recommendations and budget enforcement, following the FinOps Foundation's Inform → Optimize → Operate framework. This is a high-visibility, mission-critical role operating within a FedRAMP-compliant federal environment, directly supporting one of DOI's flagship technology modernization efforts.

Peraton supports the U.S. Department of the Interior (DOI) and U.S. Geological Survey (USGS) in modernizing the federal permitting process through the Permitting Modernization and Cloud Infrastructure program. At the heart of this initiative is the WARP platform (Workflows, Authorizations, Registrations, and Permits), a cloud-native AWS environment purpose-built to streamline and accelerate how the federal government processes permits, authorizations, and registrations. The program leverages cutting-edge cloud infrastructure, AI-assisted decision support, and advanced data engineering to serve a large, distributed team of developers, business analysts, and Government stakeholders. jobs.description:
What We Need

Corpay is looking for a UX Designer to join our Corporate Payments division. In this role, the UX Designer will shape the next generation of digital experiences for our Payables business. You’ll work across a diverse product ecosystem that includes complex web applications, operational and administrative tools, and intuitive end-user experiences. One day, you may be simplifying a high-volume workflow for finance teams; the next, you may be designing tools for administrators or creating a seamless experience for an individual user completing a payment-related task.

This is a hands-on role for a designer who enjoys turning complexity into clarity—and who thrives when ideas move quickly from sketch to prototype to shipped experience. You’ll work in tight feedback loops with Product, Research, Engineering, and fellow designers to frame problems, explore possibilities, test assumptions, and continuously improve what we put in front of customers.

We care deeply about craft, but we don’t confuse perfection with progress. The strongest candidate will know how to choose the right level of fidelity, move decisively with incomplete information, and maintain a high bar for quality while keeping momentum. We’re also looking for a designer who sees AI as an advantage. Not as a replacement for judgment, empathy, or creativity—and not as a shortcut—but as a powerful way to expand exploration, automate repetitive work, accelerate prototyping, challenge assumptions, and produce better work faster. You will collaborate closely with Product, Research, Design, and Engineering partners and report directly into the VP of Product.

How We Work As a UX Designer you will be expected to work in a virtual environment.

Corpay will set you up for success by providing:

  • Company-issued equipment
  • Formal, hands-on training

Role Responsibilities

The responsibilities of this role will include:

  • Designing end-to-end interfaces, interactions, and workflows across Corpay’s Payables product ecosystem.
  • Creating experiences for sophisticated web applications, internal and customer-facing administrative tools, and end-user consumer applications.
  • Simplifying complex financial and operational workflows without losing the depth, control, or flexibility users need.
  • Translating user needs, business goals, and technical constraints into experiences that are clear, useful, and ready to move forward.
  • Producing low-fidelity concepts early and often to help Product teams explore opportunities, clarify scope, and make faster decisions.
  • Creating prototypes at the appropriate level of fidelity for stakeholder alignment, usability research, and development handoff.
  • Partnering with UX Researchers to understand user behaviors, identify unmet needs, test concepts, and turn findings into meaningful product improvements.
  • Working directly with Product Managers and Engineers throughout the development process—not simply at the beginning and end.
  • Using AI-enabled tools thoughtfully and responsibly to accelerate activities such as ideation, workflow exploration, prototyping, research synthesis, content development, and documentation.
  • Protecting customer and company information by using AI tools in accordance with Corpay’s privacy, security, and data-handling standards.
  • Maintaining a prioritized backlog of incremental design improvements and helping the team continuously raise the quality of the Payables experience.
  • Contributing to and evolving Corpay’s UX Design System, including patterns, components, documentation, and standards.
  • Collaborating with developers to keep coded component libraries aligned with the Design System.
  • Designing responsive experiences that work effectively across devices and adapting to the needs of different user types.
  • Balancing speed with usability, accessibility, consistency, and attention to detail.
  • Communicating design rationale clearly, inviting critique, and adapting quickly when new evidence points toward a better solution.
  • Taking on additional high-impact design challenges as the product and business evolve.

Qualifications & Skills

  • At least 4+ years of professional experience in UX, product, or interaction design.
  • A portfolio that demonstrates strong interaction design, clear problem-solving, thoughtful iteration, and collaboration with cross-functional teams.
  • Experience designing complex web applications, administrative platforms, workflow tools, or consumer-facing digital products.
  • Experience working with agile product and development teams.
  • The ability to move comfortably between rough concepts, detailed interface design, interactive prototypes, and implementation support.
  • Strong proficiency with Figma or comparable modern design and prototyping tools.
  • Curiosity about AI and hands-on experience using AI-enabled tools to improve the quality or speed of your design process.
  • Strong product judgment and the ability to determine when a design needs deeper exploration—and when it is ready to move forward.
  • Comfort working through ambiguity, creating clarity, and making progress without waiting for perfect requirements.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, especially in a remote environment.
  • Strong organization, time management, and attention to detail.
  • The ability to work independently while actively seeking input, sharing work early, and contributing to a highly collaborative team.
  • A genuine commitment to understanding users and advocating for their needs.

Helpful, but Not Required

  • A degree or certification in Human-Computer Interaction, interaction design, UX design, or a related field.
  • Experience designing financial products, payment platforms, accounts payable software, enterprise tools, or other transaction-based products.
  • Experience designing for multiple audiences, such as finance professionals, administrators, operations teams, and individual end users.
  • Familiarity with accessibility standards and inclusive design practices.
  • Experience contributing to or maintaining a design system.
  • Experience working successfully on a distributed or remote team.

You’ll Thrive Here If You You like to make ideas tangible. You share work before it feels perfect, learn from feedback, and improve it quickly. You can untangle a complicated workflow, understand the needs of multiple user types, and create an experience that feels focused and intuitive. You can defend a design decision without becoming attached to it. You know that speed and quality are not opposites when a team has strong judgment, clear priorities, and short feedback loops. Most importantly, you are excited about how the designer’s role is evolving. You bring the empathy, taste, curiosity, and critical thinking that technology cannot replace—and you actively use new technology to increase what you are capable of producing.

Benefits & Perks

  • Medical, Dental & Vision benefits available the 1st month after hire
  • Automatic enrollment into our 401(k) retirement savings plan
  • Virtual fitness classes offered company-wide
  • Robust PTO offerings including major holidays, vacation, sick, personal, and volunteer time
  • Employee discounts with major providers (wireless, gym, car rental, and more)
  • Philanthropic support with local and national organizations
  • Fun culture with company-wide contests and prizes

oHigh-ticket Sales

oAccount Management

oBusiness Development

oEducation / Training Sales

oOther niche commercial environments

·Track recruitment metrics including:

oTime to shortlist

oTime to hire

oSource effectiveness

oInterview-to-offer ratio

oOffer acceptance

oQuality of hire

oPipeline health

HR & EMPLOYEE EXPERIENCE — SECONDARY RESPONSIBILITY

Act as the organisation's primary HR support person for day-to-day employee experience and people-related administration.

Employee Engagement

  • Organise team-building activities, celebrations, recognition initiatives, birthdays, work anniversaries, and other employee experience programs.

Employee Support & HR Administration

HR OPERATIONS SUPPORT

The ideal candidate is a headhunter who knows how to find people who are not actively looking for jobs and can distinguish an average salesperson from a genuine A-player.

You should be:

REQUIRED EXPERIENCE

Find the A-players we cannot easily find through traditional recruitment.

  • Manage project scope, priorities, dependencies, risks, and stakeholder communication.
  • Coordinate outsourced developers, review their deliverables, and maintain clear ownership.
  • Mentor colleagues through practical demonstrations, reviews, and knowledge transfer.

Required Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience configuring and managing Power Platform solutions connected to GitHub.

  • Previous responsibility for technical project delivery, including planning and stakeholder communication.
  • Proven experience leading developers, mentoring colleagues, or coordinating distributed contributors.
  • The ability to take ownership of technical problems, communicate their business impact, and carry improvements through to a verified result.

Especially Valuable Experience

Role Purpose

The Head of Information Security & Enterprise Risk Management is a senior executive responsible for designing, governing, and continuously strengthening an enterprise-wide cyber security, information risk, and technology risk framework across a complex, multi-business, multi-technology environment.

This role requires deep specialization in advanced cyber security architecture, global regulatory compliance, and large-scale risk governance.

Key Responsibilities

1. Enterprise Information Security Leadership

  • Design and own the enterprise-wide information security strategy, aligned with global standards (ISO, NIST, COBIT) and evolving threat landscapes
  • Establish and govern security architecture across on-premise, cloud, hybrid, OT, and IoT environments
  • Act as the final authority on cyber risk acceptance, escalation, and mitigation

2. Cyber Risk & Threat Management

  • Lead advanced cyber threat intelligence, attack simulation, and incident response programs
  • Oversee Security Operations Center (SOC) models, including SIEM, SOAR, threat hunting, and forensic investigations
  • Lead crisis response for major cyber incidents, ransomware events, or data breaches

3. Enterprise Risk Management (Technology & Digital Risk)

  • Integrate technology risk, cyber risk, data risk, and third-party risk into the broader ERM framework
  • Conduct quantitative cyber risk assessments (e.g., FAIR methodology)
  • Present risk scenarios and financial impact modeling to the Board and Executive Committee

4. Regulatory, Compliance & Governance

  • Ensure compliance with global and cross-border regulations, including:
    • GDPR, ISO 27001/27701
    • NIST CSF, PCI-DSS
    • Industry-specific cyber regulations (financial, infrastructure, utilities, real estate, etc.)
  • Lead internal and external audits related to information security and technology risk
  • Serve as the primary regulatory and auditor counterpart for cyber and IT risk matters

5. Third-Party & Supply Chain Risk

  • Establish governance for vendor cyber risk, cloud service providers, MSPs, and offshore partners
  • Oversee due diligence, contract security clauses, and continuous monitoring programs

6. Leadership & Capability Building

  • Build and mentor a highly specialized security and risk team (security architects, GRC experts, SOC analysts)
  • Develop long-term cyber capability uplift programs
  • Serve as trusted advisor to CEO, Board, and Group Executives

Required Qualifications (Highly Specialized)

Education

  • Bachelors Degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Systems, or Engineering
  • Masters Degree in Cybersecurity, Information Assurance, Risk Management, or related field (strongly preferred)

Mandatory Global Certifications

Candidates must possess multiple of the following:

  • CISSP (Certified Information Systems Security Professional)
  • CISM (Certified Information Security Manager)
  • CISA (Certified Information Systems Auditor)
  • CRISC (Certified in Risk and Information Systems Control)
  • ISO 27001 Lead Implementer / Lead Auditor
  • Cloud Security Certifications (CCSP, AWS/Azure Security Specializations)

Experience Requirements

  • 15+ years of progressive experience in:
    • Information Security
    • Cyber Risk Management
    • Enterprise Technology Risk
  • Minimum 7–10 years in a regional or global leadership role
  • Proven leadership across large, complex organizations (multi-entity, multi-system, multi-jurisdiction)

The role requires hands-on experience in:

  • Designing enterprise-scale cyber security programs across:
    • Cloud, on-premise, hybrid, OT, and legacy systems
  • Leading major cyber incident response at enterprise or regional level
  • Implementing global security frameworks across multiple countries
  • Presenting cyber risk in financial and strategic terms to Boards
  • Managing cross-border data privacy and regulatory compliance

Behavioral & Leadership Competencies

  • Board-level gravitas and executive presence
  • Ability to translate deep technical risk into business language
  • Strong crisis leadership and decision-making under pressure
  • Proven mentor and builder of local capability

Change Business Partner - MRP

Location: MexicoorUS based remote with travels

The Change Business Partner will lead the people-side implementation of strategic transformation across manufacturing operations.   • Work with local teams to build understanding of how standard costs are created and maintained, including bill of materials (BOM) accuracy, labour and machine rates, and overhead allocation.

  • Support the accuracy and integrity of costing data by identifying gaps in processes, systems, and reporting, and helping teams put the right controls in place.
  • Drive adoption of new ways of working, making sure standard costing becomes embedded in decision-making rather than simply a finance exercise.

Qualifications

  • Experience delivering change management within an industrial or manufacturing environment.
  • Understands and leads for the to-be processes and ways of working.
  • Understanding and advocating good practices in principle and in detail for a range of topics especially standard costing (cost build-up, cost drivers, variance analysis, cost updates) and margin management, but also MRP, planning, and warehousing.
  • Experience supporting or deploying standard costing frameworks within ERP systems (especially Microsoft D365), including training, data validation, and cost centre alignment.
  • Ability to engage both finance and non-finance teams in understanding the operational impact of cost changes, cost performance, and product profitability.

  • Strong communication and facilitation skills, particularly in operational and technical contexts.

jobs.description:
Product Designer, Industrial Solutions

Location: USRemote Job Term: Full-Time

The Opportunity

Picarro is looking for a Product Designer to own the design portfolio across our Industrial Solutions products. This is a hands-on role for someone who thinks in systems, sweats the details, and can move fluidly between design and code. Shaping how our products look, feel, and behave from prototype through production.

Good design at Picarro means something specific: our users are compliance managers, EHS leads, and field operators making high-stakes decisions under real-world constraints. We care about clarity, trust, and workflow efficiency — not engagement or delight for its own sake.

You will define and maintain design standards across Industrial Solutions, contribute directly to prototypes, and make production code contributions that bring designs to life. You will work closely with PM and engineering to ensure design intent survives the handoff, ensuring that what ships matches what was envisioned.

Responsibilities

Design Ownership

Own the design portfolio for Industrial Solutions, establishing and maintaining visual, interaction, and workflow standards across all products. You are the voice of design quality on the team.

User Research & Workflow Design

Deeply understand how industrial customers, compliance managers, EHS leads, and field operators work. Map user journeys, identify friction, and translate complex operational workflows into product experiences that are intuitive under real-world conditions.

Prototype Development

Collaborate with PM to build and refine product prototypes. You contribute, shape, and raise the quality bar before engineering picks work up.

Production Contributions

Make targeted code contributions in production to implement or refine UI and interaction patterns. You bridge the gap between what design specifies and what engineering delivers.

Design Review

Review production PRs for design and UX fidelity. Catch drift between intent and implementation before it reaches customers.

Design System Stewardship

Own and evolve the design system for Industrial Solutions, including components, patterns, and documentation to ensure consistency across the product surface.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Design, HCI, or a related field.
  • 3–5 years of experience in a design engineering, UX engineering, or product design role.
  • A portfolio of shipped product work — we want to see what you’ve built, how you think, and how your design decisions held up in production.
  • Demonstrated ability to design and document complex user workflows, not just screens.
  • Strong visual and UX design sensibility with the vocabulary to clearly articulate design decisions.
  • Proficiency with Figma for user flows, wireframing, prototyping, and handoff.
  • Proficiency in React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS; you can read, write, and contribute to production code.
  • Experience owning or contributing to a design system.
  • Comfortable working closely with both PMs and engineers — you can speak both languages.
  • AI-forward mindset with hands-on experience using AI tools in your design and development workflow.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience designing for data-dense, industrial, or enterprise environments where users are managing complex operational workflows.
  • Comfort working with user research outputs, synthesizing interview findings, usability results, and journey maps to inform design decisions.
  • Experience building prototypes that informed real engineering work, not just mockups.
  • Exposure to backend systems sufficient to understand technical constraints on design decisions.
  • Experience with or understanding of AI agents applied to design or frontend development workflows.
  • Prior experience in a startup or high-growth technology company.

Salary & Benefits:

The base salary range for this full-time position is $130k-$170k, commensurate with experience, qualifications, and location. Total compensation includes base salary, bonus eligibility, and equity.

We offer a comprehensive benefits package including:

  • Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance
  • Flexible Spending Account (FSA) and Health Savings Account (HSA) plans
  • Life, Short-Term Disability, and Long-Term Disability Insurance
  • Flexible Vacation Policy and Paid Holidays
  • Employee Referral Program
  • 401K
  • Social events (summer picnic, holiday party, team lunches, etc.)
  • On-site Health & Wellness programs (fitness challenges, outdoor bootcamp, flu-shots, etc.)

About Picarro:

We are the global leader in delivering timely, trusted, and actionable data through enhanced optical spectroscopy. Our solutions serve diverse applications, including natural gas leak detection, ethylene oxide emissions monitoring, semiconductor fabrication, pharmaceutical, petrochemical, atmospheric science, air quality, greenhouse gas measurements, food safety, hydrology, and ecology. Headquartered in Santa Clara, California, our products are trusted in over 90 countries and supported by over 65 patents related to cavity ring-down spectroscopy (CRDS) technology.

About the Role

We’re looking for bright, curious, and driven graduates from the2025 and 2026 batchto join our fast-growing Engineering teams at Stadium.

At Stadium, we’re redefining how organizations celebrate, reward, and connect with people across the world — through technology, personalization, and delightful experiences. As a fresher joining our Web Development or QA teams, you’ll work on real products used globally, learn from experienced engineers, and grow in an environment that values ownership, clarity, and craftsmanship.

This is a great opportunity for someone who is starting their career in software engineering and wants exposure to real-world product development, high-impact projects, and modern web technologies.

Key Responsibilities

1. Learn and Build Real Product Features

  • Work with senior engineers to understand system architecture, workflows, and coding standards.

  • Contribute to feature development across frontend, backend, or QA automation lines.

  • Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code.

2. Collaborate With Cross-Functional Teams

  • Work closely with Product, QA, and Design to understand requirements and deliver high-quality features.

  • Participate in daily stand-ups, sprint ceremonies, and technical discussions.

3. Develop a Strong Engineering Foundation

  • Strengthen your understanding of data structures, algorithms, and core programming concepts.

  • Gain hands-on experience with tools like Git, JIRA, code review processes, and Agile methodologies.

4. Support Testing, Quality, and Deployment

(For QA roles)

  • Learn manual testing, automated testing frameworks, and quality best practices.

  • Help ensure releases are stable, reliable, and user-friendly.

5. Grow, Iterate, and Improve

  • Take feedback positively and continuously enhance your technical and soft skills.

  • Be proactive in learning new tools, frameworks, and product areas.

Who You Are

Education

  • Any Graduate or Postgraduate from the2025 batch or 2026 batch.

Technical Skills

  • Strong programming fundamentals.

  • Solid problem-solving ability and logical thinking.

  • Good understanding of data structures & algorithms.

  • Familiarity (or interest) inRuby on Rails, Python, Go, JavaScript, jQuery, CSS, HTML, or similar web technologies.

Soft Skills & Mindset

  • Clear communication and willingness to ask questions.

  • Curiosity, ownership, and eagerness to learn from senior engineers.

  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, collaborative product environment.

  • Hunger to build real products that solve real problems.

Why You’ll Love Working at Vinsol | Stadium

You’ll thrive here if you want to:

  • Work with experienced engineers building global-scale products.

  • Learn modern tech stacks and real-world engineering practices.

  • Be part of a culture that values openness, mentorship, and innovation.

  • Take ownership early and grow quickly in your engineering career.

  • Work in a company where your ideas can go live — fast.

  • Developers:₹6 LPA + Bonus +ESOPs

  • QA Engineers:₹5 LPA +ESOPs

  • Remote work after training

  • Swag kits

  • Flexible work environment
