jobs.description:
SignWow is a Deaf-led accessibility technology company dedicated to bridging communication gaps between Deaf, Hard of Hearing, and hearing communities.

Our mission is to bridge communication gaps and expand access, inclusion, and advocacy across the United States by delivering exceptional remote and on-demand sign language interpreting and Deaf-led communication access solutions powered by modern technology.

Our vision is a future where Deaf, Hard of Hearing, and hearing individuals communicate effortlessly through inclusive sign language services, next-generation platforms, and a nationwide ecosystem that supports accessibility in workplaces, healthcare, education, government, and communities.

SignWow provides communication solutions including Video Remote Interpreting (VRI), scheduled interpreting services, accessibility technology, community training, and advocacy-driven support services.

Job Title: Senior Real-Time/ Telephony Engineer
Salary: $130 - $225k
Location: Remote, USA
Reports to: Chief Technology Officer

Closing Date: N/A

We reserve the right to close this vacancy early if we receive sufficient applications for the role. Therefore, if you are interested, pleasesubmityour application as early as possible.

Role Overview

The Senior Real-Time / Telephony Engineer will lead the call path end to end. This role will work across video, voice, signaling, and carrier integration, and will be our deep specialist for SIP, WebRTC, media interop, and emergency calling. As we operate across multiple regions locally and globally, you will become the senior escalation point for call-path and media incidents wherever they happen.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage SIP integration with carrier partners, including trunk configuration and call routing logic.
  • Lead WebRTC media end to end: signaling, ICE/STUN/TURN, codec negotiation, and interop between WebRTC and SIP endpoints.
  • Support number provisioning, porting, and lifecycle management across regions.
  • Implement and test emergency-calling workflows, including E911/NG911 in North America and equivalent routing in other regions.
  • Monitor and troubleshoot call quality, including jitter, packet loss, and latency.
  • Serve as Tier 3 escalation for live call-path and media incidents as part of an on-call rotation.
  • Navigate telephony and regulatory differences across SignWow operating regions.

Skills & Experience Required - Essential

  • Strong VoIP fundamentals: SIP, RTP, SDP, and real-time signaling.
  • Hands-on WebRTC experience, including media servers and connectivity (ICE/STUN/TURN).
  • Experience integrating carrier or SIP-trunk providers in production.
  • Comfortable debugging live calls with packet captures, for example Wireshark.
  • Uses AI tools to work faster while retaining responsibility for design, architecture, and judgment calls.
  • Comfortable carrying a pager and leading incident response on an always-on service.

Skills & Experience Required - Desirable

  • Emergency-calling experience, such as E911/NG911 or international equivalents.
  • Number porting and provisioning at scale.
  • Experience running self-hosted real-time media infrastructure.
  • Multi-region or multi-carrier telecom exposure.
  • American Sign Language (ASL) knowledge is a strong plus.

Our Stack

  • WebRTC and self-hosted real-time media infrastructure.
  • SIP and telephony through specialist carrier partners.
  • TypeScript / Node ecosystem.
  • PostgreSQL, Redis, websocket, and event-driven services.
  • Cloud infrastructure, containers, infrastructure-as-code, and CI/CD.
  • Async-first workflow with GitHub, Linear, Slack, and Notion.

What We Offer

  • Build the reliability foundation of a mission-driven accessibility service from the ground up.
  • Real responsibility and direct work with the founders, without bureaucracy layers.
  • Flexible, results-focused remote work.
  • Join a Deaf-led company making everyday communication more accessible.

The anticipated annual base salary range for this position is $130,000 to $225,000. The final base salary will be determined based on the selected candidate’s relevant experience, technical depth, specialized expertise, qualifications, and expected scope of responsibility, as well as internal compensation considerations.

This is a full-time, exempt position. The role may require flexibility to support urgent service requests and changing scheduling needs.

This position is primarily remote and open to candidates residing in U.S. states in which SignWow is authorized to employ personnel. Occasional travel or in-person meetings may be required.This role is also eligible for medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, paid holidays, a 401(k), and other company-sponsored benefits.

Employment in this position may be contingent upon successful completion of a criminal background check and any additional screening required for work involving regulated telecommunications services or public-sector clients, including work performed in connection with SignWow Global operations.

Job Title: In-Home Physician Part Time - Cedar Falls

Job Location: Work at Home, Iowa, United States

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Part time

Job Seniority Level:

We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

Do you have a passion for engaging with people and helping them on their journey to better health? Signify Health, part of CVS Health®, is seeking a Part Time Physician to provide In-Home Health Evaluations, engaging with people in the comfort of their own homes and helping bridge gaps in care.

You’ll play a critical role in building trusted relationships to make people healthier, helping bring flexible, comprehensive and personalized health evaluations right to people’s front doors.

Job highlights

The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). You’ll use an iPad and an intuitive clinical workflow for each evaluation and are not required to prescribe medicine, order lab tests or alter people’s current treatment regimen.

In this role, you will:

  • Bring your heart into every visit, joining a national network of purpose-driven clinicians dedicated to improving health outcomes

  • Be part of our efforts to visit millions of people nationwide with the goal of providing connections to the right care for people’s unique needs

  • Work with Signify Health as a clinician colleague, fulfilling the requirements of the specified role

  • Be flexible to travel locally and within licensed states, as needed

  • Conduct virtual visits as needed

  • Provide all Signify Health services as indicated including Diagnostic & Preventive Services products (i.e., spirometry, DEE, bone density screening, etc.)

A Note on Our Work Environment:

As an in-home clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of health plan members. We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants.

Why Clinicians Enjoy Working with Signify Health
“Many of the people I see are shocked that a physician is coming to their home to visit with them one-on-one. When you sit down and have an unhurried conversation about their health, they are impressed, happy, and understand that their health plan and care team cares about them.” - M.L., MD

“The primary care physician gets a snapshot of a person in an office setting, but with Signify Health, we see things like the number of steps to enter their home, the state of disrepair those steps may be in, and the person’s ability to function comfortably and with ease in their own home. We can make referrals to the individual’s health plan, encourage the participation of their loved ones, and ensure their PCPs are aware of their health and overall quality of life.” - C.H., MD

  • Select benefits (see benefits guide for details)

  • Malpractice insurance coverage (during Signify Health-related activities)

  • Supplies and other perks

Required & Preferred Qualifications (MDs and DOs)

  • Active, unrestricted license(s) in coverage area(s)

  • Multi-state licenses (preferred)

$105.00 - $105.00

This pay range represents the base hourly rate or base annual full-time salary for all positions in the job grade within which this position falls. The actual base salary offer will depend on a variety of factors including experience, education, geography and other relevant factors.

Our people fuel our future. Our teams reflect the customers, patients, members and communities we serve and we are committed to fostering a workplace where every colleague feels valued and that they belong.

Great benefits for great people

About Assembly Software

Assembly Software is the team behind Neos, the case management platform purpose-built for personal injury law firms, with embedded intelligence that already knows your cases. We're trusted by 1,100 firms and 15,000 users nationwide, backed by more than 40 years of experience in PI case management. As a growing SaaS company with a passionate team, we're building software that makes cases easier to manage and outcomes better for the firms and clients who rely on it.

When you join Assembly Software, you’re joining a team that genuinely cares about you, your career, and your excitement about your job. When you work for a tech company in the legal field, there are endless opportunities ripe for disruption, and you’ll be on the forefront of that innovation. We want you to pursue what drives you and push your boundaries! Assembly Software is where people come to shake up a historically buttoned-up industry.

Vision Statement

Assembly's vision is to provide the legal community the best practice management software that enables client advocacy from anywhere at anytime.

Mission Statement

Our mission is to provide intuitive and comprehensive legal practice management solutions enhancing efficiency and profitability for our customers.

Core Values

  • We are Accountable: We accept responsibility for our choices and actions. We value transparency + feedback.
  • We Never Stop Learning: We pursue growth + learning.
  • We Thrive as a Team: We value others' opinions + work respectfully with one another.
  • We are Collaborative Innovators: We are adventurous, creative + open-minded.
  • We are Here to Be of Service to our Customer + our Colleagues: No matter our role, we are all here to be of service + add value.
  • We have Unyielding Integrity: We do the right thin, even when no one is watching.
  • We Embrace Diversity + Inclusion: We are passionate about creating and cultivating an inclusive culture that promotes and values diversity.

Most companies say they want a design leader with vision. What they usually mean is someone who agrees with decisions that were already made and makes them look good. This is not that job. We want someone who walks into a room, forms a real opinion about what our product experience should become, and is willing to defend it.

At Assembly, you'll operate at every altitude. One day you're in a strategy conversation with our executives, the next you're deep in a prototype working removing friction from the user experience. You'll spend real time with customers, understanding and interpreting their feedback. You’ll operate as a partner to product and engineering, driving discovery and solutioning and shaping what we build.

We are an AI native product organization and need you to be as well. We need someone with real opinions about how AI should change the user experience and where it can be used to solve meaningful problems. If you've been waiting for a seat where you can drive this from day one, we want to hear from you.

When you’re considering a new job, it’s normal to have questions. Here are a few things we get asked all of the time:

1. I'm tired of the daily commute. Where are you located?
Assembly Software is a fully remote company. We work across time zones and connect through Teams, so you can build your career from wherever you do your best work: home office, favorite coffee shop, or yes, in your PJs if that's your vibe.

2. What makes Assembly Software different?
Our people. We're a fast growing SaaS company and the leading provider of case management solutions for personal injury and legal firms. Through our three brands, Neos, Needles, and TrialWorks, we serve over 2,500 law firms and 40,000+ users, the largest user base in the industry. Backed by Ridge Road Partners since 2017, we combine decades of legal tech expertise with a scrappy, entrepreneurial energy. We move fast, we care about the product, and we have fun doing it. Our sales team also enjoys uncapped commission with built in accelerators, so top performers are rewarded for their impact.

3. What's the benefits package like?
Competitive and comprehensive. You'll have access to:

  • Medical, dental, and vision plans
  • Short and long term disability coverage
  • Supplemental insurance options
  • 401(k)
  • Flexible time off
  • Paid parental leave
  • An Employee Assistance Program

We invest in our people because we know our results depend on them. When you do great work here, you'll be recognized and rewarded for it.

Overview

The Director of Security Operations leads the team responsible for detection and response across the enterprise. This role owns incident response, endpoint detection and response, email security, and SIEM and detection engineering, along with the monitoring and automation that support them. The director sets the strategy, staffing model, budget, and operating metrics for the function, and remains a working leader who takes incident commander duty, builds detections, and reviews analyst work alongside the team.

Responsibilities

  • Own the detection and response strategy and multi year roadmap, and align it to enterprise risk, the threat landscape, and business priorities
  • Lead, coach, and develop the security operations team, including hiring, scheduling, on call rotation, performance management, succession planning, and career development
  • Operate as a player coach, taking incident commander duty, writing detections, and performing hands on analysis alongside the team
  • Own the incident response program end to end, including the IR plan, severity model, escalation paths, tabletop exercises, evidence handling, and post incident review
  • Own endpoint detection and response strategy and operations, including policy tuning, coverage assurance, containment workflows, and threat hunting
  • Own email security, including phishing defense, mail authentication controls (SPF, DKIM, DMARC), user reporting workflows, and response to business email compromise attempts
  • Own SIEM and detection engineering, including log source onboarding, detection development and testing, alert quality, and false positive reduction
  • Build and maintain automation and runbooks that shorten response time and remove repetitive analyst work
  • Develop threat informed detection coverage mapped to MITRE ATT&CK and validate it through purple team and control testing
  • Define and report operational metrics including mean time to detect, mean time to respond, alert volume and quality, coverage, and containment effectiveness
  • Coordinate with IT, engineering, legal, privacy, and communications during incidents, including support for regulatory and customer notification decisions
  • Own budget, staffing plan, and vendor strategy for the detection and response stack, including managed service providers, tooling selection, and licensing
  • Present program status, incident outcomes, and risk decisions to executive leadership, and support board, audit committee, and regulator reporting as requested
  • Support audit and compliance requirements with evidence for monitoring, response, and control operation

Qualifications

Education/Experience:

  • 10 years of information security experience, including 5 years focused on security operations, incident response, or detection engineering, required
  • 5 years of direct people leadership experience, including hiring, performance management, and on call ownership, required
  • Experience owning a function level budget, vendor relationships, and a staffing plan, required
  • Bachelor’s degree in information systems, computer science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
  • Industry recognized certification(s) highly recommended: GCIH, GCIA, GCFA, CISSP, or CISM

  • Cloud detection and response experience in AWS, Azure, or GCP, including identity provider telemetry such as Okta or Entra ID
  • Scripting and automation ability (Python, PowerShell, or similar) for enrichment, response actions, and SOAR workflows
  • Strong knowledge of TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP, and operating system internals for Windows and macOS
  • Knowledge of secure configuration management and endpoint security technologies across multiple platforms
  • Understanding of compliance areas including controls for SOC 2, PCI DSS, and applicable state privacy and breach notification requirements
  • Ability to remain calm and decisive during active incidents and to communicate status clearly to technical and executive audiences
  • Strong verbal and written communication, including the ability to translate technical risk into business terms for non technical stakeholders
  • Proven ability to build rapport and durable working relationships with business, IT, and engineering leaders
  • Ability to influence without direct authority and to position security as a pragmatic, value added partner rather than a control function
  • Strong documentation and communication skills
  • Curious, inquisitive, innovative, lifelong learner and self-starter
  • Able to effectively give, receive, and respond to feedback

jobs.excerpt: Through proprietary software and AI, along with a focus on customer delight, Sleek makes the back-office easy for micro SMEs.
jobs.description:
Through proprietary software and AI, along with a focus on customer delight, Sleek makes the back-office easy for micro SMEs.

We give Entrepreneurs time back to focus on what they love doing - growing their business and being with customers. With a surging number of Entrepreneurs globally, we are innovating in a highly lucrative space.

We operate across 3 business segments:

Corporate Secretary: Automating the company incorporation, secretarial, filing, Nominee Director, mailroom and immigration processes via custom online robots and SleekSign. We are the market leaders in Singapore with ~5% market share of all new business incorporations

Accounting & Bookkeeping: Redefining what it means to do Accounting, Bookkeeping, Tax and Payroll thanks to our proprietary SleekBooks ledger, AI tools and exceptional customer service

FinTech payments: Overcoming a key challenge for Entrepreneurs by offering digital banking services to new businesses

Sleek launched in 2017 and now has around 17,500 customers across our offices in Singapore, Hong Kong, Australia and the UK. We have around 600 staff with an intact startup mindset. We have recently raised Series B financing off the back of >70% compound annual growth in Revenue over the last 5 years. Sleek has been recognised by The Financial Times, The Straits Times, Forbes and LinkedIn as one of the fastest growing companies in Asia. Backed by world-class investors, we are on track to be one of the few cash flow positive, tech-enabled unicorns based out of Asia Pacific.

Requirements

Mission of the role

Prepare bookkeeping, VAT returns and draft year end accounts for UK small business clients. You work in a pod of five led by a UK-based Senior Accounts Manager: two senior accountants, two accountants and a bookkeeper, serving around 300 UK small business clients from January and growing to around 500 through 2027. Until the manager starts in January, you work in one of our existing UK teams. A Senior Accountant reviews your work. Your work is on time and right the first time, and as you grow you take on year end accounts and corporation tax returns.

What you’ll do

  • Keep clients’ books up to date in Xero: bank reconciliations, sales and purchase ledgers, and month and year end adjustments.
  • Prepare VAT returns under Making Tax Digital for review.
  • Prepare draft year end accounts and, as you grow, corporation tax returns.
  • Check your own work before sending it for review, and act on corrections.
  • Chase clients early for missing records, and tell your Senior Accountant in good time when a deadline is at risk.
  • Keep client records and workflow data accurate.
  • Use the AI tools we are building into our products and workflow

Key outcomes in the first 6–12 months

  1. Your bookkeeping and VAT returns are ready for review before their deadlines, with client delays chased early and recorded.
  2. Your work needs fewer review rounds, measured from when you start.
  3. By month 12, you prepare draft year end accounts and CT600s for review, not just bookkeeping and VAT.
  4. Workflow data for your clients is accurate and up to date.

Must-have experience

  1. A degree in commerce, accounting or finance (for example B.Com or BS Accountancy).
  2. At least 2 years in accounting, including at least 1 on UK clients: bookkeeping, bank reconciliations and VAT returns.
  3. Confident with Xero, QuickBooks or a similar cloud accounting package.
  4. Written English good enough to email UK clients directly.
  5. Based in India or the Philippines, with the right to work there.
  6. Able to work a shift that overlaps UK business hours.

Nice to have

  1. Has prepared draft UK year end accounts or CT600s

Must-have attributes

  1. Ownership: you finish what you start and fix problems rather than pass them on.
  2. Accuracy: you check your own numbers before anyone else has to.
  3. Takes feedback well: you act on corrections and don’t make the same mistake twice.
  4. Great communicator: clear in writing, with UK clients and with your reviewer.
  5. Process, data and compliance: you follow the process and keep records clean.
  6. One team: you help the rest of the pod, not just your own clients.
  7. Open to AI: comfortable with our tools taking on more of the routine work.

The interview process

  • TA Screening Call: A 30 minute call with our Talent Acquisition team
  • Live Technical Assessment: A ~60–90 minute live skills test to assess your hands-on bookkeeping capability.
  • Technical Interview : A 45 - 60 minute interview with the Accounting manager who will assess your technical skills.
  • Soft Skills Interview: A ~15-30 minute interview with the hiring team to evaluate real-world work scenarios against our core behavioural values.
  • Reference Verification: Prior to final offer confirmation, we will conduct one professional reference check with your recent direct manager or supervisor. To keep the process moving smoothly, this step may be initiated during the final interview stages.

Requirement for background screening Please be aware that Sleek is a regulated entity and as such is required to perform different levels of background checks on staff depending on their role. This may include using external vendors to verify:

  • Your education
  • Any criminal history
  • Any political exposure
  • Any bankruptcy or adverse credit history We will ask for your consent before conducting these checks. Depending on your role at Sleek, an adverse result on one of these checks may prohibit you from passing probation. By submitting a job application, you confirm that you have read and agree to our Data Privacy Statement for Candidates, found at Sleek.com.

Benefits

Some other great things about working at Sleek…

Humility and kindness: Humility is a core attribute we hire for, which means we have a culture of not taking ourselves too seriously and being able to laugh. Kindness is also incredibly important. We are committed to creating and nurturing a diverse and inclusive environment.

Flexibility: You'll be able to work remotely. If you need to start early or start late to cater to your family or other needs, we don't mind, so long as you get your work done and proactively communicate. You can also work fully remote from anywhere in the world for 1 month each year.

Financial benefits: We pay competitive market salaries and provide staff with generous paid time off and holiday schedules. Certain staff at Sleek are also eligible for our employee share ownership plan and can share in the upside of our stellar growth trajectory as we work toward listing on a prominent stock exchange in the Asia Pacific region.

Personal growth: You'll get a lot of responsibility and autonomy at Sleek - we move at a fast pace so you'll be making decisions, making mistakes and learning. There's also a range of internal and external facing training programmes we run. We're also at the forefront of utilising AI in our space and are developing a regional centre of AI excellence. It is our intention that if you leave Sleek, you leave as a more well-rounded person and professional.

Sleek is also a proudly certified B Corp. Since we started our journey in 2017, we've been committed to building Sleek as a force for good. In just over 5 years, we've joined a community of industry leaders like Patagonia, Ben & Jerry's, and P&G who are building an inclusive, equitable, and a regenerative economy.

The Project Control Analyst will support Program Management Teams (Vice Presidents, Program Directors, Program Managers, and Project Leaders) in financial management of projects and programs. Teamwork and collaboration will be critical for the success of this role, along with having the ability to work independently on assigned tasks and responsibilities. Focus on accuracy and consistency of data and numbers is a pre-requisite for this role.

Leveraging our mission-ready technology and solutions, proven expertise in federal deployment, and strategic relationships, we enhance outcomes for the government, efficiently and effectively. Headquartered in Tysons, Virginia, LMI is committed to delivering impactful results that strengthen missions and drive lasting value.

Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with Project Management Teams (including Program Vice Presidents, Program Managers, and Project Leaders) in the development, review, and updates of project and program budgets, forecasts, and estimate-at-completion (EAC) and associated reporting and analysis.
  • Facilitate contract kick-off meetings to ensure consistency and effectiveness of CostPoint project set up, project billing and accounting, and other contractual obligations and requirements that have financial implication. Collaborate with accounting department in project set up structure and process.
  • Set up and maintain CostPoint project workforce in order to manage labor charges on projects; partner with program management team to communicate personnel ceilings and budgets to project team members. Track personnel spend against budgets as required.
  • Monitor and review project and program expenditures for accuracy and consistency. Collaborate with accounting department in resolving any discrepancies or miscoding of expenditures.
  • Review, monitor, and report project financial performance (revenue, cost, margins) and identify and present potential deviations against budget or forecasts to management. Develop and provide recommendations for corrective action or improvement as necessary.
  • Support subcontractor/vendor cost management lifecycle, including setting up Purchase Requests, Purchase Orders, tracking subcontractor/vendor invoicing and payments, and developing back up for subcontractor accruals. Review subcontractor invoices for accuracy, timeliness and completion. Collaborate with Purchasing Department to ensure subcontractor funding is up to date, in place, and in line with prime contract.
  • Proactively partnering with the program management team in order to understand and track program risks and challenges and ensure risk mitigation activities are in place as necessary to avoid performance issues.
  • Prepare and/or support preparation of client status reports, integrated program reviews, and/or ad-hoc program related financial requests from clients, internal management, and other stakeholders.
  • Review and approve client invoices for submission to the customer. Collaborate with Project Accounting and the Billing Department in supporting client questions associated with billings, as well as reviewing and resolving unbilled charges.
  • Monitor, track, and forecast project spend for labor and non-labor (travel/ODCs). Manage labor category spend on T&M contracts with labor category ceilings.
  • Collaborate with Pricing Department and Program Management teams in development of price proposals and cost estimates including documentation of pricing assumptions and basis of estimates.
  • Support audit requirements from federal agencies (DCAA/DCMA/Other) and internal and external auditors.
  • Support development or enhancement of project control processes, procedures, and systems.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in accounting, finance, or related field preferred

  • Strong organization skills and focus on accuracy and consistency

The target salary range for this position is $80,000-$115,000.

The salary range displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is not a guarantee of compensation. Applicants must meet eligibility requirements for a U.S. Government security clearance. Only US Citizens are eligible for a security clearance. The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. As an in-home clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of health plan members. We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants.

“I love seeing health plan members at home. You get a better picture of their health when you see where they live.” - Erica R., PA

You are equally comfortable guiding agentic-AI tools to deliver code, reviewing designs, and influencing how the platform evolves.

Location: This is a fully remote position located in Colombia.

Core Responsibilities

AI-Augmented Development Expectations

  • Use AI-assisted development tools — inline completion, conversational assistants, and agentic workflows — as a standard part of your daily workflow.

  • Mentor other developers on effective, responsible use of AI-assisted development tools.

  • Build and refine feedback loops that improve the team's collective use of AI tooling over time.

Core Qualifications

  • Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience; 8+ years of professional software development experience with demonstrated impact beyond a single team.
  • Proven experience designing and operating distributed, cloud-native, SaaS/multi-tenant platforms at scale, ideally on AWS.
  • Strong software fundamentals: OOP, design patterns, SOLID principles, and a track record of advocating for code quality.
  • Experience with agentic-AI software development practices.
  • Experience designing and consuming well-designed HTTP APIs (REST, GraphQL, or similar).
  • Experience mentoring developers and influencing architectural decisions across teams.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills; comfortable operating in fast-moving environments with ambiguity and evolving requirements. English high B2.
  • Strong initiative to improve processes, tools, methodologies, and product quality.

Department-Specific Responsibilities

  • Build and operate the AWS AgentCore Gateway layer and the capabilities it hosts — MCP tool targets today, extending to inbound access, agent-to-agent (HTTP) targets, and inference/model-routing targets as those capabilities come online.
  • Develop and maintain the target registry and configuration model that lets customer firms register their own MCP servers for their agents to call, covering tenant isolation, credential handling, allowlisting and egress control, and containment when a third-party endpoint fails or misbehaves.
  • Build the inbound surface that exposes Caseware capability to external agents and clients over MCP and adjacent protocols, including authentication, scope enforcement, and rate limiting.
  • Build and operate the on-premise connectivity path, including session lifecycle, request correlation, and recovery for long-lived sessions between cloud-hosted agents and on-premise desktop clients.
  • Implement session and scope propagation from agent to gateway to target to backend, so authorization is correct and auditable at every hop.
  • Design and evolve OpenAPI contracts for gateway targets, and the target runtimes that implement them, keeping conventions consistent regardless of what a target fronts.
  • Implement outbound authorization for gateway targets (IAM/SigV4, OAuth, credential providers) so access to each target type is securely and consistently controlled.
  • Maintain versioning of target contracts as they evolve, so consuming teams and customers are not broken by change.
  • Contribute to end-to-end tracing and SLOs for gateway traffic, and build the observability that lets you and other teams detect and debug failures anywhere in the pipeline.
  • Mentor other developers joining the team, and contribute to technical direction for the integration layer through RFCs and design reviews.

Department-Specific Qualifications

  • Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol) for LLM agents.
  • Experience building or operating a multi-tenant gateway or API platform: several traffic patterns behind one access point, tenant isolation, per-tenant credentials and secrets, quotas, and abuse protection.
  • Experience integrating with third-party or untrusted endpoints, with a clear point of view on failure containment and limiting blast radius.
  • Experience with authorization and scope propagation across multi-hop service boundaries — carrying and checking identity and permissions through the full pipeline, not just authenticating once.
  • Experience designing and operating persistent-connection or streaming architectures, including session management, recovery, and message correlation, along with related protocol-level concerns (timeout/retry semantics, backpressure, idempotency, graceful degradation).

Nice to Have

  • Experience with AWS Bedrock, AgentCore, or other managed agent/LLM orchestration platforms.
  • Experience with LLM provider routing and gateway patterns (multi-provider endpoints, model-based routing) or agent-to-agent (A2A) communication protocols.
  • Experience building developer- or partner-facing platform surfaces that external parties integrate against.
  • Experience integrating cloud services with on-premise or embedded clients (webviews, desktop apps).
  • Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (CDK, CloudFormation, or Terraform).
  • Experience operating systems in regulated or compliance-heavy domains.

Tech Stack

  • Backend & Platform: Node.js/TypeScript
  • Cloud & Infrastructure: AWS Lambda, AWS Bedrock, AWS AgentCore Gateway (or similar third-party platforms/tools)
  • Connectivity: Persistent-connection relay architecture for on-premise integrations

Perks & Benefits

Location: 100% Remote

Employment: Full-time, long-term position

Start date: As soon as possible after selection and agreement

Salary: Startup-aligned starting compensation, based on experience and responsibilities, with the potential for substantial growth during the first few years

About UsWe are a startup developing software products, web applications, AI-powered tools, integrations, and business automations across different projects.

Our delivery model combines internal ownership with outsourced development. We work with external developers and specialists, and we need strong technical leadership to turn their contributions into reliable, maintainable software.

AI-assisted and agentic development are central to how we work. We want to move quickly, make sensible technical decisions, and build solutions that our team can understand, operate, and improve.

We are looking for an experienced engineer who wants to join at an early stage, take meaningful responsibility, and grow with the company.

Job DescriptionWe are seeking a Senior AI & Full-Stack Engineer who can develop applications across frontend and backend, integrate AI capabilities, and manage the Linux infrastructure, databases, and deployment processes supporting them.

You should be comfortable taking a project from an initial business requirement through implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing operation. You will work across different products and internal initiatives, helping us choose practical solutions and deliver them efficiently.

Alongside hands-on engineering, your responsibilities may include leading developers, mentoring less experienced colleagues, coordinating outsourced contributors, and reviewing externally delivered work. Previous team leadership and mentoring experience are therefore important.

This is an opportunity to help establish the engineering foundations of a growing startup and develop into a broader technical leadership position.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain web applications across frontend and backend.
  • Build AI-powered features, integrations, internal tools, and business automations.
  • Use AI coding assistants and coding agents effectively, with appropriate testing and human review.
  • Translate business requirements into clear implementation tasks and verifiable acceptance criteria.
  • Design APIs, business logic, authentication, authorization, and third-party integrations.
  • Manage database schemas, migrations, query performance, backups, and recovery procedures.
  • Administer Linux servers, including application services, permissions, updates, networking, and troubleshooting.
  • Build and maintain Docker environments, including container networking, persistent storage, configuration, and health checks.
  • Manage DNS records, domain routing, TLS certificates, and reverse proxies.
  • Maintain CI/CD workflows using GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps Pipelines, and appropriate build agents or runners.
  • Carry out deployments with migration checks, rollback procedures, and post-deployment verification.
  • Investigate production incidents and address their underlying causes.
  • Coordinate outsourced developers and specialists, clarify requirements, review deliverables, and manage technical dependencies.
  • Mentor developers through code reviews, practical demonstrations, and constructive feedback.
  • Keep implementation proportionate to the problem, controlling unnecessary complexity, infrastructure costs, and maintenance overhead.

Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated senior-level experience delivering and maintaining production web applications.
  • Strong frontend development skills using a modern framework, JavaScript or TypeScript, HTML, and CSS.
  • Strong backend development experience, including secure APIs, integrations, validation, and error handling.
  • Practical experience integrating AI or LLM capabilities into software, including checking output quality, handling failures, and managing latency and usage costs.
  • Substantial hands-on experience with AI coding assistants or agentic development workflows, with examples of working results you independently verified.
  • Strong SQL and relational database experience, including migrations, indexing, performance analysis, and backup and recovery.
  • Hands-on Linux administration and Docker deployment experience.
  • A working understanding of DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, TLS, firewalls, ports, and reverse proxies.
  • Practical CI/CD experience with GitHub Actions and familiarity with Azure DevOps repositories, pipelines, and build agents.
  • Strong Git, pull-request, code-review, and release-management skills.
  • Previous experience leading a development team or coordinating technical delivery.
  • Proven mentoring experience and the ability to explain technical decisions clearly.
  • Experience working with outsourced developers, contractors, or distributed teams.
  • The ability to work independently, prioritize competing needs, and make sound decisions with a limited startup budget.
  • Interest in a long-term, full-time role with increasing responsibility.

Especially Valuable Experience

  • Building products or engineering processes in an early-stage startup.
  • Taking responsibility for several applications or services at the same time.
  • Evaluating outsourced work for correctness, security, maintainability, and operational readiness.
  • Developing AI agents, tool integrations, retrieval workflows, or reliable automation.
  • Operating PostgreSQL and multi-service Docker environments.
  • Establishing deployment standards, monitoring, incident procedures, and practical documentation.
  • Helping junior developers become more effective through structured mentoring.

Growth, Responsibility and CompensationJoining at this stage offers the opportunity to influence how we build software, organize delivery, and develop our engineering team.

Initial compensation will reflect our startup budget, your experience, and the agreed scope of responsibility. As your contribution and responsibilities grow alongside the business, we aim to provide substantial salary progression during the first few years.

For a strong contributor, the role can develop into positions such as Technical Lead, Engineering Lead, or Head of Engineering. Progression will depend on demonstrated results, leadership capability, company growth, and financial capacity. Compensation expectations and progression milestones will be discussed openly during recruitment.

What We Offer

  • A fully remote, full-time role with a long-term perspective.
  • Direct involvement in technical decisions across multiple products and initiatives.
  • The opportunity to build, lead, and mentor a distributed engineering team.
  • Broad ownership across software, AI integration, infrastructure, and delivery.
  • Close collaboration with startup leadership.
  • The potential for significant career and compensation growth as the company develops.

Remote Working ArrangementOur remote working setup includes a time-tracking tool that records mouse-click and keyboard-activity metrics and captures screenshots of the screen. This monitoring is part of the working arrangement and will be explained during the recruitment process.

Applicants should be comfortable working with this setup.

How to ApplyWe are looking to fill this core engineering role promptly. Applying early gives us the opportunity to discuss how you could help shape our technical direction from the beginning.

Please submit your CV and a short overview covering:

  • A production application you helped deliver and your own frontend and backend contributions.
  • An AI feature or agentic workflow you implemented and how you verified its results.
  • Your Linux, Docker, database, and deployment responsibilities.
  • A team you led or developers you mentored, including the outcomes.

Job highlights

The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). You’ll use an iPad and an intuitive clinical workflow for each evaluation and are not required to prescribe medicine, order lab tests or alter people’s current treatment regimen.

In this role, you will:

  • Conduct virtual visits as needed

As an in-home clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of health plan members. We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants.

Loan Processing Manager

Before You Apply

We receive a high volume of applications for our roles and we review every one carefully. To ensure we can give qualified candidates the attention they deserve, please only apply if you meet the following:

  • You have a minimum of 5 years of loan processing experience specifically within the Australian mortgage sector

Applications that do not meet these criteria will not be progressed.

About Us

ELP is a rapidly growing outsourcing company with a strong presence across India and Australia. Established recently, we are now one of the fastest-growing firms in the sector.

About the Role

This isn't a standard loan processing role. It's an operational leadership position for someone who is an exceptional loan processor.

You'll be stepping into a fast-paced, high-volume mortgage broking operation. Your job is to make sure everything runs smoothly, from the moment a deal comes in through to post-settlement maintenance.

You'll own the processing pipeline end-to-end, coordinate with support teams, and manage priorities across a busy and growing book. You won't be waiting for someone to tell you what to do next. You'll be the one deciding what needs to happen and ensuring it gets done. When something falls through the cracks, the expectation is that you've already caught it.

This role has a clear trajectory into formal team leadership, and we're looking for someone who sees that as a natural progression.

  • Stepping into an operational leadership capacity, with a clear path to formally owning that function

This is a senior position that requires substantial, demonstrable experience in Australian mortgage processing. Candidates should be comfortable managing a high-volume pipeline independently and operating in a leadership-adjacent capacity from the outset. Foundational Mapping Portfolio

jobs.excerpt: 1.  BackgroundFòs Feminista.  Fòs Feminista is an International Alliance of more than 200 partners across 40 countries working on the sexual and reproductive health, rights, and justice (SRHRJ) of women, girls, and gender-diverse people.
locationRestrictions: Congo, The Democratic Republic of the
jobs.description:
1. Background

Fòs Feminista. Fòs Feminista is an International Alliance of more than 200 partners across 40 countries working on the sexual and reproductive health, rights, and justice (SRHRJ) of women, girls, and gender-diverse people. In 2026, Fòs Feminista completed a three-decade mapping of how "family" has been used in United Nations agreed language — reviewing 1,441 excerpts across 180 UN documents from 1994 to 2025. That mapping found that a substantial, underused body of UN agreed language already centers individual rights, gender equality, and diverse family forms, offering feminist advocates a propositional foundation to build on rather than only a defensive posture against anti-rights mobilization around "family."

This mapping has not yet been extended to the regional level. The African Union (AU) has its own distinct body of human rights instruments, agreed language, and political dynamics relevant to family, gender equality, and SRHR — including the Protocol to the African Charter on Human and Peoples’ Rights on the Rights of Women in Africa (the Maputo Protocol), one of the most progressive regional instruments globally on women’s rights, alongside AU mechanisms with an active record on ending child marriage and other harmful practices. At the same time, the AU is not insulated from anti-rights and anti-gender actors seeking to co-opt family language in multilateral outcomes.

As such, Fòs Feminista is seeking a consultant to conduct a systematic mapping and analysis of family-related language across African Union agreed language and human rights mechanisms to produce a rigorous, regionally grounded evidence base for use in African Union-level advocacy.

2. Purpose and Objectives

The purpose of this consultancy is to produce a systematic, evidence-based mapping of how "family" is defined, referenced, and used across African Union agreed language, in order to:

  • Identify where existing AU agreed language already reflects rights-based, gender-equal, and diverse understandings of family, distinguishing this from areas where family language is used restrictively or left unaddressed.
  • Produce a citable evidence base to inform feminist advocacy in African Union-level negotiations.
  • Identify patterns specific to the African regional context — including but not limited to child marriage, female genital mutilation and other harmful practices, inheritance and marital property rights, and care — grounded in the region’s own instruments and mechanisms.
  • Analyze whether language has changed over time, assessing whether it reflects advancement, regression, or stagnation in relation to gender equality and SRHR, and identifying the instruments, sessions or political context associated with such shifts.
  • Generate concrete recommendations and draft rights-based language proposals for use in AU Summit declarations, Specialized Technical Committee outcomes, and other AU negotiating processes.

3. Scope of Work

The consultant will review family-related language across the following African Union instruments and mechanisms, at minimum:

  • The African Charter on Human and Peoples’ Rights (1981) and its jurisprudence.
  • The Protocol to the African Charter on Human and Peoples’ Rights on the Rights of Women in Africa (Maputo Protocol, 2003), with particular attention to its marriage, family, and inheritance provisions.
  • The African Charter on the Rights and Welfare of the Child (1990).
  • Decisions, declarations, and resolutions of the AU Assembly of Heads of State and Government and the Executive Council.
  • Resolutions, General Comments, and Concluding Observations of the African Commission on Human and Peoples’ Rights (ACHPR).
  • General Comments and Concluding Observations of the African Committee of Experts on the Rights and Welfare of the Child (ACERWC).
  • The Solemn Declaration on Gender Equality in Africa (2004) and subsequent AU gender policy instruments.
  • The Plan of Action on the Family in Africa (2004), adopted by the AU Assembly to mark the tenth anniversary of the International Year of the Family, and its 2010 mid-term review.
  • The Continental Policy Framework on Sexual and Reproductive Health and Rights (2005, endorsed by the AU Assembly in January 2006) and the Maputo Plan of Action for its operationalization, including subsequent iterations (2007–2010 and the revised 2016–2030 Plan).
  • Outcome documents of relevant AU Specialized Technical Committees, including those on Health, Population and Drug Control; Gender Equality and Women’s Empowerment; and Social Development, Labour and Employment.
  • Materials and declarations associated with the AU Campaign to End Child Marriage.
  • Agenda 2063 and associated flagship programmes, where family-related language appears.

The consultant, in consultation with Fòs Feminista, will propose a final document list and inclusion timeframe during the inception phase (see Section 5).

4. Specific Tasks

  • Review Fòs Feminista’s existing mapping and adapt methodology to the African Union context, in consultation with Fòs Feminista.
  • Define inclusion criteria, search terms, and a document timeframe appropriate to AU instruments, accounting for the African Union’s founding in 2002 and, where relevant, continuity with instruments of its predecessor, the Organisation of African Unity (OAU).
  • Systematically identify and retrieve relevant documents across the proposed mechanisms.
  • Extract all excerpts referencing family (and relevant equivalent terminology across the AU’s working languages, as feasible) into a structured, coded database.
  • Code excerpts thematically, drawing on categories established in the UN-level mapping, while remaining open to additional categories specific to the African regional context.
  • Assess the political and normative implications of each excerpt (positive, neutral, or negative) from a feminist, rights-based perspective, consistent with the coding logic used in the UN-level mapping.
  • Analyze how family-related language has evolved over the mapping period, identifying patterns of advancement, regression, or stagnation in relation to gender equality and SRHR, and the specific instruments, sessions, or political context associated with such shifts.
  • Draft a mapping report presenting findings, methodology, illustrative excerpts with full citations, and the trend analysis described above.
  • Generate concrete recommendations and draft rights-based language formulations suited to AU negotiating contexts, grounded in specific cited instances of existing agreed language.
  • Provide updates and present final findings to Fòs Feminista and relevant partners.

5. Deliverables

  • Inception report, including proposed methodology, document list, inclusion criteria, and timeframe (due at the end of the inception phase).
  • A structured spreadsheet database of coded excerpts, consistent in format with Fòs Feminista’s existing UN-level mapping database (mechanism, document title, citation/symbol, date, page reference, excerpt text, and thematic codes).
  • A draft mapping and analysis report, for Fòs Feminista review and feedback. This should already include a set of concrete recommendations and draft rights-based language proposals for AU negotiating contexts, cross-referenced to specific cited excerpts.
  • A final mapping and analysis report incorporating feedback, including an executive summary suitable for external advocacy use.
  • A presentation of findings (virtual or in-person, to be agreed) to Fòs Feminista and partner organizations.

6. Indicative Timeline

The following is an indicative timeline of approximately 10 weeks; the final schedule will be confirmed with the selected consultant during contracting.

  • Weeks 1–2: Inception phase — methodology, document list, and workplan finalized.
  • Weeks 3–4: Document identification, retrieval, and excerpt extraction.
  • Weeks 4–6: Thematic coding and analysis.
  • Weeks 6–8: Draft mapping report submitted to and reviewed by Fòs Feminista.
  • Weeks 8–10: Revisions, finalization, and presentation of findings.

7. Required Qualifications and Experience

  • Advanced degree (Master’s or higher) in law, human rights, gender studies, African studies, political science, or a related field.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of African Union human rights mechanisms and regional legal and policy frameworks, including the Maputo Protocol.
  • Prior experience conducting legal, policy, or content analysis of agreed language, treaty text, or comparable normative documents.
  • Experience applying feminist or rights-based analytical frameworks to legal and policy texts.
  • Strong written communication skills in English; working proficiency in French, Arabic, and/or Portuguese is highly desirable given the African Union’s official languages.
  • Prior experience on gender equality, SRHR, or family law in the African regional context is strongly preferred.
  • Familiarity with qualitative data analysis tools (e.g., Dedoose, NVivo, or comparable software) is an asset.

8. Reporting and Supervision

The consultant will report to an assigned Senior Advocacy Officer and will maintain regular check-ins (proposed bi-weekly, to be confirmed) throughout the assignment to review progress against the agreed workplan.

9. Application Process

Interested candidates should submit the following by October 16, 2026:

  • A current CV or resume.
  • A cover letter outlining relevant experience and interest in the assignment.
  • A brief proposed methodology and workplan (no more than 3 pages), including any suggested adaptations to the approach described above.
  • A financial proposal, inclusive of a proposed daily or total consultancy rate.
  • A relevant writing sample (e.g., a legal or policy analysis, research report, or comparable output).

10. Budget

The total consultancy fee for this assignment is USD 6,000–7,000, inclusive of all costs. Candidates should submit a proposed budget within this range as part of their application; Fòs Feminista will confirm the final consultancy fee during contracting.

We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

Do you have a passion for engaging with people and helping them on their journey to better health? Signify Health, part of CVS Health®, is seeking a Full Time Clinician (Nurse Practitioner or Physician Assistant) to provide In-Home Health Evaluations, engaging with people in the comfort of their own homes and helping bridge gaps in care.

You’ll play a critical role in building trusted relationships to make people healthier, helping bring flexible, comprehensive and personalized health evaluations right to people’s front doors.

Job highlights

The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). You’ll use an iPad and an intuitive clinical workflow for each evaluation and are not required to prescribe medicine, order lab tests or alter people’s current treatment regimen.

In this role, you will:

  • Bring your heart into every visit, joining a national network of purpose-driven clinicians dedicated to improving health outcomes

  • Be part of our efforts to visit millions of people nationwide with the goal of providing connections to the right care for people’s unique needs

  • Work with Signify Health as a clinician colleague, fulfilling the requirements of the specified role

  • Be flexible to travel locally and within licensed states, as needed

  • Conduct virtual visits as needed

  • Provide all Signify Health services as indicated including Diagnostic & Preventive Services products (i.e., spirometry, DEE, bone density screening, etc.)

​

A Note on Our Work Environment:

As an in-home clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of health plan members. We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants.

Why Clinicians Enjoy Working with Signify Health

“I love seeing health plan members at home. You get a better picture of their health when you see where they live.” - Erica R., PA

“At Signify Health, we have the time to help people and to truly listen to their questions and concerns. We can help guide them so they can take better care of themselves. We really can make a change in communities.” - Ali B., NP

“I like how Signify Health manages my experience. I’m just doing the clinician part of my job without all the administrative responsibilities. I have the time to provide education so people have a better understanding of their health. I can answer their questions without rushing out the door.” - Andrew K., PA

jobs.excerpt: Position:Chief Financial Officer (CFO) About the RoleWe are seeking an accomplished and commercially strategic Chief Financial Officer (CFO) to lead the financial strategy, financial performance, capital management, investment finance, treasury, reporting, and financial governance of a diversified Insurance & Investment organization.
jobs.description:
Position:Chief Financial Officer (CFO)

About the Role

We are seeking an accomplished and commercially strategic Chief Financial Officer (CFO) to lead the financial strategy, financial performance, capital management, investment finance, treasury, reporting, and financial governance of a diversified Insurance & Investment organization.

The CFO will serve as a key member of the executive leadership team and strategic advisor to the CEO/President and Board, providing leadership across financial planning, insurance accounting, capital and solvency management, investment portfolio performance, asset-liability management, treasury, risk, regulatory reporting, and corporate development.

The successful candidate will combine deep financial expertise with strong commercial and investment acumen and will be capable of operating in a highly regulated financial-services environment.

Key Responsibilities

1. Financial Strategy & Executive Leadership

Develop and execute the organization's overall financial strategy.

Advise the CEO, President, and Board on financial performance, capital allocation, investment strategy, and enterprise value creation.

Translate corporate strategy into financial plans, budgets, forecasts, and measurable objectives.

Lead financial decision-making across insurance, investment, and corporate operations.

Establish strong financial governance and accountability across the organization.

2. Financial Planning, Budgeting & Performance

Lead annual budgeting, forecasting, and long-term financial planning.

Develop financial models and scenario analyses to support strategic decisions.

Monitor revenue, profitability, expenses, capital efficiency, and operating performance.

Establish financial KPIs and executive dashboards.

Identify opportunities to improve profitability, efficiency, and shareholder returns.

3. Insurance Finance & Performance

Oversee financial management of insurance operations, including premiums, claims, reserves, expenses, and underwriting performance.

Monitor key insurance financial metrics including loss ratios, combined ratios, expense ratios, and underwriting profitability.

Partner with actuarial, underwriting, claims, and risk teams to assess financial performance and emerging exposures.

Ensure appropriate financial treatment and reporting of insurance liabilities and reserves.

Support pricing, product profitability, reinsurance, and portfolio decisions from a financial perspective.

4. Investment Finance & Portfolio Management

Provide financial oversight of the organization's investment portfolio and investment activities.

Partner with the CIO/Chief Investment Officer and Investment Committee on portfolio strategy and performance.

Monitor investment income, realized/unrealized gains, asset allocation, liquidity, and risk-adjusted returns.

Evaluate investment opportunities and strategic asset-allocation decisions.

Ensure investment activities are aligned with the organization's liabilities, liquidity requirements, risk appetite, and regulatory requirements.

5. Capital, Solvency & Balance Sheet Management

Lead capital planning and balance-sheet optimization.

Monitor solvency, capital adequacy, liquidity, leverage, and financial resilience.

Develop strategies to optimize the organization's capital structure and return on capital.

Assess the financial impact of major business, investment, and insurance decisions on capital requirements.

Work closely with Risk and Actuarial functions on capital and solvency assessments.

6. Asset-Liability Management (ALM)

Provide executive financial oversight of asset-liability management.

Ensure investment portfolios are appropriately aligned with insurance liabilities and liquidity requirements.

Monitor duration, interest-rate sensitivity, liquidity gaps, and market exposures.

Support development of ALM strategies and balance-sheet optimization initiatives.

Ensure appropriate financial stress testing and scenario analysis.

7. Treasury & Liquidity

Oversee treasury, cash management, liquidity planning, and banking relationships.

Maintain adequate liquidity to meet claims, operating obligations, investment commitments, and strategic requirements.

Optimize cash deployment and short-term investment strategies.

Monitor interest-rate, foreign-exchange, credit, and liquidity exposures.

Establish robust treasury policies and controls.

8. Regulatory & Financial Reporting

Ensure accurate, timely, and transparent financial reporting to the Board, shareholders, regulators, and other stakeholders.

Oversee statutory accounts, management reporting, regulatory returns, and consolidated financial statements.

Ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards and insurance regulations.

Lead relationships with external auditors, regulators, actuarial advisers, tax advisers, and other professional stakeholders.

Maintain strong financial controls and governance frameworks.

9. Risk Management & Financial Controls

Establish effective financial risk-management frameworks.

Monitor exposure to market, credit, liquidity, underwriting, operational, interest-rate, and foreign-exchange risks.

Strengthen internal controls, financial policies, and governance processes.

Work closely with the CRO, Chief Actuary, CIO, and other executives to manage enterprise-wide financial risks.

Ensure appropriate stress testing and contingency planning.

10. Reinsurance & Capital Optimization

Provide financial oversight of reinsurance strategy and economics.

Evaluate the financial and capital implications of reinsurance arrangements.

Monitor reinsurance recoverables, counterparty exposure, and profitability.

Support optimization of risk transfer, capital efficiency, and balance-sheet resilience.

11. Corporate Development & Strategic Investments

Lead financial evaluation of acquisitions, strategic investments, joint ventures, and business expansion opportunities.

Oversee financial due diligence, valuation, transaction modeling, and investment cases.

Assess potential M&A opportunities and their impact on capital, solvency, earnings, and shareholder value.

Support negotiations with investors, financial institutions, and strategic partners.

12. Investor & Stakeholder Relations

Develop strong relationships with shareholders, institutional investors, banks, rating agencies, regulators, and other financial stakeholders.

Communicate financial performance, capital strategy, investment results, and business outlook to key stakeholders.

Support investor presentations, Board materials, and strategic financial communications.

13. Finance Transformation & Technology

Modernize finance systems, reporting infrastructure, ERP platforms, and financial analytics.

Improve automation, data quality, forecasting, and management reporting.

Establish real-time visibility into financial, insurance, investment, and risk performance.

Drive continuous improvement within the finance function.

14. Leadership & Talent Development

Lead Finance, FP&A, Treasury, Accounting, Financial Reporting, Tax, and related functions.

Build a high-performing and commercially focused finance organization.

Develop finance leadership talent and succession plans.

Promote a culture of integrity, accountability, financial discipline, and business partnership.

Key Performance Indicators

The CFO will be accountable for:

Revenue and earnings growth

Operating and net profitability

Return on equity (ROE)

Return on capital

Capital adequacy and solvency

Investment portfolio performance

Investment income and risk-adjusted returns

Combined ratio / underwriting profitability

Expense efficiency

Liquidity and cash-flow management

Balance-sheet optimization

Budget and forecast accuracy

Regulatory and financial reporting quality

Cost of capital

Financial risk management

Shareholder value creation

Candidate Profile

Essential Experience

15+ years of progressive finance experience, including significant executive leadership.

Previous experience as CFO, Group CFO, Finance Director, VP Finance, Deputy CFO, or equivalent.

Significant experience within insurance, asset management, investment management, banking, pensions, financial services, or a related regulated financial institution.

Strong understanding of insurance financial statements, investment portfolios, capital management, and regulatory requirements.

Proven experience managing complex balance sheets, liquidity, capital, and financial performance.

Strong experience working with Boards, regulators, auditors, investors, rating agencies, and senior executives.

Demonstrated experience in financial strategy, investment analysis, and capital allocation.

Preferred Experience

Experience as Group CFO within a diversified insurance or financial-services group.

Experience across both insurance and investment/asset-management businesses.

Experience with life insurance, general insurance, health insurance, pensions, or reinsurance.

Exposure to institutional investment portfolios and alternative investments.

Experience with M&A, strategic investments, capital raising, restructuring, or corporate transformation.

Experience operating across multiple jurisdictions or regulated markets.

Experience interacting with insurance regulators and rating agencies.

Education & Professional Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, Business Administration, or a related discipline.

Professional qualification such as CA, ACCA, CPA, CMA, CFA, or equivalent strongly preferred.

MBA or Master's degree in Finance/Business is an advantage.

Relevant insurance, actuarial, investment, or risk-management qualifications are advantageous.

Core Competencies

Insurance Finance

Corporate Finance

Investment Finance

Capital & Solvency Management

Asset-Liability Management

Treasury & Liquidity

Financial Planning & Analysis

Investment Analysis

Financial Modeling

Risk Management

Regulatory Reporting

Insurance Accounting

M&A & Corporate Development

Capital Allocation

Investor Relations

Corporate Governance

Financial Transformation

Leadership Characteristics

The successful CFO will be:

Strategic, commercially minded, and financially rigorous

Highly analytical and investment-oriented

Experienced in highly regulated environments

Strong in capital and balance-sheet management

Comfortable engaging with Boards, regulators, investors, and rating agencies

Able to balance growth, profitability, liquidity, capital, and risk

An effective strategic partner to the CEO, CIO, CRO, and Chief Actuary

Strong in complex financial decision-making

A transformational finance leader capable of building high-performing teams

Compensation

A competitive executive compensation package comprising base salary, performance-based incentives, executive benefits, and other benefits commensurate with experience and market benchmarks.

Purpose Examine foreclosure title reports and abstracted documents for evaluation of effect on the chain of title and subsequent foreclosure action. Search public records to determine legal condition of property title and requirements needed to cure defective title. Examines mortgages, liens, judgments, easements, plat books, maps, contracts, and agreements to verify legal description, ownership, restrictions, or conformity to requirements. Analyzes encumbrances to title, and prepares report outlining encumbrances and actions required to clear title. Determine defendants required to obtain clear title through a foreclosure Initiates and follows-up on title claims. Interacts with Attorneys, Clients and others to resolve title issues. When you sit down and have an unhurried conversation about their health, they are impressed, happy, and understand that their health plan and care team cares about them.” - M.L., MD “The primary care physician gets a snapshot of a person in an office setting, but with Signify Health, we see things like the number of steps to enter their home, the state of disrepair those steps may be in, and the person’s ability to function comfortably and with ease in their own home.
