jobs.description:
Description

We are seeking a visionary, highly accomplished Senior Responsible AI Researcher to lead state-of-the-art research initiatives at the intersection of frontier models, Trust & Safety (T&S), model evaluation, and adversarial robustness.

In this role, you will bridge deep academic rigor with practical, real-world AI safety challenges. You will drive self-initiated research, design evaluation methodologies for emerging risks (e.g., persuasion, manipulation, sycophancy, agentic safety), and build safety benchmarks across Generative AI modalities (Text, Image, Multimodal, and Autonomous Agents). You will also serve as a key technical authority collaborating directly with top-tier AI labs, academic institutions, and enterprise partners.

Key Responsibilities

1. Frontier AI Safety & Evaluation Research

  • Design, build, and deploy new evaluation frameworks, benchmarks, and "Agentic Safety Gyms" to measure model capabilities, vulnerabilities, and alignment across diverse risk domains (e.g., Hate Speech, Misinformation, Elections Preparedness, IP/Copyright, Child Safety).
  • Develop advanced adversarial prompting methodologies, red-teaming strategies, and behavioral suites to stress-test Large Language Models (LLMs), Multimodal systems, and AI Agents.
  • Investigate emerging safety risks, including model persuasion, manipulation, sycophancy, bias, and jailbreaking tactics across multimodal and autonomous architectures.

2. Research Leadership & Outbound Impact

  • Lead high-impact collaborative research projects with external academic institutions (e.g., Oxford, Harvard, MATS, GovAI) and industry partners (e.g., OpenAI, Google DeepMind, Anthropic, Microsoft, Nvidia).
  • Represent the organization as a thought leader and speaker at top-tier international conferences, technical AI safety summits, and industry events.
  • Publish groundbreaking research findings in top AI and safety venues.

3. Strategic Client & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Go-To-Market (GTM), Policy and Delivery teams to translate research discoveries into scalable safety products, client-facing offerings, and delivery methodologies.
  • Engage directly with technical stakeholders and enterprise clients to translate complex safety and governance requirements into actionable research questions, experiments, and evaluation suites.

4. Mentorship & Team Augmentation

  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior researchers, data scientists, and engineers.
  • Bridge interdisciplinary gaps by integrating social science, policy, and technical perspectives into robust safety tooling and methodologies.

Requirements

Must Haves:

﻿Education & Track Record

  • PhD in Science, Technology and Society Studies (STS), Machine Learning, AI Ethics, Social Data Science or a closely related research domain.
  • Proven Research Record: Demonstrated academic excellence with a strong portfolio of peer-reviewed publications and conference presentations at top-tier venues (e.g., NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, ACL, IEEE, CVPR, or dedicated AI Safety conferences).

Technical & Domain Expertise

  • Deep Domain Expertise: Substantial experience in AI Safety, Responsible AI (RAI), Trust & Safety, or Model Evaluation.
  • Technical Mastery: Strong hands-on capabilities in Python and modern ML/DL frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, Transformers).
  • Generative AI & Agentic Systems: Deep working knowledge of foundation models (LLMs, Text-to-Image, Multimodal), agents, reasoning systems, and current safety mitigation techniques.
  • Benchmarking & Methodology: Proven experience in designing datasets, benchmark suites, red-teaming protocols, or synthetic simulation platforms.

Mindset & Soft Skills

  • Ownership & Self-Starter Attitude: Proven track record of self-initiating research projects, bringing in external partnerships, and shaping technical vision.
  • Communication & Engagement: Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to convey complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders, executives, and research peers.
  • Cross-Disciplinary Versatility: Ability to operate comfortably across technical data science, social science paradigms, and product execution.

﻿Preferred / Desirable Qualifications

  • Prior employment, consulting, advisory, or formal research collaboration with frontier AI labs (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, Meta AI) or leading safety research collectives (e.g., MATS, GovAI).
  • Experience in domain-specific safety applications, such as election integrity, psychological manipulation, or agentic behavioral safety suites.

About Alice

Alice is a trust, safety, and security company built for the AI era. We safeguard the communicative technologies people use to create, collaborate, and interact- whether with each other or with machines.

In a world where AI has fundamentally changed the nature of risk, Alice provides end-to-end coverage across the entire AI lifecycle. We support frontier model labs, enterprises, and UGC platforms with a comprehensive suite of solutions: from model hardening evaluations and pre-deployment red-teaming to runtime guardrails and ongoing drift detection.

Alice is widely considered a global leader in online safety and AI security. We have some of the most forward-thinking and passionate minds in the world working to safeguard over 3 billion users across the largest AI and tech platforms.

If you're creative and driven to secure the future of AI, we want to hear from you!

jobs.description:
Hello. We’re Teya.

Teya was founded on a simple belief: local businesses deserve better.

They are the cafés, restaurants, salons, shops and entrepreneurs that bring character to our high streets, create jobs and keep communities moving. Yet for too long, financial services has made life harder for them - with clunky tools, poor support and complexity that gets in the way of running a business.

Teya exists to change that.

We’re building a financial platform for local businesses across Europe - one built around simple tools, thoughtful design and real human support. Our Members rely on us to help them run their business with confidence, and that responsibility shapes the way we work.

We move fast. We care about quality. We stay close to the detail. And we believe great performance and genuine hospitality should go hand in hand.

If you want to build meaningful products, solve real problems and make a genuine difference for local businesses, we’d love to hear from you

Data Scientist

Your Mission

We're looking for a Data Scientist to join the Credit & Analytics team at Teya and help build the models that underpin our lending products. You will support the development of the credit risk and pricing models that help us make better decisions for the small businesses we serve across multiple geographies.

You will work across the model lifecycle, from data exploration and feature development through to deployment and performance monitoring. Working alongside senior data scientists, you will learn how to develop models in a statistically sound way and see first-hand how they shape credit decisions, pricing and portfolio performance.

You will collaborate with Credit Strategy, Analytics, Product, Engineering and Data Engineering, building your understanding of how data science creates real business value. From day one, your work will contribute to live products used by our Members.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone at the start of their data science career, with a quantitative background and a genuine interest in credit and lending, who wants to learn fast in a high-growth fintech.

Responsibilities

  • Model development: Build and test components of credit risk and pricing models, under guidance from senior team members.

  • Data exploration: Explore internal and external data sources, clean and prepare real-world datasets, and engineer features that could improve our models.

  • Analysis: Carry out analysis of merchant behaviour, repayment performance and product performance to answer well-defined business questions.

  • Model monitoring: Help track model performance, flag changes or drift, and support investigations into what is driving them.

  • Model deployment: Support Data Engineering with deploying models onto the ML Platform and integrating them into the credit decisioning system.

  • Documentation: Document your work clearly so models and analysis are easy to understand, review and build on.

  • Collaboration: Work closely with Product, Engineering, Data Engineering and Credit Strategy, and actively seek feedback from senior data scientists to develop your technical and commercial skills.

Requirements

  • Early in your data science career, with some experience in data science, quantitative analysis or a related field (including internships, research or substantial academic projects).

  • Degree in a quantitative field such as Mathematics, Statistics, Physics, Engineering, Computer Science or a related discipline.

  • A grounding in statistics and an understanding of core machine learning techniques.

  • Working knowledge of Python and SQL, with experience handling and analysing real-world datasets.

  • Ability to explain analytical work clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Curious, pragmatic and commercially minded, with a desire to understand how models drive business outcomes.

  • Eagerness to learn, take on feedback and grow within a collaborative team.

  • Exposure to credit risk modelling or financial services is a plus.

The Perks

  • Hybrid working: 4 days in our Central London office and 1 day from home. You choose which day you work from home, and you can change it whenever you need to.

  • We trust you, so we offer flexible working hours, as long as it suits both you and your team.

  • Physical and mental health support through our partnership with WellHub, giving free access to over 1,500 gyms in the UK, 1-1 therapy, meditation sessions, and digital fitness and nutrition apps.

  • Our company offers extended and improved maternity and paternity leave choices, giving employees more flexibility and support.

  • Cycle-to-Work Scheme.

  • Health and Life Insurance.

  • Pension Scheme.

  • 25 days of Annual Leave (plus Bank Holidays).

  • Office snacks every day.

  • Friendly, comfortable, and informal office environment in Central London.

We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, religion, or background can thrive and do their best work. We believe that a diverse team leads to better ideas, stronger outcomes, and a more supportive workplace for all.

We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

Do you have a passion for engaging with people and helping them on their journey to better health? Signify Health, part of CVS Health®, is seeking a Per Diem Physician to provide In-Home Health Evaluations, engaging with people in the comfort of their own homes and helping bridge gaps in care.

You’ll play a critical role in building trusted relationships to make people healthier, helping bring flexible, comprehensive and personalized health evaluations right to people’s front doors.

Job highlights
The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). You’ll use an iPad and an intuitive clinical workflow for each evaluation and are not required to prescribe medicine, order lab tests or alter people’s current treatment regimen.

In this role, you will:

  • Bring your heart into every visit, joining a national network of purpose-driven clinicians dedicated to improving health outcomes

  • Be part of our efforts to visit millions of people nationwide with the goal of providing connections to the right care for people’s unique needs

  • Work with Signify Health as a clinician colleague, fulfilling the requirements of the specified role

  • Be flexible to travel locally and within licensed states, as needed

  • Conduct virtual visits as needed

  • Provide all Signify Health services as indicated including Diagnostic & Preventive Services products (i.e., spirometry, DEE, bone density screening, etc.)

A Note on Our Work Environment:
As an in-home clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of health plan members. We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants.

Why Clinicians Enjoy Working with Signify Health
“Many of the people I see are shocked that a physician is coming to their home to visit with them one-on-one. When you sit down and have an unhurried conversation about their health, they are impressed, happy, and understand that their health plan and care team cares about them.” - M.L., MD

“The primary care physician gets a snapshot of a person in an office setting, but with Signify Health, we see things like the number of steps to enter their home, the state of disrepair those steps may be in, and the person’s ability to function comfortably and with ease in their own home. We can make referrals to the individual’s health plan, encourage the participation of their loved ones, and ensure their PCPs are aware of their health and overall quality of life.” - C.H., MD

Per diem employees qualify for:

  • Hourly base rate, plus additional incentive structure (i.e., per visit completed, other incentives may apply)

  • Malpractice insurance coverage (during Signify Health-related activities)

  • Supplies and other perks

Please note that we do not accept unsolicited candidate introductions, referrals, or resumes from external recruiters or staffing agencies.

Location: Candidates must be located in the PST time zone and have flexible availability for some weekends and after hours work.

Background Check Requirement

As part of our hiring process, Frontline Wildfire Defense conducts comprehensive background checks for all new hires. These checks typically cover the past 7–10 years and may include employment and education verification. For roles that require work in the field, driving record verification is also required. Employment offers are contingent upon the successful completion of these background checks.

About Frontline Wildfire Defense

Founded in 2017 by landscape ecologist and fire mitigation expert Harry Statter, Frontline developed the first fully integrated wildfire defense system to stop the leading cause of home loss in wildfires: ember-driven ignition. The system combines exterior sprinklers, full-coverage design, and connected software for remote monitoring and response, allowing homes to protect themselves long after families evacuate or infrastructure fails.

Proven effective during the 2025 Los Angeles wildfires, 96% of homes with Frontline systems survived. That success has earned top industry recognition, including Frontline being recognized as one of TIME’s Best Inventions 2025 in the Green Tech category and receiving the PCBC Gold Nugget Award for “Most Innovative Housing Concept” and the Best of IBS Award for “Best Home Technology.”

As wildfires grow hotter and more frequent, our vision is to give people the tools and strategies to live safely with fire. We’re building a mission-driven team creating real-world solutions in wildfire safety and climate tech.

About This Opportunity

As a Sales Development Representative (SDR), you will play a critical role in building the sales pipeline for Frontline Wildfire Defense. This role is responsible for engaging prospective customers, educating them about our system, qualifying opportunities, and scheduling appointments for the field sales team. The SDR will be the first point of contact for many customers and will represent our mission of protecting homes and communities with professionalism, energy, and empathy.

Key Responsibilities

  • Proactively engage prospective customers via phone, email, text, and web chat to explain the Frontline Wildfire Defense system and address questions.
  • Conduct up to 10 consultations daily to educate customers, uncover needs, and secure commitment to move forward in the sales process.
  • Qualify leads using defined criteria and schedule appointments with the field sales team for further consultation.
  • Manage and nurture a pipeline of active, dormant, and cold leads through consistent outreach and personalized communication.
  • Meet follow-up service level agreements (SLAs) for new lead engagement to ensure no opportunities are missed.
  • Partner closely with field sales representatives to ensure a smooth and professional customer handoff.
  • Provide feedback to the sales leadership and field team regarding lead quality, customer trends, and process improvements.
  • Accurately track activities, document lead status, and update customer information in Zoho CRM.
  • Achieve or exceed key performance metrics, including number of consultations, appointments set, lead conversion rates, and response times.
  • Continuously develop knowledge of wildfire risk mitigation, home protection systems, and Frontline’s product offerings to better serve customers.

Performance Metrics

  • Daily/weekly number of consultations completed.
  • Number of qualified appointments set for the field sales team.
  • Lead engagement response time (SLA compliance).
  • Conversion rates from consultation to appointment.
  • CRM accuracy and completeness.

Qualifications

  • 1–3 years of experience in sales development, inside sales, or a customer-facing role (preferably in technology, home services, or related industries).
  • Strong communication skills across phone, email, and text; able to build trust and credibility quickly.
  • Organized and disciplined with the ability to manage multiple leads, tasks, and follow-ups simultaneously.
  • Comfortable working with sales tools and CRMs (Zoho experience preferred).
  • Resilient, goal-oriented, and motivated by hitting and exceeding performance targets.
  • Ability to adapt to a fast-paced, evolving environment and contribute to process improvements.

  • Remote-first work environment, fostering work-life balance and autonomy
  • Company-provided equipment
  • Join a high-performing, mission-driven team doing work that truly matters
  • And much more!

Location: 100% Remote

Employment: Full-time, long-term position

Start date: As soon as possible after selection and agreement

Salary: Startup-aligned starting compensation, based on experience and responsibilities, with the potential for substantial growth during the first few years

About UsWe are a startup developing software products, web applications, AI-powered tools, integrations, and business automations across different projects.

Our delivery model combines internal ownership with outsourced development. We work with external developers and specialists, and we need strong technical leadership to turn their contributions into reliable, maintainable software.

AI-assisted and agentic development are central to how we work. We want to move quickly, make sensible technical decisions, and build solutions that our team can understand, operate, and improve.

We are looking for an experienced engineer who wants to join at an early stage, take meaningful responsibility, and grow with the company.

Job DescriptionWe are seeking a Senior AI & Full-Stack Engineer who can develop applications across frontend and backend, integrate AI capabilities, and manage the Linux infrastructure, databases, and deployment processes supporting them.

You should be comfortable taking a project from an initial business requirement through implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing operation. You will work across different products and internal initiatives, helping us choose practical solutions and deliver them efficiently.

Alongside hands-on engineering, your responsibilities may include leading developers, mentoring less experienced colleagues, coordinating outsourced contributors, and reviewing externally delivered work. Previous team leadership and mentoring experience are therefore important.

This is an opportunity to help establish the engineering foundations of a growing startup and develop into a broader technical leadership position.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain web applications across frontend and backend.
  • Build AI-powered features, integrations, internal tools, and business automations.
  • Use AI coding assistants and coding agents effectively, with appropriate testing and human review.
  • Translate business requirements into clear implementation tasks and verifiable acceptance criteria.
  • Design APIs, business logic, authentication, authorization, and third-party integrations.
  • Manage database schemas, migrations, query performance, backups, and recovery procedures.
  • Administer Linux servers, including application services, permissions, updates, networking, and troubleshooting.
  • Build and maintain Docker environments, including container networking, persistent storage, configuration, and health checks.
  • Manage DNS records, domain routing, TLS certificates, and reverse proxies.
  • Maintain CI/CD workflows using GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps Pipelines, and appropriate build agents or runners.
  • Carry out deployments with migration checks, rollback procedures, and post-deployment verification.
  • Investigate production incidents and address their underlying causes.
  • Coordinate outsourced developers and specialists, clarify requirements, review deliverables, and manage technical dependencies.
  • Mentor developers through code reviews, practical demonstrations, and constructive feedback.
  • Keep implementation proportionate to the problem, controlling unnecessary complexity, infrastructure costs, and maintenance overhead.

Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated senior-level experience delivering and maintaining production web applications.
  • Strong frontend development skills using a modern framework, JavaScript or TypeScript, HTML, and CSS.
  • Strong backend development experience, including secure APIs, integrations, validation, and error handling.
  • Practical experience integrating AI or LLM capabilities into software, including checking output quality, handling failures, and managing latency and usage costs.
  • Substantial hands-on experience with AI coding assistants or agentic development workflows, with examples of working results you independently verified.
  • Strong SQL and relational database experience, including migrations, indexing, performance analysis, and backup and recovery.
  • Hands-on Linux administration and Docker deployment experience.
  • A working understanding of DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, TLS, firewalls, ports, and reverse proxies.
  • Practical CI/CD experience with GitHub Actions and familiarity with Azure DevOps repositories, pipelines, and build agents.
  • Strong Git, pull-request, code-review, and release-management skills.
  • Previous experience leading a development team or coordinating technical delivery.
  • Proven mentoring experience and the ability to explain technical decisions clearly.
  • Experience working with outsourced developers, contractors, or distributed teams.
  • The ability to work independently, prioritize competing needs, and make sound decisions with a limited startup budget.
  • Interest in a long-term, full-time role with increasing responsibility.

Especially Valuable Experience

  • Building products or engineering processes in an early-stage startup.
  • Taking responsibility for several applications or services at the same time.
  • Evaluating outsourced work for correctness, security, maintainability, and operational readiness.
  • Developing AI agents, tool integrations, retrieval workflows, or reliable automation.
  • Operating PostgreSQL and multi-service Docker environments.
  • Establishing deployment standards, monitoring, incident procedures, and practical documentation.
  • Helping junior developers become more effective through structured mentoring.

Growth, Responsibility and CompensationJoining at this stage offers the opportunity to influence how we build software, organize delivery, and develop our engineering team.

Initial compensation will reflect our startup budget, your experience, and the agreed scope of responsibility. As your contribution and responsibilities grow alongside the business, we aim to provide substantial salary progression during the first few years.

For a strong contributor, the role can develop into positions such as Technical Lead, Engineering Lead, or Head of Engineering. Progression will depend on demonstrated results, leadership capability, company growth, and financial capacity. Compensation expectations and progression milestones will be discussed openly during recruitment.

What We Offer

  • A fully remote, full-time role with a long-term perspective.
  • Direct involvement in technical decisions across multiple products and initiatives.
  • The opportunity to build, lead, and mentor a distributed engineering team.
  • Broad ownership across software, AI integration, infrastructure, and delivery.
  • Close collaboration with startup leadership.
  • The potential for significant career and compensation growth as the company develops.

Remote Working ArrangementOur remote working setup includes a time-tracking tool that records mouse-click and keyboard-activity metrics and captures screenshots of the screen. This monitoring is part of the working arrangement and will be explained during the recruitment process.

Applicants should be comfortable working with this setup.

How to ApplyWe are looking to fill this core engineering role promptly. Applying early gives us the opportunity to discuss how you could help shape our technical direction from the beginning.

Please submit your CV and a short overview covering:

  • A production application you helped deliver and your own frontend and backend contributions.
  • An AI feature or agentic workflow you implemented and how you verified its results.
  • Your Linux, Docker, database, and deployment responsibilities.
  • A team you led or developers you mentored, including the outcomes.
  • Your experience coordinating outsourced development and reviewing external deliverables.
  • Your earliest start date and salary expectations, taking our startup stage into account.

Public portfolio links and GitHub repositories are welcome. Please do not share confidential customer information or credentials.

About UsWe are a startup developing AI-powered solutions, business applications, integrations, and automations across different products and internal initiatives.

Microsoft technologies are an important part of our work. We want to turn business requirements into useful AI assistants, reliable workflows, and connected systems that deliver measurable results.

Our delivery model combines internal ownership with outsourced development. We are looking for someone who enjoys hands-on implementation, can coordinate external specialists, and wants to help build and lead a growing team.

The RoleWe are seeking an experienced Microsoft AI Engineer with strong practical experience in Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, Microsoft Foundry, and Power Automate.

You will take responsibility for projects from requirements discovery and solution design through implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing improvement. Your work will span different business processes and products.

Alongside technical delivery, your responsibilities may include project management, team leadership, mentoring, and coordination of outsourced contributors. You should be comfortable discussing business priorities, organizing delivery, reviewing technical work, and helping colleagues improve.

Ownership of Our Microsoft EnvironmentYou will independently manage and develop our company's Microsoft environment across Microsoft 365, Azure, and Power Platform. This includes taking ownership of configuration, access management, operational reliability, governance, documentation, and cost control.

We need someone who can identify issues, propose practical improvements, coordinate implementation, and verify that our systems continue to work reliably. You should be comfortable combining hands-on technical work with project management, team leadership, mentoring, and coordination of outsourced specialists.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain AI assistants and agents using Microsoft Copilot Studio and Microsoft Foundry.
  • Identify practical opportunities for Microsoft 365 Copilot and help teams use it effectively.
  • Connect AI solutions to relevant business knowledge and systems while respecting permissions and data boundaries.
  • Develop Power Automate workflows with reliable validation, exception handling, monitoring, and recovery.
  • Integrate Microsoft 365, Teams, SharePoint, Dataverse, Microsoft Graph, external APIs, and other business systems.
  • Implement custom connectors or supporting code where the project requires them.
  • Evaluate AI output quality, grounding, failure behavior, latency, and operating costs.
  • Establish appropriate human review and approval steps for consequential automated actions.
  • Independently administer our Microsoft 365, Azure, and Power Platform environments, including users, groups, roles, application registrations, permissions, and service connections.
  • Configure and manage GitHub-connected Power Platform solutions, including repositories, authentication, source control, branching, reviews, and deployment workflows.

  • Monitor platform health, investigate failures, maintain operational documentation, and control licensing and cloud expenditure.
  • Translate business requirements into clear tasks, delivery milestones, and verifiable acceptance criteria.
  • Manage project scope, priorities, dependencies, risks, and stakeholder communication.
  • Coordinate outsourced developers, review their deliverables, and maintain clear ownership.
  • Mentor colleagues through practical demonstrations, reviews, and knowledge transfer.
  • Keep solutions maintainable and proportionate to the problem and startup budget.

Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated experience delivering production solutions using Copilot Studio, Microsoft Foundry, and Power Automate.
  • Practical understanding of Microsoft 365 Copilot and its use in business workflows.
  • Experience building AI agents or assistants connected to business data, tools, and APIs.
  • Experience evaluating AI-generated answers and actions, including handling unreliable or unsupported output.
  • Strong knowledge of Power Automate cloud flows, connectors, expressions, approvals, and troubleshooting.
  • Experience integrating SharePoint, Teams, Dataverse, Microsoft Graph, or comparable business platforms.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID, application permissions, authentication, and secure credential handling.
  • Ability to write and review supporting code or scripts, for example in Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, or PowerShell.
  • Proven experience independently administering a company's Microsoft environment, with responsibility for reliable operation and ongoing improvement.
  • Hands-on experience configuring and managing Power Platform solutions connected to GitHub.
  • Practical experience with GitHub Actions or comparable CI/CD workflows for Microsoft solutions.
  • Strong understanding of environment separation, managed and unmanaged solutions, dependencies, connection references, and environment-specific configuration.
  • Previous responsibility for technical project delivery, including planning and stakeholder communication.
  • Proven experience leading developers, mentoring colleagues, or coordinating distributed contributors.
  • The ability to take ownership of technical problems, communicate their business impact, and carry improvements through to a verified result.
  • Ability to work independently, explain technical decisions clearly, and prioritize within a limited startup budget.

Especially Valuable Experience

  • Delivering Microsoft AI or automation projects in a startup or consulting environment.
  • Building retrieval workflows with documented knowledge sources and permission-aware access.
  • Working with Power Apps, Azure services, SQL databases, or Azure DevOps.
  • Experience with Azure API Management and its AI gateway capabilities, including authentication, model routing, usage limits, monitoring, and cost control.
  • Experience with related components such as Azure Key Vault, Azure Monitor, Application Insights, and Azure AI Search.
  • Experience building and maintaining Power BI reports and dashboards, including Power Query, data modelling, DAX, scheduled refresh, workspace permissions, and row-level security.
  • Experience connecting reporting and analytics to operational workflows and business decisions.
  • Replacing fragile workflows with solutions that are easier to operate and maintain.

Strong contributors may progress into roles such as Microsoft AI Team Lead, AI & Automation Lead, Solutions Architect, or Head of AI & Automation. Responsibilities

Description

Empower AI is seeking a Scrum Master to enable Agile delivery for DCSA Customer Support Services. The Scrum Master guides cross-functional teams delivering customer support, IT service management, automation, analytics, and application capabilities against a government-prioritized backlog. The role serves as a servant leader and Agile coach, facilitating transparent planning and delivery, removing impediments, protecting team focus, and helping Government stakeholders, product owners, and delivery teams maintain a shared understanding of priorities, dependencies, risks, and outcomes. Work is performed in a compliance-driven environment requiring documented testing, stakeholder demonstrations, formal acceptance, and controlled releases. This is a salaried, FLSA-exempt position in which you will independently analyze situations, determine the appropriate course of action, and exercise discretion and independent judgment on matters of significance to the program and its customers.

THIS IS A REMOTE ROLE BASED WITH UP TO 10% OF TRAVEL INVOLVED.

JOB DUTIES

  • Facilitate Agile ceremonies for assigned delivery teams, including sprint planning, daily scrums, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, retrospectives, and release-planning activities.

  • Coach teams and stakeholders on Scrum values, Agile practices, estimation, acceptance criteria, Definition of Ready, Definition of Done, and continuous improvement methods.
  • Identify, track, and remove impediments; coordinate resolution of cross-team dependencies, environmental constraints, approvals, and resource conflicts that affect sprint commitments.
  • Maintain transparent delivery metrics and dashboards, including sprint velocity, burndown or burnup, backlog health, work in progress, release readiness, and impediment status; communicate meaningful trends and risks to program leadership and Government stakeholders.

  • Assist with dependency mapping, risk management, capacity planning, and roadmap development for iterative delivery and larger releases.
  • Promote disciplined use of approved work-management and collaboration tools; maintain accurate sprint artifacts, decision records, action items, and status reporting.
  • Support the transition of work from development through deployment and operational support, including knowledge transfer and post-implementation review activities.

Qualifications

REQUIREMENTS

  • Bachelor's degree and a minimum of 5 years of related experience; an additional 4 years of related experience may be substituted for the degree.
  • Must be a U.S. Citizen.
  • Must have an Active Secret Clearance (favorably adjudicated T3/T3R) to start.
  • Must be within investigation scope and/or currently enrolled in Continuous Evaluation / Continuous Vetting.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently, analyze problems, determine the appropriate course of action, and exercise discretion and independent judgment with limited day-to-day supervision.
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience serving as a Scrum Master, Agile Delivery Lead, or Agile Coach for software development or IT-service delivery teams.
  • Demonstrated experience facilitating Scrum ceremonies, managing impediments and dependencies, and coaching cross-functional teams and stakeholders in Agile practices.
  • Experience translating business needs into well-formed user stories, acceptance criteria, and prioritized backlog items with product owners and technical teams.
  • Experience with Agile work-management tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, ServiceNow Agile Development, or comparable platforms.
  • Experience with Agile metrics, delivery reporting, risk management, sprint forecasting, and stakeholder communications.
  • Experience supporting User Acceptance Testing, formal stakeholder demonstrations, and controlled release or change management processes.
  • Strong facilitation, conflict-resolution, organizational, written, and verbal communication skills.

DESIRED SKILLS

The bright side of mortgages

nesto is Canada’s leading digital residential mortgage lender, offering Canadians the lowest rates from the get-go — with total transparency and no haggling.

About Us

As Canada's pioneer in online mortgage lending, nesto is transforming the way Canadians finance their homes. Our mission is to offer a positive, empowering, and transparent property financing experience, simplified from start to finish.

Borrowers benefit from rates that are often lower than those offered by the big banks, along with an exceptional end-to-end mortgage experience powered by best-in-class AI technology. Fast, simple, and fully digital, nesto has been recognized as CLA Lender of the Year for three consecutive years. That's the bright side of mortgages.

Nesto Group

Nesto Group is Canada's leading provider of mortgage technology and financing solutions, with more than CAD $80 billion in residential and commercial mortgages under administration. Trusted by many of the country's leading financial institutions, we combine over 50 years of mortgage expertise with proprietary cloud and AI technology to transform the future of lending.

Powered by our proprietary cloud and AI technology, nesto has become one of Canada's fastest-growing mortgage lenders, gaining market share across direct-to-consumer (D2C) residential lending, the broker channel, and multi-family commercial lending. Recognized as one of Deloitte's Fast 50 companies for three consecutive years, we continue to push the industry forward through innovation, technology, and customer-focused solutions.

Operating through our family of brands—CMLS, nesto, and Nesto Cloud—our mission is to build Canada's mortgage ecosystem of the future and create a true Canadian champion in lending technology and financial services. Learn more at:

Life at nesto

At nesto, we're passionate about challenging the status quo and building a better mortgage experience and saving money on their mortgages for Canadians. We foster a culture of collaboration, transparency, and creativity where every team member is empowered to take ownership, make an impact, and grow. If you're looking to solve meaningful problems alongside ambitious, supportive teammates, you'll feel right at home here.

Work Location

This is a remote-first role open to candidates anywhere in Canada. You'll have the flexibility to work from home or from any of our offices nationwide.

Why We Are Hiring

nesto's AI Stream is building Maestro, our AI underwriting and lending engine. Maestro reads documents, applies credit policies automatically, and generates clear, auditable decisions in minutes. The team is in an active build phase with significant near-term delivery commitments, and we need a senior engineer who can take ownership of major projects and help set technical direction quickly.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Lead major features and projects end-to-end, surfacing trade-offs clearly so delivery stays on track without compromising quality
  • Design and optimize agentic AI workflows that combine deterministic rules with LLM perception, embedding search, and structured output extraction
  • Build and own evaluation pipelines, including golden sets, offline and online evals, and regression tracking, to measure model quality over time
  • Shape architecture decisions for the AI agent platform, setting high technical standards through code reviews and collaborative problem-solving
  • Use AI tooling and agent harnesses to write and ship code faster, so the team can keep pace with its deadlines
  • Mentor peers and collaborate with cross-functional teammates to hit delivery timelines

What You Bring

  • 5+ years of professional software development experience, with strong backend and API skills
  • Strong Python skills and hands-on experience with LLMs, ideally running them in production (prompting, RAG, or structured extraction)
  • A data science, data analysis, or statistics background
  • Experience with model implementation, monitoring, and evaluation across the full lifecycle
  • Solid software engineering fundamentals, including testing, design patterns, and agile practices
  • Comfort with AI-assisted development tooling and agent-based workflows
  • Experience leading projects or stepping into a technical lead role

Nice-to-Have

  • Familiarity with LLM orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex), vector databases, and document intelligence pipelines
  • Experience managing AI production systems trade-offs (cost, latency, etc.)
  • Experience working in regulated domains, such as OSFI E-23 compliance

This Role Might Be for You If

  • You want to build something from the ground up and see it through, rather than move into people management
  • You've shipped LLM features to production and care about how they're evaluated
  • You're comfortable letting AI tooling accelerate how you write and review software
  • You've led projects before and are ready to take a tech lead role on product-oriented projects with real deadlines
  • You come from backend or API work and have built data skills alongside it


Why You'll Love Working Here

We believe great people do their best work when they're supported professionally, personally, and financially. That's why we offer a comprehensive rewards package designed to help you thrive at every stage of your career.

Competitive Rewards — Competitive compensation, performance incentives (where applicable), and recognition for your contributions.

Health & Wellness — Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, Health & Wellness Spending Accounts (where applicable), telemedicine, Employee Assistance Programs, and mental health support for you and your family.

Time to Recharge — Generous vacation (4 weeks), floater days, and statutory holidays to help you recharge.

Planning for the Future — RRSP matching to support your long-term financial wellbeing.

Family Support — Enhanced maternity and parental leave top-up programs.

Learning & Growth — Education assistance, mentorship, training, and opportunities to build your career across Nesto Group.

Tools for Success — Modern technology, collaborative teams, and the resources you need to do your best work.


Diversity, Equity & Inclusion

At Nesto Group, we believe diverse perspectives make us stronger. We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone feels respected, supported, and empowered to succeed.

We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, including Indigenous Peoples (First Nations, Inuit, and Métis), persons with disabilities, members of racialized communities, women, and members of the 2SLGBTQIA+ community.

If you require accommodation during any stage of the recruitment process, we are committed to working with you to meet your needs.

Category: Education

Location:


We are seeking an enthusiastic and knowledgeable Crypto Software Tutor to teach beginner to intermediate learners about cryptocurrency, blockchain, and decentralized technologies.
The ideal candidate should be able to simplify complex blockchain concepts, guide students through real-world projects, and make learning interactive and practical.

This role is perfect for professionals passionate about Web3, DeFi, and crypto education, who can mentor learners starting their journey in blockchain software and development.

  1. Conduct live online classes on cryptocurrency, blockchain, and related software tools.

  2. Teach beginner and intermediate topics such as:

    • Basics of blockchain & crypto transactions

    • Wallets and keys (MetaMask, Trust Wallet)

    • NFTs, Tokens, and Smart Contracts (Solidity, Remix IDE)

    • Decentralized Applications (DApps)

  3. Guide learners through hands-on exercises and small projects such as creating tokens or building a basic DApp.

  4. Provide clear explanations with relatable, real-world examples.

  5. Assign homework, projects, and assessments to reinforce learning.

  6. Conduct feedback and doubt-clearing sessions.

  7. Stay updated with emerging trends in blockchain, DeFi, and crypto security.

  8. Maintain strong learner engagement and deliver interactive sessions following Enthuziastic’s standards.


Requirements

Required Skills

  • Sound understanding of cryptocurrency fundamentals and blockchain architecture.

  • Practical knowledge of tools such as MetaMask, Remix IDE, Truffle, Hardhat, or Ganache.

  • Ability to explain coding concepts using Solidity, Python, or JavaScript.

  • Fluent English communication and confident online teaching presence.

  • Reliable high-speed internet, working camera, and professional setup.

Preferred Skills

  • Hands-on experience in smart contract development and token creation.

  • Familiarity with DeFi, NFT platforms, or Web3 app frameworks.

  • Basic exposure to crypto trading, staking, or gas fee mechanics.

  • Previous online teaching or mentoring experience preferred.

Qualification

  • Bachelor’s in Computer Science / IT / Electronics (preferred).

  • Certification in Blockchain or Crypto Technologies (preferred but not mandatory).

Technical Requirements

  • Stable high-speed internet connection and a quiet, professional home studio setup.

  • Good quality microphone/headset and webcam for clear audio and video.

  • Familiarity with Zoom and other online teaching platforms.

  • Ability to use virtual whiteboards, share notations, and integrate digital teaching aids effectively.


Benefits

  • Flexible teaching schedule with fully remote work.

  • A creative and respectful environment for passionate musicians.

  • Access to a wide learner base across countries and age groups.

  • Competitive compensation based on experience and performance.

  • Continuous support and development opportunities for instructors.
